This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook for the analysis of RNAseq data generated from and published in Snyder et al. (20XX). The code in this document was modified from that made available from the work of Schweizer et al. 2023 (https://github.com/renaschweizer/pman_diaphragm_rnaseq). This analysis focuses on Antarctic and sub-Antarctic notothenioid species, C. aceratus ("ACE"), N. coriiceps ("COR"), P. georgianus ("GEO"), G. gibberifrons ("GIB"), and E. maclovinus ("MAC").

# QC Metric Analysis
Start by making sure all variables are cleared, then load libraries for analysis.

```{r load_packages}

setwd("C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq/Cleaned Analysis")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
rm(list = ls())

packages <- c(
  "lme4", "lmerTest", "edgeR", "DESeq2", "WGCNA", "Hmisc", "reshape",
  "gprofiler2", "ggbiplot", "plotrix", "UpSetR", "VennDiagram",
  "RColorBrewer", "emmeans", "qwraps2", "viridis", "tidyverse",
  "readxl", "dplyr"
)

invisible(lapply(packages, function(pkg) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
}))

source("rnaseq_helpers_revised.R")
```

We start by importing our technical sequencing metrics data for our RNAseq samples. We will then run principal components analysis and generate a 95% data ellipse to identify technical outliers. The default stat_ellipse() is intended to compute a bivariate confidence interval assuming a Student-t distribution. There is more information on this process here <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/16659749/getting-the-ellipse-function-to-match-the-dataellipse-function-in-r>.

We also run ANOVAs of sequencing metrics between lanes to test for batch effects.

```{r load in progress from previous analysis runs}

load("DEG_WGCNA_environment.RData")

run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y")
```

```{r load in metrics}
metrics <- read_excel("Ant_fish_RNAseq_qc_metrics.xlsx")
metrics.no.na = na.omit(metrics)
metrics.no.na <- metrics.no.na %>%
  dplyr::rename(forward_reads = "forward reads")

# Generating a PCA for Treatment effects with qc metrics ----
metrics.pca <- prcomp(metrics.no.na[,c(4:6,8:9)], center = TRUE,scale. = TRUE) #don't include perc dups from fastqc or # reads 
summary(metrics.pca)
#str(metrics.pca)

metrics.no.na %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mn_align  = mean(align_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mn_assign = mean(assign_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# output figure to Console
ggbiplot(metrics.pca, ellipse=TRUE, labels=metrics.no.na$SampleID,groups=metrics.no.na$Treatment,circle=FALSE,colour="black",ellipse.prob = 0.95) + scale_colour_manual(values=c("black", "red", "blue")) + ggtitle("PCA of RNASeq samples with 95% ellipse")

# Generating a PCA figure for sequencing batch effects with qc metrics ----

# Add the "group" column, setting value "1" for ACE, COR, GEO, GIB species and "2" for MAC (sequenced later)
metrics.no.na$group <- ifelse(metrics.no.na$Species %in% c("ACE", "COR", "GEO", "GIB"), "1",
                              ifelse(metrics.no.na$Species == "MAC", "2", NA))
# output figure to Console
ggbiplot(metrics.pca, ellipse=TRUE, labels=metrics.no.na$SampleID,groups=metrics.no.na$group,circle=FALSE,colour="black",ellipse.prob = 0.95) + scale_colour_manual(values=c("black", "red")) + ggtitle("PCA of RNASeq samples with 95% ellipse")

# Generating a PCA for Treatment effects with qc metrics except Alignment rate ----
metrics.pca.no.alignment.or.assignment <- prcomp(metrics.no.na[,c(4:7)], center = TRUE,scale. = TRUE) #don't include perc dups from fastqc or # reads 
summary(metrics.pca.no.alignment.or.assignment)

# output figure to Console
# making same figure as above, but without the Alignment rate to see how much that's driving separation
ggbiplot(metrics.pca.no.alignment.or.assignment, ellipse=TRUE, labels=metrics.no.na$SampleID,groups=metrics.no.na$group,circle=FALSE,colour="black",ellipse.prob = 0.95) + scale_colour_manual(values=c("black", "red")) + ggtitle("PCA of RNASeq samples with 95% ellipse \n No Alignment Rate or Assignment Rate")

# Run anova to check for significnat differences with treatment ----

lm_qs <- lm(mean_quality_score ~ Treatment, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_q30 <- lm(perc_bases_above_q30 ~ Treatment, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_gc <- lm(perc_gc ~ Treatment, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_align <- lm(align_rate ~ Treatment, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_assign <- lm(assign_rate ~ Treatment, data=metrics.no.na)

anova(lm_qs)
anova(lm_q30)
anova(lm_gc)
anova(lm_align)
anova(lm_assign)

# Run anova to check for batch effects ----
lm_qs <- lm(mean_quality_score ~ group, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_q30 <- lm(perc_bases_above_q30 ~ group, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_gc <- lm(perc_gc ~ group, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_align <- lm(align_rate ~ group, data=metrics.no.na)
lm_assign <- lm(assign_rate ~ group, data=metrics.no.na)

anova(lm_qs)
anova(lm_q30)
anova(lm_gc)
anova(lm_align)
anova(lm_assign)

# Data summary of qc metrics
set.seed(42)
# define the markup language we are working in.
# options(qwraps2_markup = "latex") is also supported.
options(qwraps2_markup = "markdown")

our_summary1 <-
  list("Mean Quality Score" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(mean_quality_score),
            "max"       = ~ max(mean_quality_score),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(mean_quality_score)),
       "Percent Bases Above Q30" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(perc_bases_above_q30),
            "median"    = ~ median(perc_bases_above_q30),
            "max"       = ~ max(perc_bases_above_q30),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(perc_bases_above_q30)),
       "GC (%)" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(perc_gc),
            "median"    = ~ median(perc_gc),
            "max"       = ~ max(perc_gc),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(perc_gc)),
       "Reads" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(forward_reads),
            "median"    = ~ median(forward_reads),
            "max"       = ~ max(forward_reads),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(forward_reads)),
       "Genome Alignment Rate (%)" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(align_rate),
            "max"       = ~ max(align_rate),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(align_rate)),
        "Assignment Rate (%)" =
       list("min"       = ~ min(assign_rate),
            "max"       = ~ max(assign_rate),
            "mean (sd)" = ~ qwraps2::mean_sd(assign_rate))
       )

### Overall
whole <- summary_table(metrics.no.na, our_summary1)
whole
```

## Venn Diagram Figure:
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggforce)
  library(dplyr)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(patchwork)
})

# =========================================================
# DIFFERENTIALLY EXPRESSED GENES WITHIN SPECIES
# Pairwise Venns: Hypoxia vs ILOS, split by Up/Down
# Expects objects like:
#   sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr, sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr, ...
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# COLORS / STYLE
# -------------------------
col_hyp_fill <- "#2B6CB0"
col_hyp_line <- "#214E86"
col_ilo_fill <- "#DAA520"
col_ilo_line <- "#A88217"

alpha_fill  <- 0.55
stroke_size <- 1.1
label_size  <- 4.2

# -------------------------
# FIXED ORDERS / LABELS
# -------------------------
species_order <- c("MAC", "GIB", "COR", "GEO", "ACE")
dir_order     <- c("Up", "Down")

species_names <- c(
  MAC = "E. maclovinus",
  GIB = "G. gibberifrons",
  COR = "N. coriiceps",
  GEO = "P. georgianus",
  ACE = "C. aceratus"
)

# -------------------------
# HELPERS
# -------------------------

# Use rownames as the DEG identifiers for within-species Venns.
# Do NOT use the Gene column here.
.clean_de <- function(df, lowercase = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(character(0))

  ids <- rownames(df)
  ids <- trimws(ids)

  if (lowercase) ids <- tolower(ids)

  ids <- ids[nzchar(ids) & !is.na(ids)]
  unique(ids)
}

get_set <- function(spec,
                    condition = c("Hypoxia", "ILOS"),
                    direction = c("Up", "Down")) {
  condition <- match.arg(condition)
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  obj_name <- paste0("sig.", condition, "_", spec, ".fdr")
  df <- if (exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) get(obj_name, inherits = TRUE) else NULL

  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  ids <- .clean_de(df, lowercase = FALSE)

  keep <- if (direction == "Up") {
    df$logFC > 0
  } else {
    df$logFC < 0
  }

  unique(ids[keep & !is.na(keep)])
}

row_for <- function(spec, dir) {
  hyp <- get_set(spec, "Hypoxia", dir)
  ilo <- get_set(spec, "ILOS",    dir)

  data.frame(
    Species   = spec,
    Direction = dir,
    area1     = length(hyp),                 # Hypoxia total
    area2     = length(ilo),                 # ILOS total
    overlap   = length(intersect(hyp, ilo)), # shared genes
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

circle_overlap_area <- function(r1, r2, d) {
  if (d >= r1 + r2) return(0)
  if (d <= abs(r1 - r2)) return(pi * min(r1, r2)^2)

  r1_2 <- r1^2
  r2_2 <- r2^2

  a <- acos((d^2 + r1_2 - r2_2) / (2 * d * r1)) * 2
  b <- acos((d^2 + r2_2 - r1_2) / (2 * d * r2)) * 2

  0.5 * r1_2 * (a - sin(a)) + 0.5 * r2_2 * (b - sin(b))
}

first_num_or_zero <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) return(0)
  as.numeric(x[1])
}

fetch_count <- function(df, sp, dir, col) {
  v <- df[df$Species == sp & df$Direction == dir, col, drop = TRUE]
  first_num_or_zero(v)
}

# -------------------------
# BUILD COUNTS TABLE
# -------------------------
venn_counts <- do.call(
  rbind,
  unlist(
    lapply(species_order, function(sp) {
      list(row_for(sp, "Up"), row_for(sp, "Down"))
    }),
    recursive = FALSE
  )
)

venn_counts <- venn_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Species   = factor(Species, levels = species_order),
    Direction = factor(Direction, levels = dir_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Species, Direction)

pairs_ord <- venn_counts

# Optional sanity check
print(pairs_ord)

# -------------------------
# GLOBAL SCALE
# Anchor circle sizes to largest MAC set
# -------------------------
max_area_mac <- pairs_ord %>%
  filter(Species == "MAC") %>%
  summarise(m = max(c(area1, area2), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(m)

if (!is.finite(max_area_mac) || max_area_mac <= 0) {
  max_area_mac <- 1
}

R_MAX <- 2.6 * 1.35
rad_from_total <- function(A) R_MAX * sqrt(A / max_area_mac)

X_PAD <- 1.35 * R_MAX
Y_MIN <- -1.35 * R_MAX
Y_MAX <-  1.15 * R_MAX

# -------------------------
# ONE MINI-PANEL
# -------------------------
make_pair_panel <- function(total_hyp, total_ilo, overlap) {
  total_hyp <- first_num_or_zero(total_hyp)
  total_ilo <- first_num_or_zero(total_ilo)
  overlap   <- first_num_or_zero(overlap)

  # force sane non-negative values
  total_hyp <- max(total_hyp, 0)
  total_ilo <- max(total_ilo, 0)
  overlap   <- max(overlap, 0)

  if (total_hyp <= 0 && total_ilo <= 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD, X_PAD), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN, Y_MAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
        ) +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No DEGs", size = 4.8, fontface = "italic")
    )
  }

  r1 <- if (total_hyp > 0) rad_from_total(total_hyp) else 0
  r2 <- if (total_ilo > 0) rad_from_total(total_ilo) else 0

  # impossible overlaps shouldn't happen, but guard anyway
  overlap <- min(overlap, total_hyp, total_ilo)

  A_ov <- pi * R_MAX^2 * (overlap / max_area_mac)

  u_hyp <- max(total_hyp - overlap, 0)
  u_ilo <- max(total_ilo - overlap, 0)

  d <- if (overlap <= 0) {
    (r1 + r2) * 2.6
  } else if (u_hyp == 0 || u_ilo == 0) {
    0.70 * abs(r1 - r2)
  } else {
    eps <- 1e-6
    uniroot(
      function(dd) circle_overlap_area(r1, r2, dd) - A_ov,
      lower = abs(r1 - r2) + eps,
      upper = (r1 + r2) - eps
    )$root
  }

  cx_h <- -d / 2
  cx_i <-  d / 2

  df <- bind_rows(
    if (total_hyp > 0) data.frame(set = "Hypoxia", cx = cx_h, cy = 0, r = r1) else NULL,
    if (total_ilo > 0) data.frame(set = "ILOS",    cx = cx_i, cy = 0, r = r2) else NULL
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, fill = set),
      alpha = alpha_fill,
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, color = set),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = stroke_size
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_fill, ILOS = col_ilo_fill),
      name = "Treatment"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_line, ILOS = col_ilo_line),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD, X_PAD), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN, Y_MAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, -80, 0, -80)
    )

  if (u_hyp > 0 && total_hyp > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_h - r1 * 0.15,
      y = r1 + R_MAX * 0.18,
      label = comma(u_hyp),
      size = label_size
    )
  }

  if (overlap > 0 && total_hyp > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = comma(overlap),
      size = label_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    )
  }

  if (u_ilo > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_i + r2 * 0.15,
      y = -r2 - R_MAX * 0.18,
      label = comma(u_ilo),
      size = label_size
    )
  }

  p
}

# -------------------------
# LABEL / HEADER CELLS
# -------------------------
label_cell <- function(sp) {
  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.985, y = 0.5, hjust = 1,
      label = species_names[[sp]],
      size = 6.0,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 24))
}

make_header_species <- function(size = 6.2) {
  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.88, 1.02), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.99, y = 0.5, hjust = 1,
      label = "Species",
      size = size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 2, 2))
}

make_header_cell <- function(txt, size = 6.2) {
  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
      label = txt,
      size = size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

# -------------------------
# BUILD BODY CELLS
# -------------------------
label_cells <- lapply(species_order, label_cell)

up_cells <- lapply(species_order, function(sp) {
  make_pair_panel(
    total_hyp = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Up",   "area1"),
    total_ilo = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Up",   "area2"),
    overlap   = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Up",   "overlap")
  )
})

down_cells <- lapply(species_order, function(sp) {
  make_pair_panel(
    total_hyp = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Down", "area1"),
    total_ilo = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Down", "area2"),
    overlap   = fetch_count(pairs_ord, sp, "Down", "overlap")
  )
})

# -------------------------
# COLUMN ASSEMBLY
# -------------------------
header_height <- 0.12

left_col <-
  make_header_species() /
  wrap_plots(label_cells, ncol = 1) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(header_height, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), plot.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

up_col <-
  make_header_cell("Upregulated") /
  wrap_plots(up_cells, ncol = 1) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(header_height, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, -140, 0, -140), plot.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

down_col <-
  make_header_cell("Downregulated") /
  wrap_plots(down_cells, ncol = 1) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(header_height, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, -140, 0, -140), plot.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

# -------------------------
# BODY BAND WIDTHS
# -------------------------
left_w <- 0.16
ven_w  <- 0.34
eps    <- 0.0025

body_w <- left_w + 2 * ven_w
body_x <- (1 - body_w) / 2

i_left <- left_w / body_w
i_ven  <- ven_w  / body_w
i_eps  <- eps    / body_w

grid_cols_inner <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(left_col, x = 0, y = 0, width = i_left, height = 1) +
  draw_plot(up_col,   x = i_left - i_eps, y = 0, width = i_ven + i_eps, height = 1) +
  draw_plot(down_col, x = i_left + i_ven - 2 * i_eps, y = 0, width = i_ven + i_eps, height = 1)

grid_cols <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(grid_cols_inner, x = body_x, y = 0, width = body_w, height = 1)

# -------------------------
# TITLE + LEGEND
# -------------------------
title_row <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(
    "Differentially Expressed Genes Within Species",
    fontface = "bold",
    x = body_x + body_w / 2, y = 0.5,
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
    size = 20
  )

treat_leg <- ggplot(
  data.frame(set = c("Hypoxia", "ILOS"), x = c(1, 2), y = 1),
  aes(x, y, fill = set, color = set)
) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 10, stroke = stroke_size) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_fill, ILOS = col_ilo_fill),
    name = "Treatment"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_line, ILOS = col_ilo_line),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    title.position = "top",
    nrow = 1,
    byrow = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 8, alpha = 1)
  )) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.box.just = "center"
  )

treatment_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(treat_leg)

legend_row <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(treatment_legend, x = body_x, y = 0, width = body_w, height = 1)

# -------------------------
# FINAL PLOT
# -------------------------
final_plot <- plot_grid(
  title_row,
  legend_row,
  grid_cols,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.08, 0.07, 1),
  align = "v"
) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

final_plot

# -------------------------
# SAVE
# -------------------------
if (!exists("run_date")) {
  run_date <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
}

out_dir <- file.path("edgeR_output", "AllSpecies", "FDR=0.05_L2FC=0")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("PairwiseVenn_bySpecies_UpDown_", run_date, ".png")),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 11.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("PairwiseVenn_bySpecies_UpDown_", run_date, ".pdf")),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 11.5,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
# ================================================================
# Whole-background DrOrtholog mapping summary
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(viridisLite)
  library(UpSetR)
  library(scales)
})

# ---- paths ----
base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"
map_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "mapped_counts")
out_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "emapper_zf_one2one", "figs")

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- species order & palette ----
species_order <- c("ACE", "GEO", "COR", "GIB", "MAC")

pal <- viridisLite::plasma(length(species_order), direction = 1)
names(pal) <- species_order

# ---- load repaired DrOrtholog maps ----
load_dr_map <- function(sp) {
  path <- file.path(map_dir, paste0(sp, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv"))

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Missing repaired DrOrtholog map for ", sp, ": ", path)
  }

  readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      species = sp,
      key = as.character(key),
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(key), nzchar(key),
      !is.na(DrOrtholog), nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) |>
    distinct(species, key, DrOrtholog, picked_from)
}

maps_dr <- setNames(
  lapply(species_order, load_dr_map),
  species_order
)

# ---- load mapping summary generated by repaired Map_to_zf.R ----
summary_path <- file.path(map_dir, "mapping_counts_summary.tsv")

if (!file.exists(summary_path)) {
  stop("Missing mapping summary: ", summary_path, "\nRun source(file.path(base_dir, 'Map_to_zf.R')) first.")
}

mapping_summary <- readr::read_tsv(summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = species_order))

print(mapping_summary, n = Inf)

# ---- barplot: mapped count-table keys with unique DrOrthologs ----
summary_tbl <- mapping_summary |>
  mutate(
    frac_pct = 100 * mapped_keys / pmax(total_keys, 1)
  )

p_counts <- ggplot(summary_tbl, aes(x = species, y = mapped_keys, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(scales::comma(mapped_keys), " (", sprintf("%.1f", frac_pct), "%)")),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.09))) +
  labs(
    title = "Unique DrOrtholog mappings per species",
    subtitle = "Label = % of count-table keys with a unique DrOrtholog mapping",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mapped count-table keys"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

print(p_counts)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "bar_DrOrtholog_mapping_counts_with_percent.pdf"),
  p_counts,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 4.8,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

# ---- Build DrOrtholog presence matrix directly from repaired maps ----
all_dr <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(maps_dr, function(x) x$DrOrtholog))))

pm_dr <- tibble(DrOrtholog = all_dr)

for (sp in species_order) {
  sp_set <- unique(maps_dr[[sp]]$DrOrtholog)
  pm_dr[[sp]] <- as.integer(pm_dr$DrOrtholog %in% sp_set)
}

readr::write_tsv(
  pm_dr,
  file.path(map_dir, "presence_matrix_DrOrtholog.tsv")
)

# ---- UpSetR: background DrOrtholog intersections ----
pm_upset <- as.data.frame(pm_dr[, species_order, drop = FALSE])
pm_upset[species_order] <- lapply(pm_upset[species_order], function(x) as.integer(x == 1))

sets_bar_cols <- unname(pal[species_order])

UpSetR::upset(
  pm_upset,
  sets = species_order,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  nsets = length(species_order),
  nintersects = 40,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  order.by = "freq",
  main.bar.color = "grey35",
  sets.bar.color = sets_bar_cols,
  text.scale = 1.2,
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size (DrOrtholog)",
  sets.x.label = "Mapped genes per species"
)

pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "upset_DrOrtholog_background.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

UpSetR::upset(
  pm_upset,
  sets = species_order,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  nsets = length(species_order),
  nintersects = 40,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  order.by = "freq",
  main.bar.color = "grey35",
  sets.bar.color = sets_bar_cols,
  text.scale = 1.2,
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size (DrOrtholog)",
  sets.x.label = "Mapped genes per species"
)

dev.off()
```

## Overlap in DEGs within treatments
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Overlap in DEGs within treatments using repaired DrOrtholog maps
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(UpSetR)
  library(viridisLite)
})

# --- paths ---
base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"
map_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "mapped_counts")
out_dir  <- "edgeR_output/AllSpecies/FDR=0.05_L2FC=0"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- species order ---
species_order <- c("ACE", "GEO", "COR", "GIB", "MAC")

# --- required repaired map files ---
required_map_files <- file.path(
  map_dir,
  paste0(species_order, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv")
)

if (!all(file.exists(required_map_files))) {
  stop(
    "Missing repaired DrOrtholog maps:\n",
    paste(required_map_files[!file.exists(required_map_files)], collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nRun source(file.path(base_dir, 'Map_to_zf.R')) first."
  )
}

# --- helpers ---
norm_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

load_dr_map <- function(sp) {
  readr::read_tsv(
    file.path(map_dir, paste0(sp, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
    mutate(
      species = sp,
      key = as.character(key),
      key_norm = norm_key(key),
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(key), nzchar(key),
      !is.na(DrOrtholog), nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) |>
    distinct(species, key, key_norm, DrOrtholog, picked_from)
}

maps_dr <- setNames(
  lapply(species_order, load_dr_map),
  species_order
)

map_deg_vector_to_dr <- function(x, species) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]

  if (!length(x)) {
    return(list(
      set = character(),
      table = tibble(),
      stats = tibble(
        species = species,
        total = 0,
        mapped_input_genes = 0,
        mapped_drorthologs = 0,
        pct_input_mapped = 0
      )
    ))
  }

  df <- tibble(
    input_gene = unique(x),
    key_norm = norm_key(unique(x))
  ) |>
    inner_join(
      maps_dr[[species]] |> select(key_norm, DrOrtholog),
      by = "key_norm",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    distinct(input_gene, DrOrtholog)

  mapped_set <- unique(df$DrOrtholog)

  stats <- tibble(
    species = species,
    total = length(unique(x)),
    mapped_input_genes = n_distinct(df$input_gene),
    mapped_drorthologs = n_distinct(df$DrOrtholog),
    pct_input_mapped = round(100 * mapped_input_genes / max(total, 1), 1)
  )

  list(
    set = mapped_set,
    table = df,
    stats = stats
  )
}

# ---- guard: only proceed if DEG vectors exist ----
need_vars <- c(
  # Hypoxia
  "sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr_up", "sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr_down",
  "sig.Hypoxia_COR.fdr_up", "sig.Hypoxia_COR.fdr_down",
  "sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr_up", "sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr_down",
  "sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr_up", "sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr_down",

  # ILOS
  "sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr_up", "sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr_down",
  "sig.ILOS_COR.fdr_up", "sig.ILOS_COR.fdr_down",
  "sig.ILOS_GEO.fdr_up", "sig.ILOS_GEO.fdr_down",
  "sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr_up", "sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr_down",
  "sig.ILOS_GIB.fdr_up", "sig.ILOS_GIB.fdr_down"
)

missing_vars <- need_vars[!need_vars %in% ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)]

if (length(missing_vars)) {
  stop("DEG vectors not found. Missing: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

# ================================================================
# Build mapped DEG lists
# ================================================================

# Hypoxia: no GEO
mac_h <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr_up, sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr_down), "MAC")
cor_h <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.Hypoxia_COR.fdr_up, sig.Hypoxia_COR.fdr_down), "COR")
ace_h <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr_up, sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr_down), "ACE")
gib_h <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr_up, sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr_down), "GIB")

listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog <- list(
  MAC = mac_h$set,
  COR = cor_h$set,
  ACE = ace_h$set,
  GIB = gib_h$set
)

# ILOS: all five
mac_i <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr_up, sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr_down), "MAC")
cor_i <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.ILOS_COR.fdr_up, sig.ILOS_COR.fdr_down), "COR")
geo_i <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.ILOS_GEO.fdr_up, sig.ILOS_GEO.fdr_down), "GEO")
ace_i <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr_up, sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr_down), "ACE")
gib_i <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(c(sig.ILOS_GIB.fdr_up, sig.ILOS_GIB.fdr_down), "GIB")

listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog <- list(
  MAC = mac_i$set,
  COR = cor_i$set,
  GEO = geo_i$set,
  ACE = ace_i$set,
  GIB = gib_i$set
)

# Temporary aliases for older downstream code.
# These are DrOrtholog IDs, not validated zebrafish gene IDs.
listInput_Hypoxia_mapped <- listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog
listInput_ILOS_mapped    <- listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog

# ================================================================
# Diagnostics
# ================================================================

deg_mapping_stats_by_treatment <- bind_rows(
  mac_h$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "Hypoxia"),
  cor_h$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "Hypoxia"),
  ace_h$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "Hypoxia"),
  gib_h$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "Hypoxia"),

  mac_i$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "ILOS"),
  cor_i$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "ILOS"),
  geo_i$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "ILOS"),
  ace_i$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "ILOS"),
  gib_i$stats |> mutate(Treatment = "ILOS")
) |>
  relocate(Treatment, .after = species)

cat("\nHypoxia DrOrtholog set sizes:\n")
print(lengths(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog))

cat("\nILOS DrOrtholog set sizes:\n")
print(lengths(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog))

cat("\nDEG mapping diagnostics:\n")
print(deg_mapping_stats_by_treatment, n = Inf)

readr::write_tsv(
  deg_mapping_stats_by_treatment,
  file.path(map_dir, "deg_mapping_stats_by_treatment.tsv")
)

# ================================================================
# UpSetR plots
# ================================================================

pal_all <- viridisLite::plasma(length(species_order), direction = 1)
names(pal_all) <- species_order

# Hypoxia
sets_hyp <- intersect(species_order, names(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog))
cols_hyp <- unname(pal_all[sets_hyp])

pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_Hypoxia_AllDEGs_DrOrthologmapped.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

UpSetR::upset(
  UpSetR::fromList(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog),
  sets            = sets_hyp,
  keep.order      = TRUE,
  order.by        = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(Hypoxia, DrOrtholog)",
  sets.x.label    = "Mapped DEGs per Species",
  sets.bar.color  = cols_hyp,
  text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),
  nsets           = length(sets_hyp),
  nintersects     = 40
)

dev.off()

UpSetR::upset(
  UpSetR::fromList(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog),
  sets            = sets_hyp,
  keep.order      = TRUE,
  order.by        = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(Hypoxia, DrOrtholog)",
  sets.x.label    = "Mapped DEGs per Species",
  sets.bar.color  = cols_hyp,
  text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),
  nsets           = length(sets_hyp),
  nintersects     = 40
)

# ILOS
sets_ilos <- intersect(species_order, names(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog))
cols_ilos <- unname(pal_all[sets_ilos])

pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_ILOS_AllDEGs_DrOrthologmapped.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

UpSetR::upset(
  UpSetR::fromList(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog),

  mainbar.y.label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(ILOS, DrOrtholog)",

  sets.bar.color  = cols_ilos,
  text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),

dev.off()

UpSetR::upset(
```

## Overlap between MAC ILOS and ACE HYPOXIA
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Pairwise overlap: MAC ILOS ∩ ACE Hypoxia using DrOrtholog IDs
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(UpSetR)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(viridisLite)
})

stopifnot(
  exists("listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("maps_dr")
)

# ================================================================
# 1. Build pairwise overlap
# ================================================================

S_mac_i <- listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]]
S_ace_h <- listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]]

cat("# MAC ILOS DrOrtholog set size:", length(S_mac_i), "\n")
cat("# ACE Hypoxia DrOrtholog set size:", length(S_ace_h), "\n")

overlap_macI_aceH <- intersect(S_mac_i, S_ace_h)

cat("# Overlap MAC ILOS ∩ ACE Hypoxia:", length(overlap_macI_aceH), "\n")

# ================================================================
# 2. Export overlap table with MAC and ACE keys
# ================================================================

ov_tab <- tibble(DrOrtholog = overlap_macI_aceH) |>
  left_join(
    maps_dr[["MAC"]] |>
      select(DrOrtholog, key) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "DrOrtholog",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  rename(MAC_key = key) |>
  left_join(
    maps_dr[["ACE"]] |>
      select(DrOrtholog, key) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "DrOrtholog",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  rename(ACE_key = key) |>
  arrange(DrOrtholog, MAC_key, ACE_key)

readr::write_tsv(
  ov_tab,
  "MAC_ILOS__ACE_Hypoxia_overlap_DrOrtholog.tsv"
)

cat("Saved: MAC_ILOS__ACE_Hypoxia_overlap_DrOrtholog.tsv\n")

# ================================================================
# 3. Venn diagram
# ================================================================

if (!requireNamespace("eulerr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("eulerr", quiet = TRUE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(eulerr))

fit <- eulerr::euler(
  c(
    "MAC_ILOS" = length(S_mac_i),
    "ACE_Hypoxia" = length(S_ace_h),
    "MAC_ILOS&ACE_Hypoxia" = length(overlap_macI_aceH)
  ),
  shape = "ellipse"
)

p_venn <- plot(
  fit,
  quantities = TRUE,
  labels = list(font = 2),
  fills = list(fill = c("#4575B4", "#D73027"), alpha = 0.35),
  edges = list(col = "grey30")
)

p_venn

ggsave(
  "Venn_MAC_ILOS__ACE_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog.pdf",
  p_venn,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4.2,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  "Venn_MAC_ILOS__ACE_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog.png",
  p_venn,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4.2,
  dpi = 300
)

# ================================================================
# 4. UpSet: MAC ILOS vs species Hypoxia sets
# ================================================================

sets_list <- list(
  MAC_ILOS = listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]],
  ACE_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]],
  COR_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["COR"]],
  GIB_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["GIB"]]
)

cat("\nSet sizes:\n")
print(lengths(sets_list))

sets_order <- c("ACE_Hypoxia", "COR_Hypoxia", "GIB_Hypoxia", "MAC_ILOS")

pal <- viridisLite::viridis(length(sets_order), direction = 1)
names(pal) <- sets_order
cols <- unname(pal[sets_order])

df_up <- UpSetR::fromList(sets_list)

UpSetR::upset(
  df_up,
  sets            = sets_order,
  keep.order      = TRUE,
  order.by        = "freq",
  nsets           = length(sets_order),
  nintersects     = 40,
  mb.ratio        = c(0.6, 0.4),
  main.bar.color  = "black",
  sets.bar.color  = cols,
  text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),
  mainbar.y.label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(MAC ILOS vs Hypoxia)",
  sets.x.label    = "Mapped DEGs per set"
)

pdf(
  "UpSet_MAC_ILOS_vs_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

UpSetR::upset(
  df_up,
  sets            = sets_order,
  keep.order      = TRUE,
  order.by        = "freq",
  nsets           = length(sets_order),
  nintersects     = 40,
  mb.ratio        = c(0.6, 0.4),
  main.bar.color  = "black",
  sets.bar.color  = cols,
  text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size (DrOrtholog)",
  sets.x.label    = "Mapped DEGs per set"
)

dev.off()
```

### New Fig. X - Overlap Across Species for DEG sets 
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Cross-species DEG overlap by treatment category
# Restricted to repaired 1:1 zebrafish DrOrtholog mappings
#
# Categories:
#   1. ILOP-unique DEGs      = ILOS DEGs not shared with Hypoxia within species
#   2. Hypoxia-unique DEGs   = Hypoxia DEGs not shared with ILOS within species
#   3. Shared DEGs           = ILOS ∩ Hypoxia within species
#
# Internal object names still use ILOS because your upstream objects use ILOS.
# Display/output labels use ILOP.
# ================================================================

norm_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

  )

load_dr_map <- function(sp) {
  readr::read_tsv(
    file.path(map_dir, paste0(sp, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
    mutate(
      species = sp,

      key_norm = norm_key(key),
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(key), nzchar(key),

    ) |>

}

# ================================================================
# 2. DEG extraction helpers
# ================================================================

clean_ids <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  unique(x)
}

extract_ids_from_object <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  if (is.atomic(obj) && !is.data.frame(obj)) {
    return(clean_ids(obj))
  }

  if (is.data.frame(obj) || tibble::is_tibble(obj)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(obj)

    ids <- if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
      df$Gene
    } else if ("gene" %in% names(df)) {
      df$gene
    } else if ("GeneID" %in% names(df)) {
      df$GeneID
    } else if ("gene_id" %in% names(df)) {
      df$gene_id
    } else {
      rownames(df)
    }

    return(clean_ids(ids))
  }

  clean_ids(obj)
}

get_deg_ids_any <- function(spec,
                            treatment = c("ILOS", "Hypoxia")) {
  treatment <- match.arg(treatment)

  full_nm <- paste0("sig.", treatment, "_", spec, ".fdr")

  up_nm <- paste0("sig.", treatment, "_", spec, ".fdr_up")
  dn_nm <- paste0("sig.", treatment, "_", spec, ".fdr_down")

  # Prefer full significant-DEG table if available.
  if (exists(full_nm, inherits = TRUE)) {
    obj <- get(full_nm, inherits = TRUE)

    if (is.data.frame(obj) || tibble::is_tibble(obj)) {
      df <- as.data.frame(obj)

      if ("logFC" %in% names(df)) {
        df <- df |>
          filter(!is.na(logFC), is.finite(logFC))
      }

      ids <- extract_ids_from_object(df)

      return(list(
        ids = ids,
        source = full_nm,
        status = if (length(ids)) "full_table" else "full_table_empty"
      ))
    }

    ids <- extract_ids_from_object(obj)

    return(list(
      ids = ids,
      source = full_nm,
      status = if (length(ids)) "full_object" else "full_object_empty"
    ))
  }

  # Fallback to up/down vectors.
  ids_up <- if (exists(up_nm, inherits = TRUE)) {
    extract_ids_from_object(get(up_nm, inherits = TRUE))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }

  ids_dn <- if (exists(dn_nm, inherits = TRUE)) {
    extract_ids_from_object(get(dn_nm, inherits = TRUE))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }

  ids <- clean_ids(c(ids_up, ids_dn))

  list(
    ids = ids,
    source = paste(c(up_nm, dn_nm), collapse = " + "),
    status = if (length(ids)) "up_down_vectors" else "missing_or_empty"
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Map DEG vectors to repaired DrOrtholog IDs
# ================================================================

map_deg_vector_to_dr <- function(x, species, treatment_label) {
  x <- clean_ids(x)

  if (!length(x)) {
    return(list(
      set = character(),
      table = tibble(),
      stats = tibble(
        species = species,
        treatment = treatment_label,
        input_genes = 0L,
        mapped_input_genes = 0L,
        mapped_DrOrthologs = 0L,
        pct_input_mapped = 0
      )
    ))
  }

  df <- tibble(
    input_gene = unique(x),
    key_norm = norm_key(unique(x))
  ) |>
    inner_join(
      maps_dr[[species]] |>
        select(key_norm, DrOrtholog),
      by = "key_norm",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    distinct(input_gene, DrOrtholog)

  mapped_set <- unique(df$DrOrtholog)

  stats <- tibble(
    species = species,
    treatment = treatment_label,
    input_genes = length(unique(x)),
    mapped_input_genes = n_distinct(df$input_gene),
    mapped_DrOrthologs = n_distinct(df$DrOrtholog),
    pct_input_mapped = round(100 * mapped_input_genes / max(input_genes, 1), 1)
  )

  list(
    set = mapped_set,
    table = df,
    stats = stats
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 4. Build treatment-level DrOrtholog DEG sets by species
# ================================================================

build_species_treatment_sets <- function(sp) {
  ilos_obj <- get_deg_ids_any(sp, "ILOS")
  hyp_obj  <- get_deg_ids_any(sp, "Hypoxia")

  ilos_map <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(
    x = ilos_obj$ids,
    species = sp,
    treatment_label = "ILOS"
  )

  hyp_map <- map_deg_vector_to_dr(
    x = hyp_obj$ids,
    species = sp,
    treatment_label = "Hypoxia"
  )

  ilos_set <- unique(ilos_map$set)
  hyp_set  <- unique(hyp_map$set)

  shared_set <- intersect(ilos_set, hyp_set)

  ilop_unique_set <- setdiff(ilos_set, shared_set)
  hyp_unique_set  <- setdiff(hyp_set, shared_set)

  list(
    species = sp,

    source_info = tibble(
      species = sp,
      ILOS_source = ilos_obj$source,
      ILOS_status = ilos_obj$status,
      Hypoxia_source = hyp_obj$source,
      Hypoxia_status = hyp_obj$status
    ),

    treatment_stats = bind_rows(
      ilos_map$stats,
      hyp_map$stats
    ),

    mapped_tables = list(
      ILOS = ilos_map$table,
      Hypoxia = hyp_map$table
    ),

    sets = list(
      ILOS_all = ilos_set,
      Hypoxia_all = hyp_set,
      ILOP_unique = ilop_unique_set,
      Hypoxia_unique = hyp_unique_set,
      Shared_ILOP_Hypoxia = shared_set
    ),

    category_counts = tibble(
      species = sp,
      ILOS_all_DrOrthologs = length(ilos_set),
      Hypoxia_all_DrOrthologs = length(hyp_set),
      ILOP_unique_DrOrthologs = length(ilop_unique_set),
      Hypoxia_unique_DrOrthologs = length(hyp_unique_set),
      Shared_ILOP_Hypoxia_DrOrthologs = length(shared_set)
    )
  )
}

species_treatment_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(species_order, build_species_treatment_sets),
  species_order
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)

overlap_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "Venn_intersection_gene_lists")
dir.create(overlap_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Cleaner output order
species_for_intersections <- c("MAC", "ACE", "GIB", "COR", "GEO")

# ------------------------------------------------
# Function: exact Venn regions
# ------------------------------------------------
get_exact_intersections <- function(sets_list, category_name) {
  
  sets_list <- sets_list[intersect(species_for_intersections, names(sets_list))]
  sets_list <- sets_list[lengths(sets_list) > 0]
  
  if (length(sets_list) < 2) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  all_genes <- sort(unique(unlist(sets_list)))
  species_present <- names(sets_list)
  
  membership <- tibble(DrOrtholog = all_genes)
  
  for (sp in species_present) {
    membership[[sp]] <- membership$DrOrtholog %in% sets_list[[sp]]
  }
  
  map_dfr(2:length(species_present), function(k) {
    
    combn(species_present, k, simplify = FALSE) |>
      map_dfr(function(combo) {
        
        others <- setdiff(species_present, combo)
        
        in_combo <- rowSums(membership[, combo, drop = FALSE]) == length(combo)
        
        not_in_others <- if (length(others) > 0) {
          rowSums(membership[, others, drop = FALSE]) == 0
        } else {
          rep(TRUE, nrow(membership))
        }
        
        genes <- membership$DrOrtholog[in_combo & not_in_others]
        
        if (length(genes) == 0) {
          return(tibble())
        }
        
        tibble(
          category = category_name,
          comparison = paste(combo, collapse = "_"),
          comparison_label = paste(combo, collapse = " ∩ "),
          DrOrtholog = genes
        )
      })
  })
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Build exact intersection table
# ------------------------------------------------
venn_intersection_gene_lists <- imap_dfr(
  category_sets,
  get_exact_intersections
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# Add zebrafish gene symbols
# ------------------------------------------------
zf_symbol_lookup <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Dr.eg.db,
  keys = unique(venn_intersection_gene_lists$DrOrtholog),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME", "ENTREZID")
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(
    DrOrtholog = ENSEMBL,
    zf_symbol = SYMBOL,
    zf_gene_name = GENENAME,
    zf_entrez = ENTREZID
  ) |>
  distinct(DrOrtholog, .keep_all = TRUE)

venn_intersection_gene_lists <- venn_intersection_gene_lists |>
  left_join(zf_symbol_lookup, by = "DrOrtholog") |>
  relocate(zf_symbol, zf_gene_name, zf_entrez, .after = DrOrtholog) |>
  arrange(category, comparison, zf_symbol, DrOrtholog)

# ------------------------------------------------
# Summary table to check against Venn labels
# ------------------------------------------------
venn_intersection_summary <- venn_intersection_gene_lists |>
  count(category, comparison, comparison_label, name = "n_genes") |>
  arrange(category, desc(n_genes))

print(venn_intersection_summary, n = Inf)

venn_intersection_gene_lists |>

# ================================================================
# 7. Plot helpers: combined files for all categories
#
# Replaces previous Sections 7–9.
#
# Outputs:
#   1. One multipage PDF for all UpSet plots
#   2. One stacked PNG for all UpSet plots
#   3. One multipage PDF for all Venn/Euler plots
#   4. One stacked PNG for all Venn/Euler plots
#
# Important fix:
#   UpSetR and eulerr plot objects are explicitly printed/drawn
#   inside graphics devices, avoiding blank saved files.
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(grid)
  library(UpSetR)
  library(eulerr)
})

MAKE_COMBINED_PNG <- requireNamespace("magick", quietly = TRUE)

if (!MAKE_COMBINED_PNG) {
  message(
    "\nPackage 'magick' is not installed, so combined stacked PNGs will be skipped.\n",
    "The combined multipage PDFs will still be created.\n",
    "To enable stacked PNGs, run: install.packages('magick')\n"
  )
}

# Keep this TRUE if you do not want empty species like GEO shown in the plots.
DROP_EMPTY_SETS_FOR_PLOTS <- TRUE

active_species_sets <- function(sets_list) {
  sets_list <- sets_list[intersect(species_order, names(sets_list))]

  if (DROP_EMPTY_SETS_FOR_PLOTS) {
    sets_list <- sets_list[lengths(sets_list) > 0]
  }

  sets_list
}

draw_skip_page <- function(category_label, reason) {
  grid::grid.newpage()

  grid::grid.text(
    category_label,
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.62,
    gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 22,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = "black"
    )
  )

  grid::grid.text(
    paste("Skipped:", reason),
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.48,
    gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 15,
      col = "black"
    )
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 7A. UpSet plotting page
# ================================================================

draw_upset_page <- function(sets_list,
                            category_name,
                            category_label) {

  sets_active <- active_species_sets(sets_list)

  if (length(sets_active) < 2) {
    draw_skip_page(
      category_label,
      "fewer than two non-empty species sets"
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sets_order <- intersect(species_order, names(sets_active))
  sets_active <- sets_active[sets_order]

  cols <- unname(pal_all[sets_order])
  df_up <- UpSetR::fromList(sets_active)

  grid::grid.newpage()

  p <- UpSetR::upset(
    df_up,
    sets            = sets_order,
    keep.order      = TRUE,
    order.by        = "freq",
    nsets           = length(sets_order),
    nintersects     = 40,
    mb.ratio        = c(0.62, 0.38),
    main.bar.color  = "grey25",
    sets.bar.color  = cols,
    text.scale      = c(2.0, 2.0, 1.55, 1.55, 1.8, 1.8),
    mainbar.y.label = paste0(
      category_label,
      "\n# of Shared DEGs"
      ),
    sets.x.label    = "Mapped DEGs per species"
  )

  # Critical when drawing inside functions/devices.
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
  }

  invisible(df_up)
}

# ================================================================
# 7B. Venn/Euler plotting page
#
# Strategy:
#   - Fit eulerr using readability-compressed region sizes.
#   - Preserve true displayed region counts.
#   - Avoid NA names in fit$original.values.
# ================================================================

all_region_names_for_sets <- function(set_cols) {
  unlist(
    lapply(seq_along(set_cols), function(k) {
      combn(
        set_cols,
        k,
        FUN = function(z) paste(z, collapse = "&"),
        simplify = TRUE
      )
    }),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
}

exact_region_counts_for_euler <- function(sets_active) {
  set_cols <- names(sets_active)
  all_combos <- all_region_names_for_sets(set_cols)

  all_ids <- sort(unique(unlist(sets_active)))

  if (!length(all_ids)) {
    vals <- rep(0, length(all_combos))
    names(vals) <- all_combos
    return(vals)
  }

  pm <- tibble(DrOrtholog = all_ids)

  for (sp in set_cols) {
    pm[[sp]] <- as.integer(pm$DrOrtholog %in% sets_active[[sp]])
  }

  combo_counts <- pm |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      combo = paste(set_cols[as.logical(c_across(all_of(set_cols)))], collapse = "&")
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(nzchar(combo)) |>
    count(combo, name = "n")

  out <- tibble(combo = all_combos) |>
    left_join(combo_counts, by = "combo") |>
    mutate(n = tidyr::replace_na(n, 0L))

  vals <- out$n
  names(vals) <- out$combo
  vals
}

compress_region_counts_for_layout <- function(true_counts,
                                              exponent = 0.72,
                                              min_size = 18) {
  layout_counts <- true_counts

  positive <- layout_counts > 0

  layout_counts[positive] <- pmax(
    min_size,
    round(layout_counts[positive] ^ exponent)
  )

  layout_counts[!positive] <- 0

  layout_counts <- as.numeric(layout_counts)
  names(layout_counts) <- names(true_counts)

  layout_counts
}

restore_true_original_values <- function(fit, true_counts) {
  if (!"original.values" %in% names(fit)) {
    return(fit)
  }

  fit_names <- names(fit$original.values)

  if (is.null(fit_names)) {
    return(fit)
  }

  restored <- rep(0, length(fit_names))

  # Preserve eulerr's names, but repair missing/blank names so plot()
  # does not fail with "row names contain missing values".
  safe_names <- fit_names
  bad_names <- is.na(safe_names) | !nzchar(safe_names)

  if (any(bad_names)) {
    safe_names[bad_names] <- paste0("unnamed_region_", seq_len(sum(bad_names)))
  }

  names(restored) <- safe_names

  ok_names <- !bad_names
  idx <- match(fit_names[ok_names], names(true_counts))
  hits <- !is.na(idx)

  restored[which(ok_names)[hits]] <- unname(true_counts[idx[hits]])

  fit$original.values <- restored

  fit
}

draw_venn_page <- function(sets_list,
                           category_name,
                           category_label) {

  sets_active <- active_species_sets(sets_list)

  if (length(sets_active) < 2) {
    draw_skip_page(
      category_label,
      "fewer than two non-empty species sets"
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sets_order <- intersect(species_order, names(sets_active))
  sets_active <- sets_active[sets_order]

  true_counts <- exact_region_counts_for_euler(sets_active)

  layout_counts <- compress_region_counts_for_layout(
    true_counts,
    exponent = 0.72,  # lower = more compression of huge regions
    min_size = 18     # higher = tiny true regions become more visible
  )

  fit <- tryCatch(
    eulerr::euler(layout_counts, shape = "ellipse"),
    error = function(e) {
      draw_skip_page(
        category_label,
        paste("eulerr fitting failed:", conditionMessage(e))
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Geometry uses compressed layout counts.
  # Displayed labels use true region counts.
  fit <- restore_true_original_values(
    fit = fit,
    true_counts = true_counts
  )

  fill_cols <- unname(pal_all[names(sets_active)])

  grid::grid.newpage()

  venn_grob <- plot(
    fit,
    quantities = list(
      cex = 1.55,
      font = 2,
      col = "black"
    ),
    labels = list(
      labels = names(sets_active),
      font = 2,
      cex = 1.60,
      col = "black"
    ),
    fills = list(
      fill = fill_cols,
      alpha = 0.42
    ),
    edges = list(
      col = "grey25",
      lwd = 1.35
    )
  )

  if (
    inherits(venn_grob, "grob") ||
      inherits(venn_grob, "gTree") ||
      inherits(venn_grob, "gList") ||
      inherits(venn_grob, "eulergram")
  ) {
    grid::grid.draw(venn_grob)
  }

  grid::grid.text(
    category_label,
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.965,
    gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 26,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = "black"
    )
  )

  invisible(list(
    fit = fit,
    true_counts = true_counts,
    layout_counts = layout_counts
  ))
}

# ================================================================
# 7C. Save combined multipage PDFs
# ================================================================

save_multipage_pdf <- function(file,
                               draw_fun,
                               width,
                               height) {

  grDevices::pdf(
    file,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    onefile = TRUE,
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  purrr::iwalk(category_sets, function(sets_list, category_name) {
    draw_fun(
      sets_list = sets_list,
      category_name = category_name,
      category_label = category_labels[[category_name]]
    )
  })

  invisible(file)
}

# ================================================================
# 7D. Save stacked PNGs using temporary per-category pages
# ================================================================

save_stacked_png <- function(file,
                             draw_fun,
                             width,
                             height,
                             dpi = 450,
                             prefix = "tmp_plot") {

  if (!MAKE_COMBINED_PNG) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  tmp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0(prefix, "_", run_date))
  dir.create(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  tmp_files <- purrr::imap_chr(category_sets, function(sets_list, category_name) {
    tmp_file <- file.path(
      tmp_dir,
      paste0(prefix, "_", category_name, ".png")
    )

    grDevices::png(
      tmp_file,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = "in",
      res = dpi,
      bg = "white"
    )

    draw_fun(
      sets_list = sets_list,
      category_name = category_name,
      category_label = category_labels[[category_name]]
    )

    grDevices::dev.off()

    tmp_file
  })

  imgs <- magick::image_read(tmp_files)

  combined <- magick::image_append(
    imgs,
    stack = TRUE
  )

  magick::image_write(
    combined,
    path = file,
    format = "png"
  )

  unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

  invisible(file)
}
```
