# GO Term Visualizations

The three overlap GO analyses below use the repaired DrOrtholog overlap framework. 
For functional annotation, each shared DrOrtholog set is projected into the MAC key/symbol 
namespace and then mapped directly to zebrafish Entrez IDs. This avoids treating DrOrtholog IDs as validated ENSDARG or Entrez IDs.

```{r overlap_go_term_visualizations_drortholog}
# ================================================================
# GO Term Visualizations
# Repaired DrOrtholog overlap -> MAC key -> zebrafish ENSDARG -> g:Profiler GO:BP
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)
  library(gprofiler2)
  library(rrvgo)
  library(ggplotify)
})

# ================================================================
# 0. Required objects and paths
# ================================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("keep_counts_MAC")
)

base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"
map_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "mapped_counts")
out_dir  <- file.path("edgeR_output", "overlap_GO")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

species_order <- c("ACE", "GEO", "COR", "GIB", "MAC")

norm_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x)))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}

print_if_not_null <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x)) print(x)
  invisible(x)
}

# Reload repaired DrOrtholog maps if needed
if (!exists("maps_dr")) {
  load_dr_map <- function(sp) {
    path <- file.path(map_dir, paste0(sp, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv"))

    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      stop("Missing repaired DrOrtholog map for ", sp, ": ", path)
    }

    readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      mutate(
        species = sp,
        key = as.character(key),
        key_norm = norm_key(key),
        DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
        picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
      ) |>
      filter(
        !is.na(key), nzchar(key),
        !is.na(DrOrtholog), nzchar(DrOrtholog)
      ) |>
      distinct(species, key, key_norm, DrOrtholog, picked_from)
  }

  maps_dr <- setNames(
    lapply(species_order, load_dr_map),
    species_order
  )
}

stopifnot("MAC" %in% names(maps_dr))

# ================================================================
# 1. Map MAC keys/symbols to zebrafish g:Profiler IDs
# ================================================================

map_symbol_keys_to_gprofiler_ids <- function(keys, label = "query") {
  keys <- clean_set(keys)

  if (!length(keys)) {
    return(tibble(
      input_key = character(),
      SYMBOL = character(),
      ENTREZID = character(),
      ENSDARG = character()
    ))
  }

  candidate_symbols <- clean_set(c(
    keys,
    tolower(keys),
    toupper(keys)
  ))

  valid_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dr.eg.db, keytype = "SYMBOL")
  query_symbols <- intersect(candidate_symbols, valid_symbols)

  if (!length(query_symbols)) {
    message("[", label, "] no valid zebrafish symbols found.")
    return(tibble(
      input_key = character(),
      SYMBOL = character(),
      ENTREZID = character(),
      ENSDARG = character()
    ))
  }

  sym_lookup <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Dr.eg.db,
      keys = query_symbols,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", "ENSEMBL")
    )
  ) |>
    transmute(
      SYMBOL = as.character(SYMBOL),
      ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID),
      ENSDARG = as.character(ENSEMBL),
      symbol_norm = tolower(SYMBOL)
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG)
    ) |>
    distinct(symbol_norm, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE)

  out <- tibble(
    input_key = keys,
    symbol_norm = tolower(keys)
  ) |>
    left_join(sym_lookup, by = "symbol_norm", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    filter(!is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG)) |>
    distinct(input_key, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(input_key, SYMBOL, ENTREZID, ENSDARG)

  message(
    "[", label, "] ",
    length(keys), " input keys -> ",
    dplyr::n_distinct(out$ENSDARG), " zebrafish Ensembl gene IDs"
  )

  out
}

get_mac_keys_for_drorthologs <- function(dr_ids) {
  dr_ids <- clean_set(dr_ids)

  if (!length(dr_ids)) {
    return(tibble(
      DrOrtholog = character(),
      MAC_key = character()
    ))
  }

  maps_dr[["MAC"]] |>
    filter(DrOrtholog %in% dr_ids) |>
    transmute(
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      MAC_key = as.character(key)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(MAC_key), nzchar(MAC_key)) |>
    distinct()
}

# ================================================================
# 2. GO:BP enrichment helper using g:Profiler
# ================================================================

run_overlap_go_bp_drortholog <- function(overlap_drortholog,
                                         comparison,
                                         title_txt,
                                         out_stub,
                                         background_keys,
                                         out_dir = file.path("edgeR_output", "overlap_GO"),
                                         topN = 100,
                                         fdr = 0.10,
                                         min_query_gprof = 10,
                                         sim_method = "Rel") {

  overlap_drortholog <- clean_set(overlap_drortholog)
  background_keys <- clean_set(background_keys)

  empty <- list(
    comparison = comparison,
    overlap_drortholog = overlap_drortholog,
    mac_key_table = tibble(),
    query_map = tibble(),
    background_map = tibble(),
    query_gprof = character(),
    bg_gprof = character(),
    query_entrez = character(),
    bg_entrez = character(),
    gost = NULL,
    bp_res = list(bp = NULL, scores = NULL, source = "none", full_bp = NULL),
    plot = NULL,
    status = "empty_or_failed"
  )

  if (!length(overlap_drortholog)) {
    message("[", comparison, "] no overlap DrOrtholog IDs.")
    empty$status <- "no_overlap_drortholog"
    return(empty)
  }

  mac_key_table <- get_mac_keys_for_drorthologs(overlap_drortholog)

  if (!nrow(mac_key_table)) {
    message("[", comparison, "] no MAC keys recovered for overlap DrOrtholog IDs.")
    empty$status <- "no_mac_keys"
    return(empty)
  }

  query_map <- map_symbol_keys_to_gprofiler_ids(
    mac_key_table$MAC_key,
    label = paste0(comparison, " overlap MAC keys")
  )

  background_map <- map_symbol_keys_to_gprofiler_ids(
    background_keys,
    label = paste0(comparison, " MAC DrOrtholog-tested background")
  )

  query_gprof <- clean_set(query_map$ENSDARG)
  bg_gprof <- clean_set(background_map$ENSDARG)

  # Keep query in the universe because query genes came from tested genes.
  bg_gprof <- clean_set(c(bg_gprof, query_gprof))

  cat(
    "\n[", comparison, "] g:Profiler input check\n",
    "  overlap DrOrtholog n = ", length(overlap_drortholog), "\n",
    "  MAC keys n           = ", dplyr::n_distinct(mac_key_table$MAC_key), "\n",
    "  query ENSDARG n      = ", length(query_gprof), "\n",
    "  background ENSDARG n = ", length(bg_gprof), "\n",
    "  query examples       = ", paste(head(query_gprof, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (length(query_gprof) < min_query_gprof) {
    message(
      "[", comparison, "] only ", length(query_gprof),
      " query g:Profiler IDs; skipping GO enrichment."
    )

    empty$mac_key_table <- mac_key_table
    empty$query_map <- query_map
    empty$background_map <- background_map
    empty$query_gprof <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_gprof <- bg_gprof
    empty$query_entrez <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_entrez <- bg_gprof
    empty$status <- "too_few_query_gprof_ids"

    return(empty)
  }

  gostres <- try(
    gprofiler2::gost(
      query = query_gprof,
      organism = "drerio",
      sources = "GO:BP",
      correction_method = "g_SCS",
      significant = FALSE,
      user_threshold = fdr,
      custom_bg = bg_gprof,
      domain_scope = "custom"
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(gostres, "try-error") || is.null(gostres$result)) {
    message("[", comparison, "] g:Profiler returned no result table.")

    empty$mac_key_table <- mac_key_table
    empty$query_map <- query_map
    empty$background_map <- background_map
    empty$query_gprof <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_gprof <- bg_gprof
    empty$query_entrez <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_entrez <- bg_gprof
    empty$gost <- gostres
    empty$status <- "no_gprofiler_result"

    return(empty)
  }

  bp_all <- as_tibble(gostres$result)

  if (!nrow(bp_all)) {
    message("[", comparison, "] GO result table had zero rows.")

    empty$mac_key_table <- mac_key_table
    empty$query_map <- query_map
    empty$background_map <- background_map
    empty$query_gprof <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_gprof <- bg_gprof
    empty$query_entrez <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_entrez <- bg_gprof
    empty$gost <- gostres
    empty$status <- "zero_go_rows"

    return(empty)
  }

  bp_all <- bp_all |>
    filter(source == "GO:BP") |>
    arrange(p_value)

  if (!nrow(bp_all)) {
    message("[", comparison, "] g:Profiler returned results, but no GO:BP rows.")

    empty$mac_key_table <- mac_key_table
    empty$query_map <- query_map
    empty$background_map <- background_map
    empty$query_gprof <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_gprof <- bg_gprof
    empty$query_entrez <- query_gprof
    empty$bg_entrez <- bg_gprof
    empty$gost <- gostres
    empty$status <- "no_GO_BP_rows"

    return(empty)
  }

 bp_for_rrvgo <- bp_all |>
  filter(!is.na(term_id), nzchar(term_id)) |>
  slice_head(n = topN)

  readr::write_csv(
    bp_all,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_full_GO_BP_results_gProfiler.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    bp_for_rrvgo,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_top", topN, "_GO_BP_results_gProfiler.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    mac_key_table,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_DrOrtholog_to_MAC_key_map.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    query_map,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_MAC_key_to_gProfiler_query_map.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    background_map,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_MAC_background_to_gProfiler_map.csv"))
  )

  if (!nrow(bp_for_rrvgo)) {
    plot_obj <- NULL
    scores <- NULL
    source_txt <- "gprofiler_GO_BP_no_terms_after_filter"
  } else {
    p_for_score <- pmax(as.numeric(bp_for_rrvgo$p_value), .Machine$double.xmin)

    scores <- -log10(p_for_score)
    names(scores) <- bp_for_rrvgo$term_id

    plot_obj <- tryCatch({
  sim <- rrvgo::calculateSimMatrix(
    bp_for_rrvgo$term_id,
    orgdb = "org.Dr.eg.db",
    ont = "BP",
    method = sim_method
  )

  red <- rrvgo::reduceSimMatrix(
    simMatrix = sim,
    scores = scores,
    threshold = 0.7,
    orgdb = "org.Dr.eg.db"
  )

  red_df <- as.data.frame(red)

  ggplotify::as.ggplot(function() {
    rrvgo::treemapPlot(
      reducedTerms = red_df,
      size = "score",
      title = title_txt
    )
  })
}, error = function(e) {
  message("[", comparison, "] rrvgo plot failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  NULL
})
    
    source_txt <- "gprofiler_GO_BP_top100_by_pvalue"
  }

  list(
    comparison = comparison,
    overlap_drortholog = overlap_drortholog,
    mac_key_table = mac_key_table,
    query_map = query_map,
    background_map = background_map,
    query_gprof = query_gprof,
    bg_gprof = bg_gprof,
    query_entrez = query_gprof,  # compatibility with older summary code
    bg_entrez = bg_gprof,        # compatibility with older summary code
    gost = gostres,
    bp_res = list(
      bp = bp_for_rrvgo,
      scores = scores,
      source = source_txt,
      full_bp = bp_all
    ),
    plot = plot_obj,
    status = "ok"
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Define overlap sets
# ================================================================

overlap_sets <- list(
  hyp = intersect(
    clean_set(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]]),
    clean_set(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]])
  ),

  ilos = intersect(
    clean_set(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]]),
    clean_set(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]])
  ),

  pair = intersect(
    clean_set(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]]),
    clean_set(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]])
  )
)

overlap_titles <- c(
  hyp = "ACE ∩ MAC (Hypoxia) — GO:BP (Top 100)",
  ilos = "ACE ∩ MAC (ILOS) — GO:BP (Top 100)",
  pair = "MAC ILOS ∩ ACE Hypoxia — GO:BP (Top 100)"
)

overlap_stubs <- c(
  hyp = "ACE_MAC_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog_GO_BP_top100",
  ilos = "ACE_MAC_ILOS_DrOrtholog_GO_BP_top100",
  pair = "MAC_ILOS_ACE_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog_GO_BP_top100"
)

# ================================================================
# 4. MAC background for overlap GO
# Tested MAC genes restricted to genes with unique repaired DrOrtholog maps
# ================================================================

mac_drortholog_background_keys <- intersect(
  rownames(keep_counts_MAC),
  maps_dr[["MAC"]]$key
)

cat(
  "\nMAC overlap-GO background:\n",
  "  tested MAC genes: ", length(rownames(keep_counts_MAC)), "\n",
  "  unique DrOrtholog-mapped MAC keys: ", length(unique(maps_dr[["MAC"]]$key)), "\n",
  "  tested + DrOrtholog-mapped MAC background: ", length(mac_drortholog_background_keys), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

# ================================================================
# 5. Run GO enrichment
# ================================================================

overlap_go_results <- lapply(names(overlap_sets), function(nm) {
  run_overlap_go_bp_drortholog(
    overlap_drortholog = overlap_sets[[nm]],
    comparison = nm,
    title_txt = overlap_titles[[nm]],
    out_stub = overlap_stubs[[nm]],
    background_keys = mac_drortholog_background_keys,
    out_dir = out_dir,
    topN = 100,
    fdr = 0.10,
    min_query_gprof = 10,
    sim_method = "Rel"
  )
})

names(overlap_go_results) <- names(overlap_sets)

res_hyp  <- overlap_go_results$hyp$bp_res
res_ilos <- overlap_go_results$ilos$bp_res
res_pair <- overlap_go_results$pair$bp_res

p_hyp  <- overlap_go_results$hyp$plot
p_ilos <- overlap_go_results$ilos$plot
p_pair <- overlap_go_results$pair$plot

# ================================================================
# 6. Diagnostics
# ================================================================

overlap_go_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(overlap_go_results), function(nm) {
  obj <- overlap_go_results[[nm]]

  tibble::tibble(
    comparison = nm,
    status = obj$status,
    n_overlap_drortholog = length(obj$overlap_drortholog),
    n_mac_keys_recovered = dplyr::n_distinct(obj$mac_key_table$MAC_key),
    n_query_gprof_ids = length(obj$query_gprof),
    n_background_gprof_ids = length(obj$bg_gprof),
    n_bp_terms_top100 = if (is.null(obj$bp_res$bp)) 0L else nrow(obj$bp_res$bp),
    n_bp_terms_total = if (is.null(obj$bp_res$full_bp)) 0L else nrow(obj$bp_res$full_bp),
    n_bp_terms_fdr_0.10 = if (is.null(obj$bp_res$full_bp)) {
      0L
    } else {
      sum(obj$bp_res$full_bp$significant %in% TRUE |
            obj$bp_res$full_bp$p_value <= 0.10,
          na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    source = obj$bp_res$source
  )
}))

cat("\n=== Overlap GO:BP diagnostics ===\n")
print(overlap_go_summary, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  overlap_go_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "overlap_GO_BP_DrOrtholog_summary.csv")
)

```


## Panel Plot: Upsets + Treemaps
```{r panel_upsets_treemaps_drortholog_FIXED2, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ================================================================
# Panel Plot: UpSets + GO:BP Treemaps
# FIXED:
#   1. UpSetR output is explicitly captured/drawn into PNG.
#   2. rrvgo uses the existing top-100 GO terms directly.
#   3. rrvgo threshold is increased to 0.90 to reduce less, not more.
#   4. No extra intersection_size / term_size filtering is applied here.
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(UpSetR)
  library(rrvgo)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)
  library(magick)
  library(viridisLite)
  library(tibble)
  library(grid)
  library(dplyr)
})

dir.create("panel_out", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

stopifnot(
  exists("listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("res_hyp"),
  exists("res_ilos"),
  exists("res_pair")
)

# ================================================================
# 1. Helpers
# ================================================================

clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}

save_placeholder_png <- function(file, label,
                                 width_px = 3600,
                                 height_px = 2400,
                                 res = 500) {
  png(
    filename = file,
    width = width_px,
    height = height_px,
    units = "px",
    res = res,
    type = "cairo-png"
  )
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  text(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    labels = label,
    cex = 1.7,
    font = 2
  )

  invisible(file)
}

standardize_upset_sets <- function(sets_list, sets_order = NULL, label = "UpSet") {
  if (is.null(sets_list) || !length(sets_list)) {
    return(list(
      sets_list = list(),
      sets_order = character(0),
      audit = tibble(
        plot = label,
        set = character(),
        n_ids = integer(),
        retained = logical()
      )
    ))
  }

  if (is.null(names(sets_list))) {
    stop(label, ": sets_list must be a named list.")
  }

  if (is.null(sets_order)) {
    sets_order <- names(sets_list)
  }

  sets_order <- intersect(sets_order, names(sets_list))
  sets_list <- sets_list[sets_order]
  sets_list <- lapply(sets_list, clean_set)

  set_sizes <- lengths(sets_list)
  keep <- set_sizes > 0

  audit <- tibble(
    plot = label,
    set = names(sets_list),
    n_ids = as.integer(set_sizes),
    retained = keep
  )

  if (any(!keep)) {
    message(
      label,
      ": dropping empty set(s): ",
      paste(names(sets_list)[!keep], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  sets_list <- sets_list[keep]
  sets_order <- names(sets_list)

  list(
    sets_list = sets_list,
    sets_order = sets_order,
    audit = audit
  )
}

make_overlap_audit <- function(sets_list, label) {
  sets_list <- lapply(sets_list, clean_set)

  if (!length(sets_list)) {
    return(tibble(
      plot = label,
      comparison = character(),
      n_overlap = integer()
    ))
  }

  out <- list()

  out[["union"]] <- tibble(
    plot = label,
    comparison = "union_all_sets",
    n_overlap = length(unique(unlist(sets_list, use.names = FALSE)))
  )

  if (length(sets_list) >= 2) {
    combo <- combn(names(sets_list), 2, simplify = FALSE)

    pairwise <- lapply(combo, function(z) {
      tibble(
        plot = label,
        comparison = paste(z, collapse = " ∩ "),
        n_overlap = length(intersect(sets_list[[z[1]]], sets_list[[z[2]]]))
      )
    })

    out <- c(out, pairwise)
  }

  if (length(sets_list) >= 2) {
    out[["all_sets_intersection"]] <- tibble(
      plot = label,
      comparison = paste(names(sets_list), collapse = " ∩ "),
      n_overlap = length(Reduce(intersect, sets_list))
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}

save_upset_png <- function(file,
                           sets_list,
                           sets_order,
                           set_colors,
                           mainbar_y_label,
                           sets_x_label = "Mapped DEGs per Species",
                           plot_label = mainbar_y_label,
                           width_px = 3600,
                           height_px = 2400,
                           res = 500) {

  std <- standardize_upset_sets(
    sets_list = sets_list,
    sets_order = sets_order,
    label = plot_label
  )

  sets_list <- std$sets_list
  sets_order <- std$sets_order

  if (length(sets_list) < 2) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(mainbar_y_label, "\n\nFewer than two non-empty mapped sets available"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(list(
      file = file,
      set_audit = std$audit,
      overlap_audit = make_overlap_audit(sets_list, plot_label)
    ))
  }

  df_up <- UpSetR::fromList(sets_list)
  sets_for_upset <- intersect(sets_order, colnames(df_up))

  if (length(sets_for_upset) < 2) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(mainbar_y_label, "\n\nFewer than two valid UpSet columns after fromList()"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(list(
      file = file,
      set_audit = std$audit,
      overlap_audit = make_overlap_audit(sets_list, plot_label)
    ))
  }

  set_colors <- set_colors[seq_along(sets_for_upset)]

  # Key fix:
  # UpSetR/grid output can fail to draw when called inside a helper unless
  # explicitly captured/drawn. grid.grabExpr() makes the side-effect plot
  # concrete before writing to PNG.
  upset_grob <- tryCatch(
    grid::grid.grabExpr({
      p <- UpSetR::upset(
        df_up,
        sets            = sets_for_upset,
        keep.order      = TRUE,
        order.by        = "freq",
        nsets           = length(sets_for_upset),
        nintersects     = 40,
        mb.ratio        = c(0.6, 0.4),
        main.bar.color  = "black",
        sets.bar.color  = set_colors,
        text.scale      = c(2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1.8, 1.8),
        mainbar.y.label = mainbar_y_label,
        sets.x.label    = sets_x_label
      )

      if (!is.null(p)) {
        print(p)
      }
    }),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(upset_grob, "error")) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(mainbar_y_label, "\n\nUpSetR capture failed:\n", conditionMessage(upset_grob)),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )
  } else {
    png(
      filename = file,
      width = width_px,
      height = height_px,
      units = "px",
      res = res,
      type = "cairo-png"
    )
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(upset_grob)
    dev.off()
  }

  list(
    file = file,
    set_audit = std$audit,
    overlap_audit = make_overlap_audit(sets_list, plot_label)
  )
}

get_bp_tbl <- function(bp_res) {
  if (is.null(bp_res)) return(NULL)

  if (is.data.frame(bp_res)) {
    bp_tbl <- bp_res
  } else if (!is.null(bp_res$bp)) {
    bp_tbl <- bp_res$bp
  } else if (!is.null(bp_res$result)) {
    bp_tbl <- bp_res$result
  } else {
    bp_tbl <- NULL
  }

  if (is.null(bp_tbl) || !nrow(bp_tbl)) return(NULL)

  bp_tbl <- as.data.frame(bp_tbl)

  if (!"term_id" %in% names(bp_tbl) && "ID" %in% names(bp_tbl)) {
    names(bp_tbl)[names(bp_tbl) == "ID"] <- "term_id"
  }

  if (!"term_name" %in% names(bp_tbl) && "Description" %in% names(bp_tbl)) {
    names(bp_tbl)[names(bp_tbl) == "Description"] <- "term_name"
  }

  bp_tbl
}

get_p_col <- function(bp_tbl) {
  candidates <- c("p_value", "p.adjust", "p_adj", "padj", "qvalue", "q_value")
  candidates[candidates %in% names(bp_tbl)][1]
}

save_rrvgo_png <- function(file,
                           bp_res,
                           title_txt,
                           sim_method = "Rel",
                           threshold = 0.90,
                           top_n_terms = 100,
                           size_mode = c("sqrt_score", "score", "equal"),
                           width_px = 3600,
                           height_px = 2400,
                           res = 500) {

  size_mode <- match.arg(size_mode)
  bp_tbl <- get_bp_tbl(bp_res)

  if (is.null(bp_tbl) || !nrow(bp_tbl)) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(title_txt, "\n\nNo GO:BP terms available"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = 0L,
      input_terms_used = 0L,
      reduced_parent_terms = 0L,
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = "no_terms"
    ))
  }

  if (!"term_id" %in% names(bp_tbl)) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(title_txt, "\n\nNo term_id column found"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = nrow(bp_tbl),
      input_terms_used = 0L,
      reduced_parent_terms = 0L,
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = "missing_term_id"
    ))
  }

  bp_tbl <- bp_tbl |>
    filter(!is.na(term_id), nzchar(as.character(term_id))) |>
    distinct(term_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  input_terms_raw <- nrow(bp_tbl)

  p_col <- get_p_col(bp_tbl)

  if (!is.na(p_col) && length(p_col) == 1) {
    bp_tbl[[p_col]] <- as.numeric(bp_tbl[[p_col]])
    bp_tbl <- bp_tbl |>
      arrange(.data[[p_col]])
  }

  # Key fix:
  # Do NOT re-filter by intersection_size or term_size here.
  # The upstream GO section already generated the top-N GO:BP result table.
  bp_tbl <- head(bp_tbl, top_n_terms)

  term_ids <- clean_set(bp_tbl$term_id)

  if (length(term_ids) < 2) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(title_txt, "\n\nFewer than two GO terms available"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = input_terms_raw,
      input_terms_used = length(term_ids),
      reduced_parent_terms = length(term_ids),
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = "too_few_terms"
    ))
  }

  bp_tbl <- bp_tbl[match(term_ids, bp_tbl$term_id), , drop = FALSE]

  scores <- bp_res$scores

  if (is.null(scores) || !all(term_ids %in% names(scores))) {
    if (!is.na(p_col) && length(p_col) == 1) {
      p_for_score <- as.numeric(bp_tbl[[p_col]])
      p_for_score <- pmax(p_for_score, .Machine$double.xmin)
      scores <- -log10(p_for_score)
      names(scores) <- term_ids
    } else {
      scores <- seq(from = length(term_ids), to = 1)
      names(scores) <- term_ids
    }
  } else {
    scores <- scores[term_ids]
  }

  scores <- scores[is.finite(scores) & !is.na(scores)]
  term_ids <- intersect(term_ids, names(scores))
  scores <- scores[term_ids]

  if (length(term_ids) < 2) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(title_txt, "\n\nFewer than two scored GO terms available"),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    return(tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = input_terms_raw,
      input_terms_used = length(term_ids),
      reduced_parent_terms = length(term_ids),
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = "too_few_scored_terms"
    ))
  }

  audit <- tryCatch({
    sim <- rrvgo::calculateSimMatrix(
      term_ids,
      orgdb = "org.Dr.eg.db",
      ont = "BP",
      method = sim_method
    )

    red <- rrvgo::reduceSimMatrix(
      simMatrix = sim,
      scores = scores,
      threshold = threshold,
      orgdb = "org.Dr.eg.db"
    )

    red_df <- as.data.frame(red)

    # Make treemap sizing less visually dominated by one highly significant parent.
    # "sqrt_score" still reflects enrichment strength but compresses huge score differences.
    if (size_mode == "sqrt_score") {
      red_df$plot_size <- sqrt(pmax(red_df$score, 0)) + 1e-6
      size_col <- "plot_size"
    } else if (size_mode == "equal") {
      red_df$plot_size <- 1
      size_col <- "plot_size"
    } else {
      size_col <- "score"
    }

    treemap_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr({
      rrvgo::treemapPlot(
        reducedTerms = red_df,
        size = size_col,
        title = title_txt
      )
    })

    png(
      filename = file,
      width = width_px,
      height = height_px,
      units = "px",
      res = res,
      type = "cairo-png"
    )
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(treemap_grob)
    dev.off()

    tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = input_terms_raw,
      input_terms_used = length(term_ids),
      reduced_parent_terms = length(unique(red_df$parent)),
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = "ok"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    save_placeholder_png(
      file,
      paste0(title_txt, "\n\nrrvgo failed:\n", conditionMessage(e)),
      width_px = width_px,
      height_px = height_px,
      res = res
    )

    tibble(
      plot = title_txt,
      input_terms_raw = input_terms_raw,
      input_terms_used = length(term_ids),
      reduced_parent_terms = NA_integer_,
      threshold = threshold,
      size_mode = size_mode,
      status = paste0("rrvgo_failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    )
  })

  audit
}

pad_to_size <- function(img, target_width, target_height) {
  image_extent(
    img,
    geometry = paste0(target_width, "x", target_height),
    color = "white",
    gravity = "center"
  )
}

resize_to_width <- function(img, target_width) {
  image_scale(img, paste0(target_width, "x"))
}

save_magick_as_pdf <- function(img, file, width_in = 18, height_in = 10) {
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    filename = file,
    width = width_in,
    height = height_in,
    bg = "white"
  )
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.raster(
    as.raster(img),
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    width = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    interpolate = TRUE
  )

  invisible(file)
}

# ================================================================
# 2. Render UpSet plots
# ================================================================

species_order <- c("ACE", "GEO", "COR", "GIB", "MAC")

pal_all <- viridisLite::plasma(length(species_order), direction = 1)
names(pal_all) <- species_order

# Hypoxia
sets_hyp <- intersect(species_order, names(listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog))
cols_hyp <- unname(pal_all[sets_hyp])

up_hyp_info <- save_upset_png(
  file = "panel_out/up_hyp.png",
  sets_list = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog,
  sets_order = sets_hyp,
  set_colors = cols_hyp,
  mainbar_y_label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(Hypoxia, DrOrtholog)",
  plot_label = "Hypoxia"
)

# ILOP display label, object names may still be ILOS
sets_ilos <- intersect(species_order, names(listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog))
cols_ilos <- unname(pal_all[sets_ilos])

up_ilos_info <- save_upset_png(
  file = "panel_out/up_ilos.png",
  sets_list = listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog,
  sets_order = sets_ilos,
  set_colors = cols_ilos,
  mainbar_y_label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(ILOP, DrOrtholog)",
  plot_label = "ILOP"
)

# Pair: MAC ILOP vs Hypoxia sets
sets_pair_list <- list(
  ACE_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["ACE"]],
  COR_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["COR"]],
  GIB_Hypoxia = listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog[["GIB"]],
  MAC_ILOP    = listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog[["MAC"]]
)

sets_pair_order <- c("ACE_Hypoxia", "COR_Hypoxia", "GIB_Hypoxia", "MAC_ILOP")
cols_pair <- unname(viridisLite::viridis(length(sets_pair_order), direction = 1))

up_pair_info <- save_upset_png(
  file = "panel_out/up_pair.png",
  sets_list = sets_pair_list,
  sets_order = sets_pair_order,
  set_colors = cols_pair,
  mainbar_y_label = "DE Gene Overlap\n(MAC ILOP vs Hypoxia)",
  sets_x_label = "Mapped DEGs per set",
  plot_label = "MAC ILOP vs Hypoxia"
)

upset_set_audit <- bind_rows(
  up_hyp_info$set_audit,
  up_ilos_info$set_audit,
  up_pair_info$set_audit
)

upset_overlap_audit <- bind_rows(
  up_hyp_info$overlap_audit,
  up_ilos_info$overlap_audit,
  up_pair_info$overlap_audit
)

write.csv(
  upset_set_audit,
  "panel_out/upset_set_audit.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  upset_overlap_audit,
  "panel_out/upset_overlap_audit.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== UpSet set audit ===\n")
print(upset_set_audit, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== UpSet overlap audit ===\n")
print(upset_overlap_audit, n = Inf)

upset_file_check <- tibble(
  file = c("panel_out/up_hyp.png", "panel_out/up_ilos.png", "panel_out/up_pair.png"),
  size_bytes = file.info(file)$size
)

cat("\n=== UpSet PNG file check ===\n")
print(upset_file_check)

# ================================================================
# 3. Render rrvgo treemaps directly to PNG
# ================================================================

# Important:
# Higher threshold = less aggressive reduction.
# If still too collapsed, try 0.95.
# If too busy, try 0.85.
rrvgo_threshold <- 0.90

# "sqrt_score" avoids one huge -log10(p) parent dominating the whole treemap.
# Alternatives:
#   "score" = original score-sized rrvgo treemap
#   "equal" = all reduced parent terms get equal area
rrvgo_size_mode <- "sqrt_score"

tm_hyp_audit <- save_rrvgo_png(
  file = "panel_out/tm_hyp.png",
  bp_res = res_hyp,
  title_txt = "MAC Hypoxia ∩ ACE Hypoxia — GO:BP",
  sim_method = "Rel",
  threshold = rrvgo_threshold,
  top_n_terms = 100,
  size_mode = rrvgo_size_mode
)

tm_ilos_audit <- save_rrvgo_png(
  file = "panel_out/tm_ilos.png",
  bp_res = res_ilos,
  title_txt = "MAC ILOP ∩ ACE ILOP — GO:BP",
  sim_method = "Rel",
  threshold = rrvgo_threshold,
  top_n_terms = 100,
  size_mode = rrvgo_size_mode
)

tm_pair_audit <- save_rrvgo_png(
  file = "panel_out/tm_pair.png",
  bp_res = res_pair,
  title_txt = "MAC ILOP ∩ ACE Hypoxia — GO:BP",
  sim_method = "Rel",
  threshold = rrvgo_threshold,
  top_n_terms = 100,
  size_mode = rrvgo_size_mode
)

rrvgo_audit <- bind_rows(
  tm_hyp_audit,
  tm_ilos_audit,
  tm_pair_audit
)

write.csv(
  rrvgo_audit,
  "panel_out/rrvgo_reduction_audit.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== rrvgo reduction audit ===\n")
print(rrvgo_audit, n = Inf)

treemap_file_check <- tibble(
  file = c("panel_out/tm_hyp.png", "panel_out/tm_ilos.png", "panel_out/tm_pair.png"),
  size_bytes = file.info(file)$size
)

cat("\n=== Treemap PNG file check ===\n")
print(treemap_file_check)

# ================================================================
# 4. Assemble 3 x 2 panel
# ================================================================

up_hyp  <- image_read("panel_out/up_hyp.png")
up_ilos <- image_read("panel_out/up_ilos.png")
up_pair <- image_read("panel_out/up_pair.png")

tm_hyp  <- image_read("panel_out/tm_hyp.png")
tm_ilos <- image_read("panel_out/tm_ilos.png")
tm_pair <- image_read("panel_out/tm_pair.png")

target_width <- min(
  image_info(up_hyp)$width,
  image_info(up_ilos)$width,
  image_info(up_pair)$width,
  image_info(tm_hyp)$width,
  image_info(tm_ilos)$width,
  image_info(tm_pair)$width
)

imgs_top <- lapply(
  list(up_hyp, up_ilos, up_pair),
  resize_to_width,
  target_width = target_width
)

imgs_bot <- lapply(
  list(tm_hyp, tm_ilos, tm_pair),
  resize_to_width,
  target_width = target_width
)

top_height <- max(vapply(imgs_top, function(x) image_info(x)$height, numeric(1)))
bot_height <- max(vapply(imgs_bot, function(x) image_info(x)$height, numeric(1)))

imgs_top <- lapply(
  imgs_top,
  pad_to_size,
  target_width = target_width,
  target_height = top_height
)

imgs_bot <- lapply(
  imgs_bot,
  pad_to_size,
  target_width = target_width,
  target_height = bot_height
)

spacer_top <- image_blank(width = 20, height = top_height, color = "white")
spacer_bot <- image_blank(width = 20, height = bot_height, color = "white")

row_top <- image_append(
  c(imgs_top[[1]], spacer_top, imgs_top[[2]], spacer_top, imgs_top[[3]]),
  stack = FALSE
)

row_bot <- image_append(
  c(imgs_bot[[1]], spacer_bot, imgs_bot[[2]], spacer_bot, imgs_bot[[3]]),
  stack = FALSE
)

panel_width <- max(image_info(row_top)$width, image_info(row_bot)$width)

row_top <- image_extent(
  row_top,
  geometry = paste0(panel_width, "x", top_height),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

row_bot <- image_extent(
  row_bot,
  geometry = paste0(panel_width, "x", bot_height),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

v_spacer <- image_blank(width = panel_width, height = 30, color = "white")

final_panel <- image_append(
  c(row_top, v_spacer, row_bot),
  stack = TRUE
)

# ================================================================
# 5. Add panel labels A-F
# ================================================================

panel_info <- image_info(final_panel)

label_specs <- tibble(
  label = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  x_frac = rep(c(0.02, 0.36, 0.69), times = 2),
  y_abs = c(
    rep(30, 3),
    rep(top_height + 60, 3)
  )
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(label_specs))) {
  final_panel <- image_annotate(
    final_panel,
    label_specs$label[i],
    size = 90,
    weight = 700,
    color = "black",
    boxcolor = "white",
    gravity = "northwest",
    location = paste0(
      "+", round(label_specs$x_frac[i] * panel_info$width),
      "+", round(label_specs$y_abs[i])
    )
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 6. Save final panel
# ================================================================

png_out <- "panel_out/Panel_UpSet_Treemaps_DrOrtholog_FIXED2_LABELED.png"
pdf_out <- "panel_out/Panel_UpSet_Treemaps_DrOrtholog_FIXED2_LABELED.pdf"

image_write(
  final_panel,
  png_out,
  format = "png"
)

save_magick_as_pdf(
  final_panel,
  pdf_out,
  width_in = 18,
  height_in = 10
)

cat("\nSaved panel files:\n")
cat("  ", png_out, "\n", sep = "")
cat("  ", pdf_out, "\n", sep = "")

final_panel
```

# ================================================================
# Pairwise Venns + Split Direction Heatmaps + KEGG Bubbles
#
# Display logic:
#   - Venn circle totals = all DEGs for each species/treatment.
#   - Venn shared center = conservative mapped DrOrtholog overlap.
#   - Heatmaps = shared DrOrthologs recovered in KEGG pathway genes.
#   - KEGG bubbles = KEGG enrichment of shared DrOrtholog-derived
#     MAC/Entrez gene sets.
#
# Figure labels:
#   - Treatment label is displayed as ILOP.
#   - Existing upstream R objects may still contain ILOS.
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)

  library(stringr)

  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)

  "path_order_hyp", "path_order_ilos", "path_order_pair",
  "venn_count_summary",
  "kegg_diagnostic_summary",
  "heat_diagnostic_summary",
  "pathway_gene_recovery_diagnostics",
  "p_venn_hyp", "p_venn_ilos", "p_venn_pair",
  "p_heat_hyp", "p_heat_ilos", "p_heat_pair",
  "p_bub_hyp", "p_bub_ilos", "p_bub_pair"
)

rm(list = intersect(old_panel_objects, ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)), envir = .GlobalEnv)

unlink(c(
  "panel_out/venn_hyp.png",
  "panel_out/venn_ilop.png",
  "panel_out/venn_pair.png",
  "panel_out/heat_hyp.png",
  "panel_out/heat_ilop.png",

  "panel_out/bub_ilop.png",

  "panel_out/Panel_Venn_DirectionHeatmaps_KEGGBubbles_DrOrtholog_FINAL_LABELED.png",
  "panel_out/Panel_Venn_DirectionHeatmaps_KEGGBubbles_DrOrtholog_FINAL_LABELED.pdf"
), force = TRUE)

# ================================================================
# 1. Required objects and paths
# ================================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("listInput_Hypoxia_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("listInput_ILOS_DrOrtholog"),
  exists("keep_counts_MAC")
)

base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"
map_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "mapped_counts")

species_order <- c("ACE", "GEO", "COR", "GIB", "MAC")
overlap_symbol <- "\u2229"   # ∩

# ================================================================
# 2. Core helpers
# ================================================================

clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x)))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}

norm_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

get_gene_ids_from_deg_table <- function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  gene_col_candidates <- c("Gene", "gene", "GeneID", "gene_id", "ID", "id", "key", "Key")
  gene_col <- gene_col_candidates[gene_col_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  ids <- if (!is.na(gene_col) && length(gene_col)) as.character(df[[gene_col]]) else rownames(df)
  clean_set(ids)
}

get_deg_table_with_gene_ids <- function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  gene_col_candidates <- c("Gene", "gene", "GeneID", "gene_id", "ID", "id", "key", "Key")
  gene_col <- gene_col_candidates[gene_col_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  ids <- if (!is.na(gene_col) && length(gene_col)) as.character(df[[gene_col]]) else rownames(df)

  tibble(
    input_gene = as.character(ids),
    logFC = as.numeric(df$logFC)
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(input_gene), nzchar(input_gene), !is.na(logFC)) |>
    distinct(input_gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

get_sig_df <- function(species, condition) {
  nm <- paste0("sig.", condition, "_", species, ".fdr")
  if (!exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) stop("Missing expected DEG object: ", nm)
  get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

get_raw_deg_count <- function(species, condition) {
  df <- get_sig_df(species, condition)
  length(get_gene_ids_from_deg_table(df))
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Load repaired DrOrtholog maps if needed
# ================================================================

if (!exists("maps_dr")) {
  load_dr_map <- function(sp) {
    path <- file.path(map_dir, paste0(sp, "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv"))
    if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing repaired DrOrtholog map for ", sp, ": ", path)

    readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      mutate(
        species = sp,
        key = as.character(key),
        key_norm = norm_key(key),
        DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
        picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(key), nzchar(key), !is.na(DrOrtholog), nzchar(DrOrtholog)) |>
      distinct(species, key, key_norm, DrOrtholog, picked_from)
  }

  maps_dr <- setNames(lapply(species_order, load_dr_map), species_order)
}

stopifnot(all(c("MAC", "ACE") %in% names(maps_dr)))

# ================================================================
# 4. DEG table standardization: species DEG -> DrOrtholog + logFC
# ================================================================

standardize_deg_drortholog <- function(species, condition) {
  df <- get_sig_df(species, condition)
  if (!"logFC" %in% names(df)) stop("Expected logFC column not found in sig.", condition, "_", species, ".fdr")

  deg <- get_deg_table_with_gene_ids(df) |>
    mutate(
      species = species,
      condition = condition,
      key_norm = norm_key(input_gene),
      direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
        logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    )

  deg |>
    inner_join(
      maps_dr[[species]] |> select(key, key_norm, DrOrtholog, picked_from),
      by = "key_norm",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(DrOrtholog), nzchar(DrOrtholog)) |>
    arrange(DrOrtholog, desc(abs(logFC))) |>
    distinct(DrOrtholog, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

std_MAC_H <- standardize_deg_drortholog("MAC", "Hypoxia")
std_ACE_H <- standardize_deg_drortholog("ACE", "Hypoxia")
std_MAC_I <- standardize_deg_drortholog("MAC", "ILOS")
std_ACE_I <- standardize_deg_drortholog("ACE", "ILOS")

deg_check <- tibble(
  table = c("std_MAC_H", "std_ACE_H", "std_MAC_I", "std_ACE_I"),
  species = c("MAC", "ACE", "MAC", "ACE"),
  treatment_display = c("Hypoxia", "Hypoxia", "ILOP", "ILOP"),
  mapped_deg_rows = c(nrow(std_MAC_H), nrow(std_ACE_H), nrow(std_MAC_I), nrow(std_ACE_I)),
  unique_DrOrtholog = c(
    n_distinct(std_MAC_H$DrOrtholog),
    n_distinct(std_ACE_H$DrOrtholog),
    n_distinct(std_MAC_I$DrOrtholog),
    n_distinct(std_ACE_I$DrOrtholog)
  )
)

cat("\n=== Directional heatmap DEG table checks ===\n")
print(deg_check, n = Inf)

# ================================================================
# 5. Symbol/key -> zebrafish Entrez mapping for KEGG
# ================================================================

map_keys_to_entrez <- function(keys, label = "query") {
  keys <- clean_set(keys)

  if (!length(keys)) {
    return(tibble(input_key = character(), SYMBOL = character(), ENTREZID = character()))
  }

  candidate_symbols <- clean_set(c(keys, tolower(keys), toupper(keys)))
  valid_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dr.eg.db, keytype = "SYMBOL")
  query_symbols <- intersect(candidate_symbols, valid_symbols)

  if (!length(query_symbols)) {
    message("[", label, "] no valid zebrafish symbols found.")
    return(tibble(input_key = character(), SYMBOL = character(), ENTREZID = character()))
  }

  sym_lookup <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Dr.eg.db,
      keys = query_symbols,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
    )
  ) |>
    transmute(
      SYMBOL = as.character(SYMBOL),
      ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID),
      symbol_norm = tolower(SYMBOL)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) |>
    distinct(symbol_norm, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  out <- tibble(
    input_key = keys,
    symbol_norm = tolower(keys)
  ) |>
    left_join(sym_lookup, by = "symbol_norm", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) |>
    distinct(input_key, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(input_key, SYMBOL, ENTREZID)

  message("[", label, "] ", length(keys), " input keys -> ", n_distinct(out$ENTREZID), " Entrez IDs")
  out
}

get_mac_keys_for_drorthologs <- function(dr_ids) {
  dr_ids <- clean_set(dr_ids)

  maps_dr[["MAC"]] |>
    filter(DrOrtholog %in% dr_ids) |>
    transmute(
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      MAC_key = as.character(key)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(MAC_key), nzchar(MAC_key)) |>
    distinct()
}

make_overlap_kegg_input <- function(overlap_drortholog, comparison_label) {
  mac_key_table <- get_mac_keys_for_drorthologs(overlap_drortholog)

  query_map <- map_keys_to_entrez(
    mac_key_table$MAC_key,
    label = paste0(comparison_label, " overlap MAC keys")
  )

  query_link <- mac_key_table |>
    left_join(query_map, by = c("MAC_key" = "input_key"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) |>
    distinct(DrOrtholog, MAC_key, SYMBOL, ENTREZID)

  list(
    mac_key_table = mac_key_table,
    query_map = query_map,
    query_link = query_link,
    query_entrez = clean_set(query_link$ENTREZID)
  )
}

mac_drortholog_background_keys <- intersect(rownames(keep_counts_MAC), maps_dr[["MAC"]]$key)

bg_map <- map_keys_to_entrez(
  mac_drortholog_background_keys,
  label = "MAC DrOrtholog-tested KEGG background"
)

bg_ent <- clean_set(bg_map$ENTREZID)

cat(
  "\nMAC KEGG background:\n",
  "  tested MAC genes: ", length(rownames(keep_counts_MAC)), "\n",
  "  unique DrOrtholog-mapped MAC keys: ", length(unique(maps_dr[["MAC"]]$key)), "\n",
  "  tested + DrOrtholog-mapped MAC keys: ", length(mac_drortholog_background_keys), "\n",
  "  background Entrez IDs: ", length(bg_ent), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

# ================================================================
# 6. KEGG enrichment helpers
# ================================================================

enrich_kegg_universe <- function(query_entrez, bg_entrez, min_fg = 10) {
  query_entrez <- clean_set(query_entrez)
  bg_entrez <- clean_set(bg_entrez)

  if (!length(query_entrez) || !length(bg_entrez) || length(query_entrez) < min_fg) return(tibble())

  bg_entrez <- clean_set(c(bg_entrez, query_entrez))

  ek <- suppressWarnings(
    clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
      gene          = query_entrez,
      organism      = "dre",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      qvalueCutoff  = 1,
      minGSSize     = 5,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      universe      = bg_entrez
    )
  )

  if (is.null(ek) || is.null(ek@result)) return(tibble())

  as_tibble(ek@result) |>
    filter(!is.na(ID), !is.na(p.adjust)) |>
    arrange(p.adjust, pvalue)
}

tidy_kegg_for_bubbles <- function(tbl, padj_cutoff = 0.10, fallback_to_ranked = TRUE) {
  if (!nrow(tbl)) return(tibble())

  split_ratio <- function(x) {
    sp <- strsplit(x, "/", fixed = TRUE)
    as.numeric(vapply(sp, `[`, "", 1)) / as.numeric(vapply(sp, `[`, "", 2))
  }

  out <- tbl |>
    mutate(
      pathway   = Description,
      nPath     = as.numeric(Count),
      pct       = 100 * split_ratio(GeneRatio),
      neglogFDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      significant = p.adjust <= padj_cutoff
    ) |>
    select(ID, pathway, geneID, pct, nPath, neglogFDR, p.adjust, significant)

  if (any(out$significant, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    out |> filter(significant)
  } else if (fallback_to_ranked) {
    out
  } else {
    out[0, ]
  }
}

keep_top <- function(dat, top_n = 15, by = c("neglogFDR", "pct", "nPath")) {
  if (!nrow(dat)) return(dat)
  by <- match.arg(by)
  dat |>
    arrange(desc(.data[[by]]), desc(pct), desc(nPath), pathway) |>
    slice_head(n = min(top_n, nrow(dat)))
}

# ================================================================
# 7. Venn helpers
# ================================================================

make_pairwise_count_row <- function(comparison,
                                    left_name,
                                    right_name,
                                    left_raw_n,
                                    right_raw_n,
                                    shared_drortholog_n) {
  tibble(
    comparison = comparison,
    left_set = left_name,
    right_set = right_name,
    left_total_all_DEGs = left_raw_n,
    right_total_all_DEGs = right_raw_n,
    shared_mapped_DrOrtholog = shared_drortholog_n,
    left_not_in_shared_mapped_overlap = left_raw_n - shared_drortholog_n,
    right_not_in_shared_mapped_overlap = right_raw_n - shared_drortholog_n
  )
}

make_two_set_venn <- function(left_total,
                              right_total,
                              shared_n,
                              left_label,
                              right_label,
                              title,
                              left_fill = "#E6E600",
                              right_fill = "#1F2A90",
                              base_size = 15) {

  left_only  <- left_total - shared_n
  right_only <- right_total - shared_n

  circle_poly <- function(cx, cy, r, group, n = 360) {
    theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
    tibble(x = cx + r * cos(theta), y = cy + r * sin(theta), group = group)
  }

  circles <- bind_rows(
    circle_poly(-0.55, 0, 1, left_label),
    circle_poly( 0.55, 0, 1, right_label)
  )

  counts_df <- tibble(
    x = c(-0.88, 0, 0.88),
    y = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
    lab = c(left_only, shared_n, right_only)
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = circles,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = group, fill = group),
      alpha = 0.55,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = counts_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 9.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -0.72, y = -1.18,
      label = paste0(left_label, "\n", "n = ", left_total),
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.72, y = -1.18,
      label = paste0(right_label, "\n", "n = ", right_total),
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    # annotate(
    #   "text",
    #   x = 0, y = -1.40,
    #   label = "Shared region = mapped DrOrtholog overlap",
    #   size = 4.1,
    #   fontface = "italic",
    #   color = "grey25"
    # ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(left_fill, right_fill), c(left_label, right_label))) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1.85, 1.85), ylim = c(-1.58, 1.35), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = base_size * 1.22,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 32, 20)
    )
}

# ================================================================
# 8. Bubble plot helpers
# ================================================================

bubble_plot <- function(dat, title,
                        size_lim = NULL, fill_lim = NULL, x_lim = NULL,
                        top_n = 15,
                        order_by = c("neglogFDR", "pct", "nPath"),
                        wrap_width = 40,
                        base_size = 12.5,
                        size_range = c(3.0, 8.2)) {

  order_by <- match.arg(order_by)
  dat <- keep_top(dat, top_n, by = order_by)

  if (!nrow(dat)) {
    return(
      ggplot(data.frame(x = .5, y = .5, lab = "No KEGG pathways available"), aes(x, y, label = lab)) +
        geom_text(fontface = "bold", size = 4.2, color = "black") +
        scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL, limits = c(0, 1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL, limits = c(0, 1)) +
        ggtitle(title) +
        theme_void(base_size = base_size) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5, size = base_size * 1.25, color = "black"))
    )
  }

  dat <- dat |>
    mutate(pathway_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(pathway, width = wrap_width)) |>
    arrange(pct, neglogFDR, nPath) |>
    mutate(pathway_wrapped = factor(pathway_wrapped, levels = unique(pathway_wrapped)))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = pct, y = pathway_wrapped)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = nPath, fill = neglogFDR), shape = 21, alpha = 0.92, stroke = 0.45, color = "black") +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "DE genes",
      limits = size_lim,
      range = size_range,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top", nrow = 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      low = "#E8EEF7",
      high = "#123B7A",
      limits = fill_lim,
      oob = scales::squish,
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        order = 2,
        title.position = "top",
        direction = "horizontal",
        barheight = grid::unit(3.2, "mm"),
        barwidth  = grid::unit(32, "mm"),
        label.theme = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = base_size * 0.78)
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim, breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = "% of genes in pathway", y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5, size = base_size * 1.35, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = base_size * 1.02, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_size * 0.92, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = base_size * 0.9, color = "black", lineheight = .96, margin = margin(r = 7)),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size * 0.98, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size * 0.88, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey55", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 9, 5, 5)
    )
}

# ================================================================
# 9. Heatmap helpers
# ================================================================

make_bubble_order_tbl <- function(tid_tbl,
                                  top_n_bubble = 15,
                                  top_n_heatmap = 10,
                                  wrap_width = 34) {
  if (!nrow(tid_tbl)) return(tibble())

  keep_top(tid_tbl, top_n = top_n_bubble, by = "neglogFDR") |>
    mutate(pathway_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(pathway, width = wrap_width)) |>
    arrange(desc(pct), desc(neglogFDR), pathway) |>
    slice_head(n = top_n_heatmap) |>
    mutate(
      pathway_order = row_number(),
      pathway_wrapped = factor(pathway_wrapped, levels = rev(unique(pathway_wrapped)))
    )
}

extract_pathway_genes <- function(ek_tbl, pathway_order_tbl, query_link) {
  if (!nrow(ek_tbl) || !nrow(pathway_order_tbl)) return(tibble())

  ek_tbl |>
    filter(ID %in% pathway_order_tbl$ID) |>
    select(ID, Description, geneID, Count, GeneRatio, p.adjust) |>
    left_join(
      pathway_order_tbl |> select(ID, pathway, pathway_wrapped, pathway_order, pct, nPath, neglogFDR),
      by = "ID"
    ) |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
    rename(ENTREZID = geneID) |>
    mutate(ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID)) |>
    left_join(query_link, by = "ENTREZID", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    mutate(mapped_to_drortholog = !is.na(DrOrtholog) & nzchar(DrOrtholog))
}

diagnose_pathway_gene_recovery <- function(ek_tbl,
                                           tid_tbl,
                                           query_link,
                                           left_deg,
                                           right_deg,
                                           comparison,
                                           top_n_bubble = 15,
                                           top_n_heatmap = 10) {
  pathway_order_tbl <- make_bubble_order_tbl(tid_tbl, top_n_bubble, top_n_heatmap)
  pg <- extract_pathway_genes(ek_tbl, pathway_order_tbl, query_link)
  if (!nrow(pg)) return(tibble())

  left_ids  <- clean_set(left_deg$DrOrtholog)
  right_ids <- clean_set(right_deg$DrOrtholog)

  pg |>
    mutate(
      in_left_deg  = mapped_to_drortholog & DrOrtholog %in% left_ids,
      in_right_deg = mapped_to_drortholog & DrOrtholog %in% right_ids,
      in_both_deg  = in_left_deg & in_right_deg
    ) |>
    group_by(comparison = comparison, pathway_order, ID, pathway) |>
    summarise(
      kegg_entrez_in_enrichment = n_distinct(ENTREZID),
      mapped_to_drortholog = n_distinct(DrOrtholog[mapped_to_drortholog]),
      in_left_deg = n_distinct(DrOrtholog[in_left_deg]),
      in_right_deg = n_distinct(DrOrtholog[in_right_deg]),
      in_both_deg = n_distinct(DrOrtholog[in_both_deg]),
      lost_entrez_to_drortholog = kegg_entrez_in_enrichment - mapped_to_drortholog,
      lost_after_left_join = mapped_to_drortholog - in_left_deg,
      lost_after_right_join = mapped_to_drortholog - in_right_deg,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(pathway_order)
}

make_direction_heatmap_data <- function(ek_tbl,
                                        tid_tbl,
                                        query_link,
                                        left_deg,
                                        right_deg,
                                        left_label,
                                        right_label,
                                        top_n_bubble = 15,
                                        top_n_heatmap = 10,
                                        genes_per_pathway = 6) {
  pathway_order_tbl <- make_bubble_order_tbl(tid_tbl, top_n_bubble, top_n_heatmap)
  if (!nrow(pathway_order_tbl)) return(tibble())

  pg <- extract_pathway_genes(ek_tbl, pathway_order_tbl, query_link) |>
    filter(mapped_to_drortholog)

  if (!nrow(pg)) return(tibble())

  left_small <- left_deg |>
    select(DrOrtholog, logFC_left = logFC, left_input_gene = input_gene, left_key = key, direction_left = direction)

  right_small <- right_deg |>
    select(DrOrtholog, logFC_right = logFC, right_input_gene = input_gene, right_key = key, direction_right = direction)

  joined <- pg |>
    left_join(left_small, by = "DrOrtholog") |>
    left_join(right_small, by = "DrOrtholog") |>
    mutate(
      has_left_logFC  = !is.na(logFC_left),
      has_right_logFC = !is.na(logFC_right),
      has_both_logFC  = has_left_logFC & has_right_logFC
    ) |>
    filter(has_both_logFC) |>
    mutate(
      gene_label = coalesce(SYMBOL, MAC_key, left_key, right_key, DrOrtholog),
      gene_label = stringr::str_to_upper(gene_label),
      gene_label_short = stringr::str_trunc(gene_label, width = 10, ellipsis = ""),
      opposite_direction = sign(logFC_left) != sign(logFC_right),
      opposition_score = abs(logFC_left - logFC_right),
      combined_abs_logFC = abs(logFC_left) + abs(logFC_right)
    )

  if (!nrow(joined)) return(tibble())

  selected <- joined |>
    group_by(ID, pathway, pathway_wrapped, pathway_order) |>
    arrange(pathway_order, desc(opposite_direction), desc(opposition_score), desc(combined_abs_logFC), gene_label, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    slice_head(n = genes_per_pathway) |>
    mutate(gene_rank = row_number()) |>
    ungroup()

  out <- bind_rows(
    selected |>
      transmute(
        ID, pathway, pathway_wrapped, pathway_order,
        ENTREZID, DrOrtholog, gene_label, gene_label_short, gene_rank,
        comparison_side = left_label,
        logFC = logFC_left,
        direction = case_when(logFC_left > 0 ~ "Up", logFC_left < 0 ~ "Down", TRUE ~ "No change"),
        opposite_direction
      ),
    selected |>
      transmute(
        ID, pathway, pathway_wrapped, pathway_order,
        ENTREZID, DrOrtholog, gene_label, gene_label_short, gene_rank,
        comparison_side = right_label,
        logFC = logFC_right,
        direction = case_when(logFC_right > 0 ~ "Up", logFC_right < 0 ~ "Down", TRUE ~ "No change"),
        opposite_direction
      )
  ) |>
    mutate(comparison_side = factor(comparison_side, levels = c(left_label, right_label)))

  pathway_levels <- rev(as.character(pathway_order_tbl$pathway_wrapped))

  out |>
    mutate(pathway_wrapped = factor(as.character(pathway_wrapped), levels = pathway_levels)) |>
    arrange(pathway_order, comparison_side, gene_rank)
}

direction_heatmap_plot <- function(dat,
                                   title,
                                   fill_lim = NULL,
                                   genes_per_pathway = 6,
                                   pathway_levels = NULL,
                                   base_size = 10.8,
                                   tile_label_size = 2.45) {
  if (!nrow(dat)) {
    return(
      ggplot(data.frame(x = .5, y = .5, lab = "No shared pathway genes available"), aes(x, y, label = lab)) +
        geom_text(fontface = "bold", size = 3.8, color = "black") +
        scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL, limits = c(0, 1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL, limits = c(0, 1)) +
        ggtitle(title) +
        theme_void(base_size = base_size) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5, size = base_size * 1.25, color = "black"))
    )
  }

  if (is.null(fill_lim)) {
    fill_lim <- max(abs(dat$logFC), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(fill_lim) || fill_lim <= 0) fill_lim <- 1
  }

  if (is.null(pathway_levels)) pathway_levels <- levels(dat$pathway_wrapped)

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = gene_rank, y = pathway_wrapped, fill = logFC)) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.35, width = 0.95, height = 0.86) +
    geom_text(aes(label = gene_label_short), size = tile_label_size, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    facet_grid(. ~ comparison_side) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = pathway_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      name = "logFC",
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-fill_lim, fill_lim),
      oob = scales::squish,
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        direction = "horizontal",
        title.position = "top",
        barheight = grid::unit(3.2, "mm"),
        barwidth  = grid::unit(34, "mm")
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(genes_per_pathway),
      limits = c(0.5, genes_per_pathway + 0.5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Selected shared pathway genes", y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = base_size * 1.38, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 6)),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size * 1.08, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 3, r = 2, b = 3, l = 2)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.65),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = base_size * 0.95, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = base_size * 0.88, color = "black", lineheight = 0.92),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size * 0.96, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size * 0.9, color = "black"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 9, 5, 5)
    )
}

save_panel_png <- function(file, plot, width_px = 6200, height_px = 4000, res = 600) {
  ggsave(
    file,
    plot,
    width = width_px / res,
    height = height_px / res,
    dpi = res,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  invisible(file)
}

save_magick_as_pdf <- function(img, file, width_in = 22, height_in = 15) {
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(filename = file, width = width_in, height = height_in, bg = "white")
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.raster(as.raster(img), x = 0.5, y = 0.5, width = grid::unit(1, "npc"), height = grid::unit(1, "npc"), interpolate = TRUE)
  invisible(file)
}
