```{r panel_venns_heatmaps_kegg_bubbles_drortholog}
  tibble(
    pathway = "placeholder",
    pct = 0,
    nPath = 1,
    neglogFDR = 1
  )
}

p_for_leg <- bubble_plot(
  legend_source,
  "Legend",
  size_lim = size_lim_all,
  fill_lim = fill_lim_all,
  x_lim = x_lim_all,
  top_n = 15,
  base_size = 14.2,
  size_range = c(3.4, 9.2)
) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

bubble_size_leg_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p_for_leg +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")
    )
)

bubble_fdr_leg_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p_for_leg +
    guides(size = "none") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")
    )
)

bubble_size_legend_file <- "panel_out/shared_bubble_size_legend.png"
bubble_fdr_legend_file  <- "panel_out/shared_bubble_fdr_legend.png"

ggsave(
  bubble_size_legend_file,
  cowplot::ggdraw(bubble_size_leg_grob),
  width = 4.8,
  height = 1.25,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  bubble_fdr_legend_file,
  cowplot::ggdraw(bubble_fdr_leg_grob),
  width = 4.8,
  height = 1.25,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

shared_bubble_size_leg_img <- image_read(bubble_size_legend_file)
shared_bubble_fdr_leg_img  <- image_read(bubble_fdr_legend_file)

# ================================================================
# 16. Save retained individual panels
# ================================================================

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/venn_hyp.png",
  p_venn_hyp
)

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/venn_ilop.png",
  p_venn_ilos
)

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/heat_hyp.png",
  p_heat_hyp
)

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/heat_ilop.png",
  p_heat_ilos
)

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/bub_hyp.png",
  p_bub_hyp
)

save_panel_png(
  "panel_out/bub_ilop.png",
  p_bub_ilos
)

# ================================================================
# 17. Assemble revised 3-row × 2-column figure
#
# A = Hypoxia Venn
# B = ILOP Venn
# C = Hypoxia direction heatmap
# D = ILOP direction heatmap
# E = Hypoxia KEGG
# F = ILOP KEGG
# ================================================================

venn_hyp  <- image_read("panel_out/venn_hyp.png")
venn_ilos <- image_read("panel_out/venn_ilop.png")

heat_hyp  <- image_read("panel_out/heat_hyp.png")
heat_ilos <- image_read("panel_out/heat_ilop.png")

bub_hyp   <- image_read("panel_out/bub_hyp.png")
bub_ilos  <- image_read("panel_out/bub_ilop.png")

target_width <- max(
  image_info(venn_hyp)$width,
  image_info(venn_ilos)$width,
  image_info(heat_hyp)$width,
  image_info(heat_ilos)$width,
  image_info(bub_hyp)$width,
  image_info(bub_ilos)$width
)

resize_to_width <- function(img) {
  image_scale(img, paste0(target_width, "x"))
}

imgs_top <- lapply(
  list(venn_hyp, venn_ilos),
  resize_to_width
)

imgs_mid <- lapply(
  list(heat_hyp, heat_ilos),
  resize_to_width
)

imgs_bot <- lapply(
  list(bub_hyp, bub_ilos),
  resize_to_width
)

spacer_top <- image_blank(
  width = 18,
  height = image_info(imgs_top[[1]])$height,
  color = "white"
)

spacer_mid <- image_blank(
  width = 18,
  height = image_info(imgs_mid[[1]])$height,
  color = "white"
)

spacer_bot <- image_blank(
  width = 18,
  height = image_info(imgs_bot[[1]])$height,
  color = "white"
)

row_top <- image_append(
  c(
    imgs_top[[1]],
    spacer_top,
    imgs_top[[2]]
  ),
  stack = FALSE
)

row_mid <- image_append(
  c(
    imgs_mid[[1]],
    spacer_mid,
    imgs_mid[[2]]
  ),
  stack = FALSE
)

row_bot <- image_append(
  c(
    imgs_bot[[1]],
    spacer_bot,
    imgs_bot[[2]]
  ),
  stack = FALSE
)

panel_width <- image_info(row_top)$width

# ================================================================
# Shared legend row
# ================================================================

legend_cell_w <- floor(panel_width / 3)

legend_h <- max(
  image_info(shared_heat_leg_img)$height,
  image_info(shared_bubble_size_leg_img)$height,
  image_info(shared_bubble_fdr_leg_img)$height
)

legend_cell_logfc <- image_extent(
  shared_heat_leg_img,
  geometry = paste0(legend_cell_w, "x", legend_h),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

legend_cell_size <- image_extent(
  shared_bubble_size_leg_img,
  geometry = paste0(legend_cell_w, "x", legend_h),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

legend_cell_fdr <- image_extent(
  shared_bubble_fdr_leg_img,
  geometry = paste0(legend_cell_w, "x", legend_h),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

bottom_legend_row <- image_append(
  c(
    legend_cell_logfc,
    legend_cell_size,
    legend_cell_fdr
  ),
  stack = FALSE
)

bottom_legend_row <- image_extent(
  bottom_legend_row,
  geometry = paste0(panel_width, "x", legend_h),
  color = "white",
  gravity = "center"
)

v_spacer_h <- 34

v_spacer_1 <- image_blank(
  width = panel_width,
  height = v_spacer_h,
  color = "white"
)

v_spacer_2 <- image_blank(
  width = panel_width,
  height = v_spacer_h,
  color = "white"
)

bottom_legend_spacer <- image_blank(
  width = panel_width,
  height = 28,
  color = "white"
)

final_panel <- image_append(
  c(
    row_top,
    v_spacer_1,
    row_mid,
    v_spacer_2,
    row_bot,
    bottom_legend_spacer,
    bottom_legend_row
  ),
  stack = TRUE
)

# ================================================================
# 18. Add revised A–F panel labels
# ================================================================

row_top_h <- image_info(row_top)$height
row_mid_h <- image_info(row_mid)$height

y_top <- 0
y_mid <- row_top_h + v_spacer_h
y_bot <- row_top_h + v_spacer_h + row_mid_h + v_spacer_h

label_specs <- tibble(
  label = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  x_frac = rep(c(0.02, 0.52), times = 3),
  y_abs = c(
    rep(y_top + 35, 2),
    rep(y_mid + 35, 2),
    rep(y_bot + 35, 2)
  )
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(label_specs))) {
  final_panel <- image_annotate(
    final_panel,
    label_specs$label[i],
    size = 105,
    weight = 700,
    color = "black",
    boxcolor = "white",
    gravity = "northwest",
    location = paste0(
      "+",
      round(
        label_specs$x_frac[i] *
          image_info(final_panel)$width
      ),
      "+",
      round(label_specs$y_abs[i])
    )
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 19. Save revised output
# ================================================================

png_out <- paste0(
  "panel_out/",
  "Panel_Venn_DirectionHeatmaps_KEGGBubbles_",
  "Hypoxia_ILOP_2COL_FINAL_LABELED.png"
)

pdf_out <- paste0(
  "panel_out/",
  "Panel_Venn_DirectionHeatmaps_KEGGBubbles_",
  "Hypoxia_ILOP_2COL_FINAL_LABELED.pdf"
)

image_write(
  final_panel,
  png_out,
  format = "png"
)

save_magick_as_pdf(
  final_panel,
  pdf_out,
  width_in = 15,
  height_in = 15
)

cat(
  "\nSaved revised two-column panel:\n",
  "  ", png_out, "\n",
  "  ", pdf_out, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat("\nGenerated file check:\n")

print(
  file.info(
    c(
      "panel_out/venn_hyp.png",
      "panel_out/venn_ilop.png",
      "panel_out/heat_hyp.png",
      "panel_out/heat_ilop.png",
      "panel_out/bub_hyp.png",
      "panel_out/bub_ilop.png",
      png_out,
      pdf_out
    )
  )[, c("size", "mtime")]
)

final_panel
```

## Inspecting the shared pathways more closely
```{r}
# ================================================================
# FULL GENE-LEVEL INSPECTION OF FIGURE 5 SHARED KEGG PATHWAYS
#
# Run this AFTER the complete Figure 5 code.
#
# Uses existing Figure 5 objects:
#
#   Hypoxia:
#     tid_hyp
#     ek_hyp
#     hyp_input$query_link
#     std_MAC_H
#     std_ACE_H
#
#   ILOP:
#     tid_ilos
#     ek_ilos
#     ilos_input$query_link
#     std_MAC_I
#     std_ACE_I
#
# For each of the same top 15 pathways displayed in Figure 5,
# this exports:
#
#   1. Complete Entrez-to-DrOrtholog mapping audit
#   2. One-row-per-shared-DrOrtholog comparison table
#   3. Full MAC–ACE heatmap
#   4. MAC-versus-ACE scatterplot
#   5. Combined inspection figure
#   6. Run log and per-pathway ERROR.txt files if needed
#
# No KEGG enrichment is rerun.
# No shared ortholog set is reconstructed.
# ================================================================


# ================================================================
# 0. Packages
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
})

select <- dplyr::select


# ================================================================
# 1. Confirm required Figure 5 objects exist
# ================================================================

required_fig5_objects <- c(
  "tid_hyp",
  "tid_ilos",
  "ek_hyp",
  "ek_ilos",
  "hyp_input",
  "ilos_input",
  "std_MAC_H",
  "std_ACE_H",
  "std_MAC_I",
  "std_ACE_I"
)

missing_fig5_objects <- required_fig5_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_fig5_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    envir = .GlobalEnv
  )
]

if (length(missing_fig5_objects)) {
  stop(
    "The following Figure 5 objects are missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_fig5_objects,
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n\nRun the complete Figure 5 code first."
  )
}


# ================================================================
# 2. Settings
# ================================================================

TOP_N_PATHWAYS <- 15

# All genes are plotted, but only this many are labeled on scatterplots.
SCATTER_LABEL_N <- 20

# Fixed heatmap color scale.
# Set to NULL to use a separate observed range for each pathway.
FIXED_LOGFC_LIMIT <- 3

inspection_out_dir <- file.path(
  "panel_out",
  "Fig5_full_shared_pathway_gene_inspection"
)

dir.create(
  inspection_out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ================================================================
# 3. Connect directly to existing Figure 5 objects
# ================================================================

fig5_inspection_objects <- list(

  Hypoxia = list(
    tidy_kegg = tid_hyp,
    full_kegg = ek_hyp,
    query_link = hyp_input$query_link,
    mac_deg = std_MAC_H,
    ace_deg = std_ACE_H
  ),

  ILOS = list(
    tidy_kegg = tid_ilos,
    full_kegg = ek_ilos,
    query_link = ilos_input$query_link,
    mac_deg = std_MAC_I,
    ace_deg = std_ACE_I
  )
)


# ================================================================
# 4. Small helpers
# ================================================================

safe_filename <- function(x) {

  x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_"
    ) |>
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "^_+|_+$",
      ""
    ) |>
    stringr::str_sub(
      1,
      90
    )
}


clean_character_values <- function(x) {

  x <- unique(
    as.character(x)
  )

  x[
    !is.na(x) &
      nzchar(x)
  ]
}


# ================================================================
# 5. Obtain the exact top pathways used in Figure 5
#
# Figure 5:
#   - selects the top 15 using neglogFDR
#   - displays the selected pathways vertically by pct
#
# figure_rank below represents the top-to-bottom order in Fig. 5.
# ================================================================

get_fig5_top_pathways <- function(
    treatment,
    top_n = TOP_N_PATHWAYS
) {

  tid_tbl <- fig5_inspection_objects[[treatment]]$tidy_kegg

  if (
    is.null(tid_tbl) ||
    !nrow(tid_tbl)
  ) {
    stop(
      "No Figure 5 KEGG table found for ",
      treatment,
      "."
    )
  }

  selected <- keep_top(
    tid_tbl,
    top_n = top_n,
    by = "neglogFDR"
  )

  selected |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(pct),
      dplyr::desc(neglogFDR),
      dplyr::desc(nPath),
      pathway
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      figure_rank = dplyr::row_number(),
      .before = 1
    )
}


# ================================================================
# 6. Extract all shared genes associated with one pathway
#
# Mapping chain:
#
#   Figure 5 enrichment Entrez ID
#       -> Figure 5 query_link
#       -> DrOrtholog
#       -> MAC logFC
#       -> ACE logFC
#
# No six-gene limit is applied.
# ================================================================

extract_full_shared_pathway_genes <- function(
    treatment,
    pathway_id
) {

  obj <- fig5_inspection_objects[[treatment]]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # A. Full KEGG result table
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  full_kegg_tbl <- as.data.frame(
    obj$full_kegg
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble()

  pathway_row <- full_kegg_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$ID == pathway_id
    )

  if (!nrow(pathway_row)) {
    stop(
      "Pathway ",
      pathway_id,
      " was not found in the full KEGG enrichment table for ",
      treatment,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # B. Entrez IDs that contributed to this enrichment result
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pathway_entrez <- pathway_row |>
    dplyr::select(
      ID,
      Description,
      geneID,
      Count,
      GeneRatio,
      pvalue,
      p.adjust
    ) |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(
      geneID,
      sep = "/"
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      pathway_ID = as.character(ID),
      pathway = as.character(Description),
      ENTREZID = as.character(geneID),
      pathway_Count = as.numeric(Count),
      GeneRatio = as.character(GeneRatio),
      pathway_pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
      pathway_FDR = as.numeric(p.adjust)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(ENTREZID),
      nzchar(ENTREZID)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  if (!nrow(pathway_entrez)) {
    stop(
      "No Entrez genes were recovered from ",
      pathway_id,
      " for ",
      treatment,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # C. Existing MAC expression table from Figure 5
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mac_expression <- obj$mac_deg |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      MAC_input_gene = as.character(input_gene),
      MAC_key = as.character(key),
      MAC_logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      MAC_direction = as.character(direction)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(DrOrtholog),
      nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
      DrOrtholog,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # D. Existing ACE expression table from Figure 5
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  ace_expression <- obj$ace_deg |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      ACE_input_gene = as.character(input_gene),
      ACE_key = as.character(key),
      ACE_logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      ACE_direction = as.character(direction)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(DrOrtholog),
      nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
      DrOrtholog,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # E. Existing Entrez-to-DrOrtholog link from Figure 5
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  query_link <- obj$query_link |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID),
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      MAC_mapping_key = as.character(MAC_key),
      SYMBOL = as.character(SYMBOL)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(ENTREZID),
      nzchar(ENTREZID)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # F. Complete mapping audit
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  audit <- pathway_entrez |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      query_link,
      by = "ENTREZID",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      recovered_DrOrtholog =
        !is.na(DrOrtholog) &
        nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      mac_expression,
      by = "DrOrtholog"
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      ace_expression,
      by = "DrOrtholog"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      has_MAC_expression =
        !is.na(MAC_logFC),

      has_ACE_expression =
        !is.na(ACE_logFC),

      has_both_expression =
        has_MAC_expression &
        has_ACE_expression
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      ENTREZID,
      DrOrtholog
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # G. One comparison row per shared DrOrtholog
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  comparison_base <- audit |>
    dplyr::filter(
      recovered_DrOrtholog,
      has_both_expression
    )

  if (!nrow(comparison_base)) {

    comparison <- tibble::tibble(
      pathway_ID = character(),
      pathway = character(),
      DrOrtholog = character(),
      ENTREZID_list = character(),
      SYMBOL_list = character(),
      MAC_mapping_key = character(),
      n_Entrez_mappings = integer(),
      MAC_input_gene = character(),
      MAC_key = character(),
      MAC_logFC = numeric(),
      ACE_input_gene = character(),
      ACE_key = character(),
      ACE_logFC = numeric(),
      gene_label = character(),
      direction_class = character(),
      opposite_direction = logical(),
      opposition_score = numeric(),
      combined_abs_logFC = numeric(),
      gene_order = integer()
    )

  } else {

    comparison <- comparison_base |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        DrOrtholog
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        pathway_ID =
          dplyr::first(pathway_ID),

        pathway =
          dplyr::first(pathway),

        ENTREZID_list = {
          x <- clean_character_values(
            ENTREZID
          )

          if (length(x)) {
            paste(
              sort(x),
              collapse = ";"
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        },

        SYMBOL_list = {
          x <- clean_character_values(
            SYMBOL
          )

          if (length(x)) {
            paste(
              sort(x),
              collapse = ";"
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        },

        MAC_mapping_key = {
          x <- clean_character_values(
            MAC_mapping_key
          )

          if (length(x)) {
            paste(
              sort(x),
              collapse = ";"
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        },

        n_Entrez_mappings =
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            ENTREZID[
              !is.na(ENTREZID) &
                nzchar(ENTREZID)
            ]
          ),

        MAC_input_gene =
          dplyr::first(MAC_input_gene),

        MAC_key =
          dplyr::first(MAC_key),

        MAC_logFC =
          dplyr::first(MAC_logFC),

        ACE_input_gene =
          dplyr::first(ACE_input_gene),

        ACE_key =
          dplyr::first(ACE_key),

        ACE_logFC =
          dplyr::first(ACE_logFC),

        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        gene_label = dplyr::case_when(
          !is.na(SYMBOL_list) &
            nzchar(SYMBOL_list) ~
            SYMBOL_list,

          !is.na(MAC_mapping_key) &
            nzchar(MAC_mapping_key) ~
            MAC_mapping_key,

          !is.na(MAC_key) &
            nzchar(MAC_key) ~
            MAC_key,

          !is.na(ACE_key) &
            nzchar(ACE_key) ~
            ACE_key,

          TRUE ~
            DrOrtholog
        ),

        gene_label = stringr::str_to_upper(
          gene_label
        ),

        direction_class = dplyr::case_when(
          MAC_logFC > 0 &
            ACE_logFC > 0 ~
            "Both up",

          MAC_logFC < 0 &
            ACE_logFC < 0 ~
            "Both down",

          sign(MAC_logFC) !=
            sign(ACE_logFC) ~
            "Opposite",

          TRUE ~
            "Other"
        ),

        opposite_direction =
          direction_class == "Opposite",

        opposition_score =
          abs(
            MAC_logFC -
              ACE_logFC
          ),

        combined_abs_logFC =
          abs(MAC_logFC) +
          abs(ACE_logFC)
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(opposite_direction),
        dplyr::desc(opposition_score),
        dplyr::desc(combined_abs_logFC),
        gene_label
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        gene_order = dplyr::row_number()
      )
  }

  list(
    audit = audit,
    comparison = comparison
  )
}


# ================================================================
# 7. Full MAC–ACE heatmap
# ================================================================

make_full_pathway_heatmap <- function(
    comparison,
    pathway_name,
    treatment_display,
    fill_limit
) {

  if (!nrow(comparison)) {

    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(
          title = paste0(
            pathway_name,
            " — ",
            treatment_display
          ),
          subtitle = "No shared pathway genes recovered"
        )
    )
  }

  gene_levels <- comparison |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      gene_order
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(
      gene_label
    ) |>
    unique()

  heatmap_data <- comparison |>
    dplyr::select(
      gene_label,
      MAC_logFC,
      ACE_logFC,
      direction_class,
      gene_order
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        MAC_logFC,
        ACE_logFC
      ),
      names_to = "species",
      values_to = "logFC"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      species = dplyr::recode(
        species,
        MAC_logFC = "MAC",
        ACE_logFC = "ACE"
      ),

      species = factor(
        species,
        levels = c(
          "MAC",
          "ACE"
        )
      ),

      gene_label = factor(
        gene_label,
        levels = rev(gene_levels)
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = species,
      y = gene_label,
      fill = logFC
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf(
          "%.2f",
          logFC
        )
      ),
      size = 3,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      name = "logFC",
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(
        -fill_limit,
        fill_limit
      ),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        pathway_name,
        " — ",
        treatment_display
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        nrow(comparison),
        " shared DrOrthologs recovered"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "black"
      ),

      panel.grid = element_blank(),

      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.6
      ),

      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}


# ================================================================
# 8. MAC-versus-ACE scatterplot
# ================================================================

make_pathway_scatter <- function(
    comparison,
    pathway_name,
    treatment_display,
    axis_limit,
    label_n = SCATTER_LABEL_N
) {

  if (!nrow(comparison)) {

    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(
          title = paste0(
            pathway_name,
            " — ",
            treatment_display
          ),
          subtitle = "No shared pathway genes recovered"
        )
    )
  }

  label_data <- comparison |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(opposition_score),
      dplyr::desc(combined_abs_logFC)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n = min(
        label_n,
        nrow(comparison)
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    comparison,
    aes(
      x = MAC_logFC,
      y = ACE_logFC,
      color = direction_class
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey55"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey55"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.55,
      color = "grey45"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3.2,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Both up" = "#B2182B",
        "Both down" = "#2166AC",
        "Opposite" = "#762A83",
        "Other" = "grey60"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = c(
        -axis_limit,
        axis_limit
      ),
      ylim = c(
        -axis_limit,
        axis_limit
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        pathway_name,
        " — ",
        treatment_display
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Labels show the ",
        min(
          label_n,
          nrow(comparison)
        ),
        " largest MAC–ACE differences"
      ),
      x = "MAC logFC",
      y = "ACE logFC",
      color = "Expression class"
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),

      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  if (
    requireNamespace(
      "ggrepel",
      quietly = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    p <- p +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = label_data,
        aes(
          label = gene_label
        ),
        size = 3,
        color = "black",
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        min.segment.length = 0,
        box.padding = 0.3,
        point.padding = 0.2,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )

  } else {

    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        data = label_data,
        aes(
          label = gene_label
        ),
        size = 2.7,
        color = "black",
        check_overlap = TRUE,
        nudge_y = 0.08,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }

  p
}


# ================================================================
# 9. Process all Figure 5 pathways for one treatment
# ================================================================

run_full_pathway_inspection <- function(
    treatment,
    top_n = TOP_N_PATHWAYS
) {

  treatment_display <- ifelse(
    treatment == "ILOS",
    "ILOP",
    treatment
  )

  treatment_dir <- file.path(
    inspection_out_dir,
    treatment_display
  )

  dir.create(
    treatment_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  top_pathways <- get_fig5_top_pathways(
    treatment = treatment,
    top_n = top_n
  )

  write.csv(
    top_pathways,
    file.path(
      treatment_dir,
      paste0(
        treatment_display,
        "_Fig5_top",
        top_n,
        "_pathways.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  run_log <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = nrow(top_pathways)
  )

  for (
    i in seq_len(
      nrow(top_pathways)
    )
  ) {

    pathway_id <- top_pathways$ID[[i]]
    pathway_name <- top_pathways$pathway[[i]]
    figure_rank <- top_pathways$figure_rank[[i]]

    rank_label <- sprintf(
      "%02d",
      figure_rank
    )

    safe_name <- safe_filename(
      pathway_name
    )

    pathway_dir <- file.path(
      treatment_dir,
      paste0(
        rank_label,
        "_",
        pathway_id,
        "_",
        safe_name
      )
    )

    dir.create(
      pathway_dir,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )

    message(
      "\n[",
      treatment_display,
      "] ",
      i,
      "/",
      nrow(top_pathways),
      ": ",
      pathway_name,
      " [",
      pathway_id,
      "]"
    )

    result <- tryCatch(
      {

        extracted <- extract_full_shared_pathway_genes(
          treatment = treatment,
          pathway_id = pathway_id
        )

        audit <- extracted$audit
        comparison <- extracted$comparison

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Save mapping tables before making any plots
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        write.csv(
          audit,
          file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            paste0(
              safe_name,
              "_complete_mapping_audit.csv"
            )
          ),
          row.names = FALSE
        )

        write.csv(
          comparison,
          file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            paste0(
              safe_name,
              "_shared_DrOrtholog_expression_comparison.csv"
            )
          ),
          row.names = FALSE
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Plot scale
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        observed_values <- c(
          comparison$MAC_logFC,
          comparison$ACE_logFC
        )

        observed_values <- observed_values[
          is.finite(observed_values)
        ]

        observed_limit <- if (
          length(observed_values)
        ) {
          max(
            abs(observed_values)
          )
        } else {
          1
        }

        if (
          !is.finite(observed_limit) ||
          observed_limit <= 0
        ) {
          observed_limit <- 1
        }

        plot_limit <- if (
          is.null(FIXED_LOGFC_LIMIT)
        ) {
          observed_limit
        } else {
          FIXED_LOGFC_LIMIT
        }

        scatter_limit <- max(
          plot_limit,
          observed_limit
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Make plots
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        p_heatmap <- make_full_pathway_heatmap(
          comparison = comparison,
          pathway_name = pathway_name,
          treatment_display = treatment_display,
          fill_limit = plot_limit
        )

        p_scatter <- make_pathway_scatter(
          comparison = comparison,
          pathway_name = pathway_name,
          treatment_display = treatment_display,
          axis_limit = scatter_limit
        )

        heatmap_height <- max(
          4.5,
          0.28 *
            nrow(comparison) +
            1.8
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Save heatmap
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        ggsave(
          filename = file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            paste0(
              safe_name,
              "_full_MAC_ACE_heatmap.png"
            )
          ),
          plot = p_heatmap,
          width = 5.5,
          height = heatmap_height,
          dpi = 400,
          bg = "white",
          limitsize = FALSE
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Save scatterplot
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        ggsave(
          filename = file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            paste0(
              safe_name,
              "_MAC_vs_ACE_scatter.png"
            )
          ),
          plot = p_scatter,
          width = 7,
          height = 6.5,
          dpi = 400,
          bg = "white"
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Save combined plot
        # ------------------------------------------------------

        combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
          p_heatmap,
          p_scatter,
          labels = c(
            "A",
            "B"
          ),
          nrow = 1,
          rel_widths = c(
            0.9,
            1.25
          ),
          label_size = 16,
          label_fontface = "bold"
        )

        ggsave(
          filename = file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            paste0(
              safe_name,
              "_combined_gene_inspection.png"
            )
          ),
          plot = combined_plot,
          width = 13,
          height = max(
            6.5,
            heatmap_height
          ),
          dpi = 400,
          bg = "white",
          limitsize = FALSE
        )

        list(
          status = "success",

          n_kegg_entrez =
            dplyr::n_distinct(
              audit$ENTREZID
            ),

          n_entrez_recovered =
            dplyr::n_distinct(
              audit$ENTREZID[
                !is.na(audit$recovered_DrOrtholog) &
                  audit$recovered_DrOrtholog
              ]
            ),

          n_shared_drortholog =
            dplyr::n_distinct(
              comparison$DrOrtholog
            ),

          n_opposite =
            sum(
              comparison$direction_class ==
                "Opposite",
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),

          n_both_up =
            sum(
              comparison$direction_class ==
                "Both up",
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),

          n_both_down =
            sum(
              comparison$direction_class ==
                "Both down",
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
      },

      error = function(e) {

        error_message <- conditionMessage(
          e
        )

        message(
          "\nERROR for ",
          pathway_name,
          " [",
          pathway_id,
          "]:\n",
          error_message,
          "\n"
        )

        writeLines(
          error_message,
          con = file.path(
            pathway_dir,
            "ERROR.txt"
          )
        )

        list(
          status = paste0(
            "error: ",
            error_message
          ),

          n_kegg_entrez = NA_integer_,
          n_entrez_recovered = NA_integer_,
          n_shared_drortholog = NA_integer_,
          n_opposite = NA_integer_,
          n_both_up = NA_integer_,
          n_both_down = NA_integer_
        )
      }
    )

    run_log[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
      figure_rank = figure_rank,
      treatment = treatment_display,
      pathway_ID = pathway_id,
      pathway = pathway_name,
      pct = top_pathways$pct[[i]],
      nPath = top_pathways$nPath[[i]],
      neglogFDR = top_pathways$neglogFDR[[i]],
      FDR = top_pathways$p.adjust[[i]],

      KEGG_Entrez_in_enrichment =
        result$n_kegg_entrez,

      KEGG_Entrez_recovered_to_DrOrtholog =
        result$n_entrez_recovered,

      shared_DrOrthologs_with_both_logFC =
        result$n_shared_drortholog,

      opposite_direction =
        result$n_opposite,

      both_up =
        result$n_both_up,

      both_down =
        result$n_both_down,

      status =
        result$status,

      output_folder =
        pathway_dir
    )
  }

  run_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    run_log
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      figure_rank
    )

  write.csv(
    run_log,
    file.path(
      treatment_dir,
      paste0(
        treatment_display,
        "_full_pathway_inspection_run_log.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  run_log
}


# ================================================================
# 10. Run Hypoxia and ILOP
# ================================================================

hypoxia_inspection_log <- run_full_pathway_inspection(
  treatment = "Hypoxia",
  top_n = TOP_N_PATHWAYS
)

ilop_inspection_log <- run_full_pathway_inspection(
  treatment = "ILOS",
  top_n = TOP_N_PATHWAYS
)

all_inspection_logs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  hypoxia_inspection_log,
  ilop_inspection_log
)

write.csv(
  all_inspection_logs,
  file.path(
    inspection_out_dir,
    "Fig5_full_shared_pathway_inspection_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(
  all_inspection_logs,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

cat(
  "\n=== Run status ===\n"
)

all_inspection_logs |>
  dplyr::select(
    treatment,
    pathway,
    status
  ) |>
  print(
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )

message(
  "\nFull shared-pathway gene inspection written to:\n",
  normalizePath(
    inspection_out_dir,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  )
)
```

Analysis of phenotypic correlations with module expression in WGCNA. 
```{r trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_ACE, cache=TRUE, dependson="construct_gene_network_WGCNA_ACE"}
# ACE Module-Trait Correlation Analysis (final corrected version)

library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Load trait data
traitData <- id
Samples_ACE = rownames(Expr_ACE)
traitRows_ACE = match(Samples_ACE, traitData$SampleID)
Traits0_ACE = traitData[traitRows_ACE, ]

# Format traits
Traits_ACE <- Traits0_ACE[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "Heart_mass_g")]
Traits_ACE$HeartMass_Ratio = Traits_ACE$Heart_mass_g / Traits_ACE$Mass_g
Traits_ACE = Traits_ACE[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "HeartMass_Ratio")]
Traits_ACE = as.data.frame(Traits_ACE)
rownames(Traits_ACE) = Samples_ACE

# Calculate Module Eigengenes
MEs0_ACE = moduleEigengenes(Expr_ACE, moduleColors_ACE)$eigengenes
MEs_ACE = orderMEs(MEs0_ACE)

# Initialize matrices
nModules = ncol(MEs_ACE)
nTraits = ncol(Traits_ACE)

moduleTraitCor_ACE = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                            dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_ACE), colnames(Traits_ACE)))
moduleTraitPvalue_ACE = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                               dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_ACE), colnames(Traits_ACE)))
traitSampleSizes_ACE = setNames(rep(NA, nTraits), colnames(Traits_ACE))

# No excluded samples for ACE
excluded_samples <- c()

# Trait-by-trait correlation
for (trait in colnames(Traits_ACE)) {
  
  valid_samples = !is.na(Traits_ACE[[trait]]) &
                  !(rownames(Traits_ACE) %in% excluded_samples)
  
  if (sum(valid_samples) >= 2) {
    MEs_sub = MEs_ACE[valid_samples, , drop = FALSE]
    Trait_sub = as.numeric(Traits_ACE[[trait]][valid_samples])
    
    cor_mat = cor(MEs_sub, Trait_sub, use = "p")
    p_mat = corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nSamples = sum(valid_samples))
    
    moduleTraitCor_ACE[, trait] = cor_mat[, 1]
    moduleTraitPvalue_ACE[, trait] = p_mat[, 1]
    
    traitSampleSizes_ACE[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    if (sum(valid_samples) < 3) {
      message("⚠️ Warning: very few samples for trait ", trait, " (n = ", sum(valid_samples), ")")
    }
    
  } else {
    moduleTraitCor_ACE[, trait] = NA
    moduleTraitPvalue_ACE[, trait] = NA
    traitSampleSizes_ACE[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    message("⏭️ Skipping trait ", trait, " due to < 2 valid samples.")
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for FDR
moduleTraitFDR_ACE = apply(moduleTraitPvalue_ACE, 2, p.adjust, method = "fdr")

# Create significance labels based on raw p-values
sig_labels_ACE = matrix("", nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
sig_labels_ACE[moduleTraitPvalue_ACE < 0.001] = "***"
sig_labels_ACE[moduleTraitPvalue_ACE >= 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue_ACE < 0.01] = "**"

colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_ACE) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_ACE)
colnames(heat_text_ACE) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_ACE)

# Save correlation table
corr_table_ACE <- data.frame(
```

Next, we want to test for a significant effect of treatment on module expression using ANOVA tests with bonferroni correction. 

```{r run_ANOVAs_on_trait_correlations_ACE, cache=TRUE, dependson="trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_ACE"}

## code from Plachetzki et al 2014

# ACE ANOVA on Module Eigengene Expression by Treatment (Panel Figure Output)
# ACE Module Expression ANOVA by Treatment (all + significant panels, Bonferroni corrected, posthoc letters)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)

# 1. Prepare data
ME_ACE = MEs_ACE
ME_ACE$SampleID = rownames(MEs_ACE)
ME_info_ACE = merge(ME_ACE, id, by = "SampleID")

# 2. Define modules to test
modules_to_test = colnames(MEs_ACE)

# 3. Initialize storage
anova_results_list = list()
all_scatter_list = list()
sig_scatter_list = list()
raw_pvals = c()

# 4. Run ANOVA for each module
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = lm(ME_info_ACE[[mod]] ~ ME_info_ACE$Treatment)
  aov_table = anova(model)
  
  # Extract raw p-value
  pval = aov_table$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  raw_pvals = c(raw_pvals, pval)
  
  # Save models and ANOVA tables
  anova_results_list[[mod]] = list(model = model, aov = aov_table)
}

# 5. Bonferroni correction
pvals_bonf = p.adjust(raw_pvals, method = "bonferroni")
names(pvals_bonf) = modules_to_test

# 6. Create plots
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = anova_results_list[[mod]]$model
  
  # Always prepare the plot
  p = ggplot(ME_info_ACE, aes(x=Treatment, y=.data[[mod]], fill=Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', position=position_dodge(1), dotsize=0.5) +
    labs(y = paste0(mod, " Expression"), x = "Treatment") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1),
          plot.title = element_text(size=10)) +
    ggtitle(paste0(mod, ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.001, " ***",
                               ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.01, " **",
                                      ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05, " *", "")))))
  
  all_scatter_list[[length(all_scatter_list) + 1]] = p
  
  # If significant after Bonferroni, add posthoc letters and include in significant panel
  if (pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05) {
    
    emm = emmeans(model, ~ Treatment)
    cld = multcomp::cld(emm, Letters=letters, adjust="tukey")
    
    p_sig = p +
      geom_text(data=cld, aes(x=Treatment, y=max(ME_info_ACE[[mod]], na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05, label=.group),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust=0)
    
    sig_scatter_list[[length(sig_scatter_list) + 1]] = p_sig
  }
}

# 7. Save ANOVA results
anova_results_df = data.frame(
  Module = modules_to_test,
  Raw_Pval = raw_pvals,
  Bonferroni_Pval = pvals_bonf
)
write.table(anova_results_df,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/ACE/WGCNA/ACE_table_wgcna_module_ANOVA_results_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# 8. Save full panel figure (all modules)
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/ACE/WGCNA/ACE_panel_all_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2) * 4)

print(ggarrange(plotlist = all_scatter_list, ncol=4, nrow=ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2)))

dev.off()

# 9. Save significant-only panel figure
if (length(sig_scatter_list) > 0) {
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/ACE/WGCNA/ACE_panel_significant_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 10, height = ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = sig_scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2)))
  
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("⚠️ No modules passed Bonferroni p<0.05 for ACE treatment comparisons.")
}
```

Analysis of phenotypic correlations with module expression in WGCNA. 
```{r trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_COR, cache=TRUE, dependson="construct_gene_network_WGCNA_COR"}
# load trait data
traitData <- id
# Trait-module correlation analysis COR: fully corrected
# Load necessary libraries
library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)

# Set up trait and expression data
Samples_COR = rownames(Expr_COR)
traitRows_COR = match(Samples_COR, traitData$SampleID)
Traits0_COR = traitData[traitRows_COR, ]

# Set correct sample IDs for traits
Traits_COR_full <- Traits0_COR[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "Heart_mass_g")]
Traits_COR_full$HeartMass_Ratio = Traits_COR_full$Heart_mass_g / Traits_COR_full$Mass_g
Traits_COR_full = Traits_COR_full[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "HeartMass_Ratio")]
rownames(Traits_COR_full) = Samples_COR  # <<--- THE FIX

Traits_COR_full = as.data.frame(Traits_COR_full)
rownames(Traits_COR_full) = Samples_COR

# Calculate Module Eigengenes
MEs0_COR = moduleEigengenes(Expr_COR, moduleColors_COR)$eigengenes
MEs_COR = orderMEs(MEs0_COR)

# Initialize matrices
nModules = ncol(MEs_COR)
nTraits = ncol(Traits_COR_full)

moduleTraitCor_COR = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                            dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_COR), colnames(Traits_COR_full)))
moduleTraitPvalue_COR = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                               dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_COR), colnames(Traits_COR_full)))
traitSampleSizes_COR = setNames(rep(NA, nTraits), colnames(Traits_COR_full))

# ------------------------------
# Exclude known outliers like COR732
# ------------------------------
excluded_samples <- c("COR732")  # Add any others if needed

# ------------------------------
# Trait-by-trait correlation (excluding outliers)
# ------------------------------
for (trait in colnames(Traits_COR_full)) {
  
  # Exclude NAs and flagged samples
  valid_samples <- !is.na(Traits_COR_full[[trait]]) &
                   !(rownames(Traits_COR_full) %in% excluded_samples)
  
  if (sum(valid_samples) >= 2) {
    MEs_sub <- MEs_COR[valid_samples, , drop = FALSE]
    Trait_sub <- as.numeric(Traits_COR_full[[trait]][valid_samples])
    
    cor_mat <- cor(MEs_sub, Trait_sub, use = "p")
    p_mat <- corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nSamples = sum(valid_samples))
    
    moduleTraitCor_COR[, trait] <- cor_mat[, 1]
    moduleTraitPvalue_COR[, trait] <- p_mat[, 1]
    
    traitSampleSizes_COR[trait] <- sum(valid_samples)
    
    if (sum(valid_samples) < 3) {
      message("⚠️ Warning: very few samples for trait ", trait, " (n = ", sum(valid_samples), ")")
    }
    
  } else {
    moduleTraitCor_COR[, trait] <- NA
    moduleTraitPvalue_COR[, trait] <- NA
    traitSampleSizes_COR[trait] <- sum(valid_samples)
    
    message("⏭️ Skipping trait ", trait, " due to < 2 valid samples.")
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing (trait by trait)
moduleTraitFDR_COR = apply(moduleTraitPvalue_COR, 2, p.adjust, method = "fdr")

# Create human-readable significance labels
sig_labels_COR = matrix("", nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
sig_labels_COR[moduleTraitPvalue_COR < 0.001] = "***"
sig_labels_COR[moduleTraitPvalue_COR >= 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue_COR < 0.01] = "**"
sig_labels_COR[moduleTraitPvalue_COR >= 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue_COR < 0.05] = "*"
sig_labels_COR[moduleTraitPvalue_COR >= 0.05] = ""

# Create display text for heatmap
rm(heat_text_COR)
heat_text_COR = matrix(paste0(
  signif(moduleTraitCor_COR, 2), "\n(p=", signif(moduleTraitPvalue_COR, 2), ")"
), nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
rownames(heat_text_COR) = rownames(moduleTraitCor_COR)
colnames(heat_text_COR) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_COR)

# Add sample sizes to trait names
colnames(moduleTraitCor_COR) = paste0(colnames(moduleTraitCor_COR), "\n(n=", traitSampleSizes_COR, ")")
colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_COR) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_COR)
colnames(heat_text_COR) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_COR)

# Save results table
corr_table_COR <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(moduleTraitCor_COR),
  moduleTraitCor_COR,
  moduleTraitPvalue_COR,
  FDR = moduleTraitFDR_COR
)
write.table(corr_table_COR, file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_table_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot the final heatmap
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_heatmap_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 8)

pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_COR,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_COR,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         fontsize = 12,
         angle_col = 0)
dev.off()


# Console Plot
pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_COR,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_COR,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "COR Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)

# ----------------------------
# Plot scatterplots for significant correlations (COR)
# ----------------------------

library(ggpubr)  # for ggarrange()

# Use raw p-value threshold of 0.05
sig_hits_COR = which(moduleTraitPvalue_COR < 0.05, arr.ind = TRUE)

if (nrow(sig_hits_COR) > 0) {
  scatter_list_COR = list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(sig_hits_COR)) {
    mod = rownames(moduleTraitPvalue_COR)[sig_hits_COR[i, 1]]
    col_with_sample = colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_COR)[sig_hits_COR[i, 2]]

    trait_label_clean = sub("\\n\\(n=.*\\)", "", col_with_sample)
    trait_label_clean = sub("\\n.*", "", trait_label_clean)
    
    # Pull trait and ME values

    x = MEs_COR[[mod]]

    valid = !is.na(y) & !rownames(Traits_COR_full) %in% "COR732"

                                                              aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
      labs(x = mod, y = trait_label_clean) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  }
  
  # Save as panel figure
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_panel_scatterplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = ceiling(length(scatter_list_COR) / 2) * 4)
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_COR, ncol = 4, nrow = length(scatter_list_COR) / 2))
  dev.off()
}


# Console plot
print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_COR, ncol = 4, nrow = length(scatter_list_COR) / 2))
  dev.off()
```


Next, we want to test for a significant effect of treatment on module expression using ANOVA tests with bonferroni correction. 

```{r run_ANOVAs_on_trait_correlations_COR, cache=TRUE, dependson="trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_COR"}

## code from Plachetzki et al 2014

# COR Module Expression ANOVA by Treatment (full + significant panels, Bonferroni corrected, posthoc letters)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)

# 1. Prepare data
ME_COR = MEs_COR
ME_COR$SampleID = rownames(MEs_COR)
ME_info_COR = merge(ME_COR, id, by = "SampleID")

# 2. Exclude known outliers if needed
excluded_samples = c("COR732")  # ← You told me we want to exclude COR732 for COR
ME_info_COR = ME_info_COR[!(ME_info_COR$SampleID %in% excluded_samples), ]

# 3. Define modules to test
modules_to_test = colnames(MEs_COR)

# 4. Initialize storage
anova_results_list = list()
all_scatter_list = list()
sig_scatter_list = list()
raw_pvals = c()

# 5. Run ANOVA for each module
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = lm(ME_info_COR[[mod]] ~ ME_info_COR$Treatment)
  aov_table = anova(model)
  
  # Extract raw p-value
  pval = aov_table$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  raw_pvals = c(raw_pvals, pval)
  
  # Save models and ANOVA tables
  anova_results_list[[mod]] = list(model = model, aov = aov_table)
}

# 6. Bonferroni correction
pvals_bonf = p.adjust(raw_pvals, method = "bonferroni")
names(pvals_bonf) = modules_to_test

# 7. Create plots
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = anova_results_list[[mod]]$model
  
  # Always prepare the plot
  p = ggplot(ME_info_COR, aes(x=Treatment, y=.data[[mod]], fill=Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', position=position_dodge(1), dotsize=0.5) +
    labs(y = paste0(mod, " Expression"), x = "Treatment") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1),
          plot.title = element_text(size=10)) +
    ggtitle(paste0(mod, ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.001, " ***",
                               ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.01, " **",
                                      ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05, " *", "")))))
  
  all_scatter_list[[length(all_scatter_list) + 1]] = p
  
  # If significant after Bonferroni, add posthoc letters and include in significant panel
  if (pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05) {
    
    emm = emmeans(model, ~ Treatment)
    cld = multcomp::cld(emm, Letters=letters, adjust="tukey")
    
    p_sig = p +
      geom_text(data=cld, aes(x=Treatment, y=max(ME_info_COR[[mod]], na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05, label=.group),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust=0)
    
    sig_scatter_list[[length(sig_scatter_list) + 1]] = p_sig
  }
}

# 8. Save ANOVA results
anova_results_df = data.frame(
  Module = modules_to_test,
  Raw_Pval = raw_pvals,
  Bonferroni_Pval = pvals_bonf
)
write.table(anova_results_df,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_table_wgcna_module_ANOVA_results_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# 9. Save full panel figure (all modules)
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_panel_all_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2) * 4)

print(ggarrange(plotlist = all_scatter_list, ncol=4, nrow=ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2)))

dev.off()

# 10. Save significant-only panel figure
if (length(sig_scatter_list) > 0) {
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/COR/WGCNA/COR_panel_significant_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 10, height = ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = sig_scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2)))
  
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("⚠️ No modules passed Bonferroni p<0.05 for COR treatment comparisons.")
}

```

Analysis of phenotypic correlations with module expression in WGCNA. 
```{r trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_GEO, cache=TRUE, dependson="construct_gene_network_WGCNA_GEO"}
# load trait data
traitData <- id

library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)

# Form a data frame analogous to expression data that will hold the phenotypic traits
Samples_GEO = rownames(Expr_GEO)
traitRows_GEO = match(Samples_GEO, traitData$SampleID)
Traits0_GEO = traitData[traitRows_GEO, ]

# Set correct sample IDs for traits
Traits_GEO_full <- Traits0_GEO[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "Heart_mass_g")]
Traits_GEO_full$HeartMass_Ratio = Traits_GEO_full$Heart_mass_g / Traits_GEO_full$Mass_g
Traits_GEO_full = Traits_GEO_full[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "HeartMass_Ratio")]
Traits_GEO_full = as.data.frame(Traits_GEO_full)
rownames(Traits_GEO_full) = Samples_GEO


# Recalculate MEs across all samples
MEs0_GEO = moduleEigengenes(Expr_GEO, moduleColors_GEO)$eigengenes
MEs_GEO = orderMEs(MEs0_GEO)

# Initialize correlation and p-value matrices
nModules = ncol(MEs_GEO)
nTraits = ncol(Traits_GEO_full)

moduleTraitCor_GEO = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                            dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_GEO), colnames(Traits_GEO_full)))
moduleTraitPvalue_GEO = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                               dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_GEO), colnames(Traits_GEO_full)))
traitSampleSizes_GEO = setNames(rep(NA, nTraits), colnames(Traits_GEO_full))

# No known outliers for GEO (right?), so no samples excluded

# Trait-by-trait correlation
for (trait in colnames(Traits_GEO_full)) {
  
  valid_samples = !is.na(Traits_GEO_full[[trait]])
  
  if (sum(valid_samples) >= 2) {
    MEs_sub = MEs_GEO[valid_samples, , drop = FALSE]
    Trait_sub = as.numeric(Traits_GEO_full[[trait]][valid_samples])
    
    cor_mat = cor(MEs_sub, Trait_sub, use = "p")
    p_mat = corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nSamples = sum(valid_samples))
    
    moduleTraitCor_GEO[, trait] = cor_mat[, 1]
    moduleTraitPvalue_GEO[, trait] = p_mat[, 1]
    
    traitSampleSizes_GEO[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    if (sum(valid_samples) < 3) {
      message("⚠️ Warning: very few samples for trait ", trait, " (n = ", sum(valid_samples), ")")
    }
    
  } else {
    moduleTraitCor_GEO[, trait] = NA
    moduleTraitPvalue_GEO[, trait] = NA
    traitSampleSizes_GEO[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    message("⏭️ Skipping trait ", trait, " due to < 2 valid samples.")
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing (trait by trait)
moduleTraitFDR_GEO = apply(moduleTraitPvalue_GEO, 2, p.adjust, method = "fdr")

# Create human-readable significance labels (using raw p-values here)
sig_labels_GEO = matrix("", nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
sig_labels_GEO[moduleTraitPvalue_GEO < 0.001] = "***"
sig_labels_GEO[moduleTraitPvalue_GEO >= 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue_GEO < 0.01] = "**"
sig_labels_GEO[moduleTraitPvalue_GEO >= 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue_GEO < 0.05] = "*"
sig_labels_GEO[moduleTraitPvalue_GEO >= 0.05] = ""

# Create display text for heatmap
heat_text_GEO = matrix(paste0(
  signif(moduleTraitCor_GEO, 2), "\n(p=", signif(moduleTraitPvalue_GEO, 2), ")"
), nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
rownames(heat_text_GEO) = rownames(moduleTraitCor_GEO)
colnames(heat_text_GEO) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GEO)

# Add sample sizes to trait names
colnames(moduleTraitCor_GEO) = paste0(colnames(moduleTraitCor_GEO), "\n(n=", traitSampleSizes_GEO, ")")
colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_GEO) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GEO)
colnames(heat_text_GEO) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GEO)

# Save correlation results
corr_table_GEO = data.frame(
  Module = rownames(moduleTraitCor_GEO),
  moduleTraitCor_GEO,
  moduleTraitPvalue_GEO,
  FDR = moduleTraitFDR_GEO
)

write.table(corr_table_GEO,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/GEO/WGCNA/GEO_table_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot heatmap
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/GEO/WGCNA/GEO_heatmap_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 8)

pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_GEO,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_GEO,#heat_text_GEO,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "GEO Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)

dev.off()

# Console Plot
pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_GEO,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_GEO,#heat_text_GEO,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         angle_col = 0,
         main = "GEO Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         fontsize = 12)


# ----------------------------
# Plot scatterplots for significant correlations (GEO)

library(ggpubr)  # for ggarrange()

# Extract significant correlations (p < 0.05)
sig_hits_GEO = which(moduleTraitPvalue_GEO < 0.05, arr.ind = TRUE)

if (length(sig_hits_GEO) > 0) {
  scatter_list_GEO = list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(sig_hits_GEO)) {

  # Save as panel figure

      width = 8, height = ceiling(length(scatter_list_GEO) / 2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_GEO, ncol = 4, nrow = ceiling(length(scatter_list_GEO) / 2)))
  
  dev.off()
}

#Console Plot
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_GEO, ncol = 4, nrow = ceiling(length(scatter_list_GEO) / 2)))
```

Analysis of phenotypic correlations with module expression in WGCNA. 
```{r trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_GIB, cache=TRUE, dependson="construct_gene_network_WGCNA_GIB"}
# GIB Module-Trait Correlation Analysis (final corrected version)

library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Load trait data
traitData <- id
Samples_GIB = rownames(Expr_GIB)
traitRows_GIB = match(Samples_GIB, traitData$SampleID)
Traits0_GIB = traitData[traitRows_GIB, ]

# Format traits
Traits_GIB <- Traits0_GIB[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "Heart_mass_g")]
Traits_GIB$HeartMass_Ratio = Traits_GIB$Heart_mass_g / Traits_GIB$Mass_g
Traits_GIB = Traits_GIB[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm", "HeartMass_Ratio")]
Traits_GIB = as.data.frame(Traits_GIB)
rownames(Traits_GIB) = Samples_GIB


# Calculate Module Eigengenes
MEs0_GIB = moduleEigengenes(Expr_GIB, moduleColors_GIB)$eigengenes
MEs_GIB = orderMEs(MEs0_GIB)

# Initialize matrices
nModules = ncol(MEs_GIB)
nTraits = ncol(Traits_GIB)

moduleTraitCor_GIB = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                            dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_GIB), colnames(Traits_GIB)))
moduleTraitPvalue_GIB = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                               dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_GIB), colnames(Traits_GIB)))
traitSampleSizes_GIB = setNames(rep(NA, nTraits), colnames(Traits_GIB))

# No excluded samples for GIB
excluded_samples <- c()

# Trait-by-trait correlation
for (trait in colnames(Traits_GIB)) {
  
  valid_samples = !is.na(Traits_GIB[[trait]]) &
                  !(rownames(Traits_GIB) %in% excluded_samples)
  
  if (sum(valid_samples) >= 2) {
    MEs_sub = MEs_GIB[valid_samples, , drop = FALSE]
    Trait_sub = as.numeric(Traits_GIB[[trait]][valid_samples])
    
    cor_mat = cor(MEs_sub, Trait_sub, use = "p")
    p_mat = corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nSamples = sum(valid_samples))
    
    moduleTraitCor_GIB[, trait] = cor_mat[, 1]
    moduleTraitPvalue_GIB[, trait] = p_mat[, 1]
    
    traitSampleSizes_GIB[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    if (sum(valid_samples) < 3) {
      message("⚠️ Warning: very few samples for trait ", trait, " (n = ", sum(valid_samples), ")")
    }
    
  } else {
    moduleTraitCor_GIB[, trait] = NA
    moduleTraitPvalue_GIB[, trait] = NA
    traitSampleSizes_GIB[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    message("⏭️ Skipping trait ", trait, " due to < 2 valid samples.")
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for FDR
moduleTraitFDR_GIB = apply(moduleTraitPvalue_GIB, 2, p.adjust, method = "fdr")

# Create significance labels based on raw p-values
sig_labels_GIB = matrix("", nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
sig_labels_GIB[moduleTraitPvalue_GIB < 0.001] = "***"
sig_labels_GIB[moduleTraitPvalue_GIB >= 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue_GIB < 0.01] = "**"
sig_labels_GIB[moduleTraitPvalue_GIB >= 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue_GIB < 0.1] = "*"
sig_labels_GIB[moduleTraitPvalue_GIB >= 0.05] = ""

# Create display text for heatmap
rm(heat_text_GIB)
heat_text_GIB = matrix(paste0(
  signif(moduleTraitCor_GIB, 2), "\n(p=", signif(moduleTraitPvalue_GIB, 2), ")"
), nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
rownames(heat_text_GIB) = rownames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)
colnames(heat_text_GIB) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)

# Add sample sizes to trait names
colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB) = paste0(colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB), "\n(n=", traitSampleSizes_GIB, ")")
colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_GIB) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)
colnames(heat_text_GIB) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)

# Save correlation table
corr_table_GIB <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(moduleTraitCor_GIB),
  moduleTraitCor_GIB,
  moduleTraitPvalue_GIB,
  FDR = moduleTraitFDR_GIB
)
write.table(corr_table_GIB, file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_table_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot heatmap
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_heatmap_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 8)

pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_GIB,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_GIB,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "GIB Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)

dev.off()

# Console plot
pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_GIB,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_GIB,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "GIB Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)

# ----------------------------
# Plot scatterplots for significant correlations
# ----------------------------

# Extract significant correlations (FDR < 0.05)
sig_hits = which(moduleTraitPvalue_GIB < 0.05, arr.ind = TRUE)

if (length(sig_hits) > 0) {
  scatter_list = list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(sig_hits)) {
    mod = rownames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)[sig_hits[i, 1]]
    trait_label = gsub("\\n\\(n=.*\\)", "", colnames(moduleTraitCor_GIB)[sig_hits[i, 2]])
    trait_label = gsub("\\n.*", "", trait_label)  # remove sample size
    
    y = Traits_GIB[[trait_label]]
    x = MEs_GIB[[mod]]
    
    valid = !is.na(y)
    
    plot = ggplot(data = data.frame(x = x[valid], y = y[valid]), aes(x=x, y=y)) +
      geom_point(size=2) +
      geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="black") +
      labs(x = paste0(mod), y = trait_label) +
      theme_bw()
    
    scatter_list[[length(scatter_list) + 1]] = plot
  }
  
  # Save as panel figure
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_panel_scatterplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 8, height = ceiling(length(scatter_list)/2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(scatter_list)/2)))
  
  dev.off()
}

# Console plot
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(scatter_list)/2)))

```

Next, we want to test for a significant effect of treatment on module expression using ANOVA tests with bonferroni correction. 

```{r run_ANOVAs_on_trait_correlations_GIB, cache=TRUE, dependson="trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_GIB"}

## code from Plachetzki et al 2014

# GIB ANOVA on Module Eigengene Expression by Treatment (Panel Figure Output)
# GIB Module Expression ANOVA by Treatment (all + significant panels, Bonferroni corrected, posthoc letters)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)

# 1. Prepare data
ME_GIB = MEs_GIB
ME_GIB$SampleID = rownames(MEs_GIB)
ME_info_GIB = merge(ME_GIB, id, by = "SampleID")

# 2. Define modules to test
modules_to_test = colnames(MEs_GIB)

# 3. Initialize storage
anova_results_list = list()
all_scatter_list = list()
sig_scatter_list = list()
raw_pvals = c()

# 4. Run ANOVA for each module
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = lm(ME_info_GIB[[mod]] ~ ME_info_GIB$Treatment)
  aov_table = anova(model)
  
  # Extract raw p-value
  pval = aov_table$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  raw_pvals = c(raw_pvals, pval)
  
  # Save models and ANOVA tables
  anova_results_list[[mod]] = list(model = model, aov = aov_table)
}

# 5. Bonferroni correction
pvals_bonf = p.adjust(raw_pvals, method = "bonferroni")
names(pvals_bonf) = modules_to_test

# 6. Create plots
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = anova_results_list[[mod]]$model
  
  # Always prepare the plot
  p = ggplot(ME_info_GIB, aes(x=Treatment, y=.data[[mod]], fill=Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', position=position_dodge(1), dotsize=0.5) +
    labs(y = paste0(mod, " Expression"), x = "Treatment") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1),
          plot.title = element_text(size=10)) +
    ggtitle(paste0(mod, ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.001, " ***",
                               ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.01, " **",
                                      ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05, " *", "")))))
  
  all_scatter_list[[length(all_scatter_list) + 1]] = p
  
  # If significant after Bonferroni, add posthoc letters and include in significant panel
  if (pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05) {
    
    emm = emmeans(model, ~ Treatment)
    cld = multcomp::cld(emm, Letters=letters, adjust="tukey")
    
    p_sig = p +
      geom_text(data=cld, aes(x=Treatment, y=max(ME_info_GIB[[mod]], na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05, label=.group),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust=0)
    
    sig_scatter_list[[length(sig_scatter_list) + 1]] = p_sig
  }
}

# 7. Save ANOVA results
anova_results_df = data.frame(
  Module = modules_to_test,
  Raw_Pval = raw_pvals,
  Bonferroni_Pval = pvals_bonf
)
write.table(anova_results_df,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_table_wgcna_module_ANOVA_results_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# 8. Save full panel figure (all modules)
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_panel_all_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2) * 4)

print(ggarrange(plotlist = all_scatter_list, ncol=4, nrow=ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2)))

dev.off()

# 9. Save significant-only panel figure
if (length(sig_scatter_list) > 0) {
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/GIB/WGCNA/GIB_panel_significant_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 10, height = ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = sig_scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2)))
  
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("⚠️ No modules passed Bonferroni p<0.05 for GIB treatment comparisons.")
}

```

```{r construct_gene_network_WGCNA_MAC, cache=TRUE}
# 1. Get gene-module memberships (kME = correlation with eigengenes)
# 1) Build the table (make sure rows match!)
library(WGCNA)

# Color-named eigengenes
MEs_MAC <- moduleEigengenes(Expr_MAC, colors = moduleColors_MAC)$eigengenes
MEs_MAC <- orderMEs(MEs_MAC)

# kME with color names
kME_color <- as.data.frame(cor(Expr_MAC, MEs_MAC, use = "p"))
colnames(kME_color) <- paste0("kME", sub("^ME", "", colnames(MEs_MAC)))

geneInfo_MAC <- data.frame(
  Gene        = colnames(Expr_MAC),
  ModuleColor = moduleColors_MAC,
  kME_color,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Pick the kME matching each gene's own module color
kmecols <- paste0("kME", geneInfo_MAC$ModuleColor)
idx     <- match(kmecols, colnames(kME_color))
geneInfo_MAC$kME_inModule <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(geneInfo_MAC)), function(i) {
  j <- idx[i]; if (is.na(j)) NA_real_ else kME_color[i, j]
}, numeric(1))

geneInfo_MAC <- geneInfo_MAC[order(geneInfo_MAC$ModuleColor, -abs(geneInfo_MAC$kME_inModule)), ]
write.csv(geneInfo_MAC,
          file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_geneInfo_allModules_", run_date, ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

Analysis of phenotypic correlations with module expression in WGCNA. 
```{r trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_MAC, cache=TRUE, dependson="construct_gene_network_WGCNA_MAC"}
# load trait data
# MAC Module-Trait Correlation Analysis: Corrected (No HeartMass_Ratio)

library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)

# Load trait data
traitData <- id

# Set up trait and expression data
Samples_MAC = rownames(Expr_MAC)
traitRows_MAC = match(Samples_MAC, traitData$SampleID)
Traits0_MAC = traitData[traitRows_MAC, ]

# Correct sample IDs for traits
Traits_MAC_full <- Traits0_MAC[, c("ILOS_torr", "Mass_g", "Length_cm")]  # <-- Only 3 traits!
rownames(Traits_MAC_full) = Samples_MAC
Traits_MAC_full = as.data.frame(Traits_MAC_full)

# Calculate MEs
MEs0_MAC = moduleEigengenes(Expr_MAC, moduleColors_MAC)$eigengenes
MEs_MAC = orderMEs(MEs0_MAC)

# Initialize correlation matrices
nModules = ncol(MEs_MAC)
nTraits = ncol(Traits_MAC_full)

moduleTraitCor_MAC = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                            dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_MAC), colnames(Traits_MAC_full)))
moduleTraitPvalue_MAC = matrix(NA, nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits,
                               dimnames = list(colnames(MEs_MAC), colnames(Traits_MAC_full)))
traitSampleSizes_MAC = setNames(rep(NA, nTraits), colnames(Traits_MAC_full))

# No outlier exclusions for MAC

# Trait-by-trait correlation
for (trait in colnames(Traits_MAC_full)) {
  
  valid_samples = !is.na(Traits_MAC_full[[trait]])
  
  if (sum(valid_samples) >= 2) {
    MEs_sub = MEs_MAC[valid_samples, , drop = FALSE]
    Trait_sub = as.numeric(Traits_MAC_full[[trait]][valid_samples])
    
    cor_mat = cor(MEs_sub, Trait_sub, use = "p")
    p_mat = corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nSamples = sum(valid_samples))
    
    moduleTraitCor_MAC[, trait] = cor_mat[, 1]
    moduleTraitPvalue_MAC[, trait] = p_mat[, 1]
    
    traitSampleSizes_MAC[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    if (sum(valid_samples) < 3) {
      message("⚠️ Warning: very few samples for trait ", trait, " (n = ", sum(valid_samples), ")")
    }
    
  } else {
    moduleTraitCor_MAC[, trait] = NA
    moduleTraitPvalue_MAC[, trait] = NA
    traitSampleSizes_MAC[trait] = sum(valid_samples)
    
    message("⏭️ Skipping trait ", trait, " due to < 2 valid samples.")
  }
}

# Adjust p-values (trait-by-trait)
moduleTraitFDR_MAC = apply(moduleTraitPvalue_MAC, 2, p.adjust, method = "fdr")

# Create significance labels based on RAW p-values
sig_labels_MAC = matrix("", nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
sig_labels_MAC[moduleTraitPvalue_MAC < 0.001] = "***"
sig_labels_MAC[moduleTraitPvalue_MAC >= 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue_MAC < 0.01] = "**"
sig_labels_MAC[moduleTraitPvalue_MAC >= 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue_MAC < 0.05] = "*"
sig_labels_MAC[moduleTraitPvalue_MAC >= 0.05] = ""

# Create heatmap text
heat_text_MAC = matrix(paste0(
  signif(moduleTraitCor_MAC, 2), "\n(p=", signif(moduleTraitPvalue_MAC, 2), ")"
), nrow = nModules, ncol = nTraits)
rownames(heat_text_MAC) = rownames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)
colnames(heat_text_MAC) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)

# Add sample sizes to trait names
colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC) = paste0(colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC), "\n(n=", traitSampleSizes_MAC, ")")
colnames(moduleTraitPvalue_MAC) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)
colnames(heat_text_MAC) = colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)

# Save correlation results
corr_table_MAC = data.frame(
  Module = rownames(moduleTraitCor_MAC),
  moduleTraitCor_MAC,
  moduleTraitPvalue_MAC,
  FDR = moduleTraitFDR_MAC
)

write.table(corr_table_MAC,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_table_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot heatmap
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_heatmap_module_trait_correlations_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 8)

pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_MAC,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_MAC,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "MAC Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)
dev.off()

# Console Plot
pheatmap(moduleTraitCor_MAC,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = sig_labels_MAC,
         number_color = "black",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         main = "MAC Module-Trait Correlations (Sample Sizes Shown)",
         angle_col = 0,
         fontsize = 12)

# MAC Panel Plot for Module-Trait Scatterplots (Relaxed Significant Modules Only)

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ----------------------------
# Plot scatterplots for significant correlations (MAC)
# ----------------------------

library(ggpubr)  # for ggarrange()

# Extract significant correlations (p < 0.1 for MAC)
sig_hits_MAC = which(moduleTraitPvalue_MAC < 0.1, arr.ind = TRUE)

if (length(sig_hits_MAC) > 0) {
  scatter_list_MAC = list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(sig_hits_MAC)) {
    mod = rownames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)[sig_hits_MAC[i, 1]]
    
    trait_label = colnames(moduleTraitCor_MAC)[sig_hits_MAC[i, 2]]
    trait_label_clean = gsub("\\n\\(n=.*\\)", "", trait_label)
    trait_label_clean = gsub("\\n.*", "", trait_label_clean)
    
    y = Traits_MAC_full[[trait_label_clean]]
    x = MEs_MAC[[mod]]
    
    valid = !is.na(y)
    
    plot = ggplot(data = data.frame(x = x[valid], y = y[valid]), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
      labs(x = paste0(mod), y = trait_label_clean) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14)
    
    scatter_list_MAC[[length(scatter_list_MAC) + 1]] = plot
  }
  
  # Save as panel figure
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_panel_scatterplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 8, height = ceiling(length(scatter_list_MAC) / 2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_MAC, ncol = 2, nrow = ceiling(length(scatter_list_MAC) / 2)))
  
  dev.off()
}

# Console plot

  print(ggarrange(plotlist = scatter_list_MAC, ncol = 2, nrow = ceiling(length(scatter_list_MAC) / 2)))
```
