```{r run_ANOVAs_on_trait_correlations_MAC, cache=TRUE, dependson="trait_correlation_analysis_WGCNA_MAC"}

## code from Plachetzki et al 2014

# MAC Module Expression ANOVA by Treatment
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)

# 1. Prepare data
ME_MAC = MEs_MAC
ME_MAC$SampleID = rownames(MEs_MAC)
ME_info_MAC = merge(ME_MAC, id, by = "SampleID")

# 2. No known outliers for MAC → no exclusions needed

# 3. Define modules to test
modules_to_test = colnames(MEs_MAC)

# 4. Initialize storage
anova_results_list = list()
all_scatter_list = list()
sig_scatter_list = list()
raw_pvals = c()

# 5. Run ANOVA for each module
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = lm(ME_info_MAC[[mod]] ~ ME_info_MAC$Treatment)
  aov_table = anova(model)
  
  # Extract raw p-value
  pval = aov_table$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  raw_pvals = c(raw_pvals, pval)
  
  # Save models and ANOVA tables
  anova_results_list[[mod]] = list(model = model, aov = aov_table)
}

# 6. Bonferroni correction
pvals_bonf = p.adjust(raw_pvals, method = "bonferroni")
names(pvals_bonf) = modules_to_test

# 7. Create plots
for (mod in modules_to_test) {
  
  model = anova_results_list[[mod]]$model
  
  # Always prepare the plot
  p = ggplot(ME_info_MAC, aes(x=Treatment, y=.data[[mod]], fill=Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', position=position_dodge(1), dotsize=0.5) +
    labs(y = paste0(mod, " Expression"), x = "Treatment") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1),
          plot.title = element_text(size=10)) +
    ggtitle(paste0(mod, ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.001, " ***",
                               ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.01, " **",
                                      ifelse(pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05, " *", "")))))
  
  all_scatter_list[[length(all_scatter_list) + 1]] = p
  
  # If significant after Bonferroni, add posthoc letters and include in sig panel
  if (pvals_bonf[mod] < 0.05) {
    emm = emmeans(model, ~ Treatment)
    cld = multcomp::cld(emm, Letters=letters, adjust="tukey")
    
    p_sig = p +
      geom_text(data=cld, aes(x=Treatment, y=max(ME_info_MAC[[mod]], na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05, label=.group),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust=0)
    
    sig_scatter_list[[length(sig_scatter_list) + 1]] = p_sig
  }
}

# 8. Save ANOVA table
anova_results_df = data.frame(
  Module = modules_to_test,
  Raw_Pval = raw_pvals,
  Bonferroni_Pval = pvals_bonf
)

write.table(anova_results_df,
            file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_table_wgcna_module_ANOVA_results_", run_date, ".txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)

# 9. Save all module boxplot panel
pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_panel_all_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
    width = 10, height = ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2) * 4)

print(ggarrange(plotlist = all_scatter_list, ncol=4, nrow=ceiling(length(all_scatter_list)/2)))
dev.off()

# 10. Save significant-only boxplot panel
if (length(sig_scatter_list) > 0) {
  pdf(file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_panel_significant_module_expression_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf"),
      width = 10, height = ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2) * 4)
  
  print(ggarrange(plotlist = sig_scatter_list, ncol=2, nrow=ceiling(length(sig_scatter_list)/2)))
  
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("⚠️ No modules passed Bonferroni p<0.05 for MAC treatment comparisons.")
}
```

Get hub genes for each module:
```{r hub_genes_MAC, cache=TRUE}
# Minimal reproducible fix

# 1. Load ONLY WGCNA
library(WGCNA)

# 2. Rebuild expression matrix
datExpr <- as.matrix(Expr0_MAC)  # genes = columns, samples = rows

# 3. Name your module colors
names(moduleColors_MAC) <- colnames(datExpr)

# 4. Run function explicitly from WGCNA namespMAC
hub_genes <- WGCNA::chooseTopHubInEachModule(
  datExpr = datExpr,
  colorh = moduleColors_MAC,
  power = 10,
  type = "signed"
)

# 5. Save & print
hub_table_MAC <- data.frame(
  Module = names(hub_genes),
  HubGene = hub_genes
)

write.csv(hub_table_MAC, file = paste0("edgeR_output/MAC/WGCNA/MAC_hub_genes_kWithin_top1_", run_date, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(hub_table_MAC)
```

## Table for correlations for each species
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(gt); library(flextable); library(officer); library(scales)
})

species_order <- c("MAC","GIB","COR","GEO","ACE")
out_dir <- "WGCNA_module_trait_tables_heatmap_style"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Robust aligner: trusts COR & P as the ground truth and recomputes FDR to match
# --- helper remains unchanged ---
align_and_recalc_fdr <- function(cor_mat, p_mat) {
  cor_mat <- as.matrix(cor_mat); p_mat <- as.matrix(p_mat)
  if (is.null(rownames(p_mat)) && nrow(p_mat) == nrow(cor_mat)) rownames(p_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat)
  if (is.null(colnames(p_mat)) && ncol(p_mat) == ncol(cor_mat)) colnames(p_mat) <- colnames(cor_mat)
  if (!identical(dimnames(cor_mat), dimnames(p_mat))) {
    if (!is.null(rownames(cor_mat)) && !is.null(colnames(cor_mat)) &&
        !is.null(rownames(p_mat))  && !is.null(colnames(p_mat))  &&
        all(rownames(cor_mat) %in% rownames(p_mat)) &&
        all(colnames(cor_mat) %in% colnames(p_mat))) {
      p_mat <- p_mat[rownames(cor_mat), colnames(cor_mat), drop = FALSE]
    } else if (all(dim(cor_mat) == dim(p_mat))) {
      dimnames(p_mat) <- dimnames(cor_mat)
    } else {
      stop("Cannot align p-matrix to cor-matrix: dim/labels mismatch.")
    }
  }
  fdr_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(p_mat), ncol = ncol(p_mat),
                    dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(p_mat))) {
    v <- p_mat[, j]
    fdr_mat[, j] <- if (all(is.na(v))) rep(NA_real_, length(v)) else p.adjust(v, "fdr")
  }
  list(cor = cor_mat, p = p_mat, fdr = fdr_mat)
}

# --- REPLACE your long_from_heatmap() with this version ---
long_from_heatmap <- function(species, cor_mat, p_mat, traitN) {
  mats <- align_and_recalc_fdr(cor_mat, p_mat)
  cor_mat <- mats$cor; p_mat <- mats$p; fdr_mat <- mats$fdr

  # Map trait column names -> base trait + n (robust to titles like "ILOS_torr\n(n=22)")
  trait_tbl <- tibble(Trait = colnames(cor_mat)) %>%
    mutate(
      Trait_base = sub("\\n\\(n=.*\\)$", "", Trait),
      n_from_title = {
        m <- regmatches(Trait, regexpr("\\(n=\\s*\\d+\\)", Trait))
        as.integer(sub(".*\\(n=\\s*([0-9]+)\\).*", "\\1", ifelse(m == "", NA, m)))
      }
    )

  # ensure traitN is named by base trait names
  # (if not named, try to name by colnames(cor_mat) after stripping the (n=...) bit)
  if (is.null(names(traitN))) names(traitN) <- trait_tbl$Trait_base
  # prefer lookup by base name
  trait_tbl <- trait_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      n_from_traitN = unname(traitN[Trait_base]),
      n_final = dplyr::coalesce(n_from_traitN, n_from_title)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Trait, n_final)

  # Build long table and join n
  as_tibble(cor_mat, rownames = "ME") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-ME, names_to = "Trait", values_to = "r") %>%
    left_join(
      as_tibble(p_mat, rownames = "ME") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(-ME, names_to = "Trait", values_to = "p"),
      by = c("ME","Trait")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      as_tibble(fdr_mat, rownames = "ME") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(-ME, names_to = "Trait", values_to = "FDR"),
      by = c("ME","Trait")
    ) %>%
    left_join(trait_tbl, by = "Trait") %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species,
      Module  = sub("^ME", "", ME),
      n       = as.integer(n_final),
      # *** significance by RAW p-values ***
      sig     = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(p) & p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        !is.na(p) & p < 0.01  ~ "**",
        !is.na(p) & p < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, Trait, Module, n, r, p, FDR, sig) %>%
    arrange(Trait, desc(abs(r)))
}


# Use your already-built heatmap objects
mt_MAC <- long_from_heatmap("MAC", moduleTraitCor_MAC, moduleTraitPvalue_MAC, traitSampleSizes_MAC)
mt_GIB <- long_from_heatmap("GIB", moduleTraitCor_GIB, moduleTraitPvalue_GIB, traitSampleSizes_GIB)
mt_COR <- long_from_heatmap("COR", moduleTraitCor_COR, moduleTraitPvalue_COR, traitSampleSizes_COR)
mt_GEO <- long_from_heatmap("GEO", moduleTraitCor_GEO, moduleTraitPvalue_GEO, traitSampleSizes_GEO)
mt_ACE <- long_from_heatmap("ACE", moduleTraitCor_ACE, moduleTraitPvalue_ACE, traitSampleSizes_ACE)

mt_all <- bind_rows(mt_MAC, mt_GIB, mt_COR, mt_GEO, mt_ACE) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)) %>%
  arrange(Species, Trait, desc(abs(r)))

message("Rows: MAC=", nrow(mt_MAC),
        " | GIB=", nrow(mt_GIB),
        " | COR=", nrow(mt_COR),
        " | GEO=", nrow(mt_GEO),
        " | ACE=", nrow(mt_ACE),
        " | ALL=", nrow(mt_all))

# --- CSVs ---
for (sp in species_order) {
  write_csv(filter(mt_all, Species == sp),
            file.path(out_dir, paste0(sp, "_module_trait_correlations.csv")))
}
write_csv(mt_all, file.path(out_dir, "ALL_species_module_trait_correlations.csv"))

# --- HTML (gt) ---
gt_tab <- mt_all %>%
  # show rows where r & p exist; allow FDR to be NA if a whole trait was NA pre-BH
  filter(!is.na(r) & !is.na(p)) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      !is.na(p) & p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      !is.na(p) & p < 0.01  ~ "**",
      !is.na(p) & p < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(Species, Trait, Module, n, `r` = r, `p (raw)` = p, `FDR (BH)` = FDR, sig) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Species") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Module–trait correlations (heatmap-style)**"),
    subtitle = "Pearson r, trait-specific n, raw p and BH–FDR (per trait)"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Association", columns = c(`r`,`p (raw)`,`FDR (BH)`,`sig`)) %>%
  cols_label(Trait="Trait", Module="Module", n="n", `r`="r", `p (raw)`="p", `FDR (BH)`="FDR", sig="sig") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`r`), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_scientific(columns = c(`p (raw)`, `FDR (BH)`), decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Trait, Module, n, sig)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = c(`r`,`p (raw)`,`FDR (BH)`)) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), data_row.padding = px(6)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md("Values mirror your heatmap computation. BH–FDR recomputed from p within trait."))

gtsave(gt_tab, file.path(out_dir, "module_trait_correlations.html"))

# --- DOCX (landscape) ---
mt_all_doc <- mt_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(r) & !is.na(p)) %>%
  mutate(
    sig     = case_when(!is.na(p) & p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                        !is.na(p) & p < 0.01  ~ "**",
                        !is.na(p) & p < 0.05  ~ "*",

    p_fmt   = label_scientific(digits = 2)(p),
    FDR_fmt = ifelse(is.na(FDR), "NA", label_scientific(digits = 2)(FDR))

ft_all <- flextable(mt_all_doc) %>%

sect_land <- prop_section(page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape"))
```

## Testing for Overlap between ACE Magenta & GEO Brown
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Cross-species WGCNA module overlap
#
# Comparison:
#   ACE magenta module
#   GEO brown module
#
# Cross-species key:
#   repaired one-to-one zebrafish DrOrtholog mappings
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Module mapping diagnostics
#   2. Statistical overlap summary
#   3. Shared ortholog table with species genes and kME
#   4. ACE-only and GEO-only ortholog tables
#   5. Module membership tables
#   6. Optional Euler/Venn diagram
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(WGCNA)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ================================================================
# 0. Settings
# ================================================================

base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"
map_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "mapped_counts")

out_dir <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "edgeR_output",
  "AllSpecies",
  "WGCNA_ACE_magenta_GEO_brown_overlap"
)

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y")

ACE_MODULE <- "magenta"
GEO_MODULE <- "brown"

# ================================================================
# 1. Check required WGCNA objects
# ================================================================

required_objects <- c(
  "moduleColors_ACE",
  "moduleColors_GEO"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    envir = .GlobalEnv,
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required WGCNA objects:\n",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nLoad DEG_WGCNA_environment.RData or run the WGCNA sections first."
  )
}

moduleColors_ACE <- get(
  "moduleColors_ACE",
  envir = .GlobalEnv,
  inherits = TRUE
)

moduleColors_GEO <- get(
  "moduleColors_GEO",
  envir = .GlobalEnv,
  inherits = TRUE
)

# ================================================================
# 2. Find the expression matrix matching each module-color vector
#
# This permits either Expr_* or Expr0_* to be present, but requires
# the number of expression columns to match the color-vector length.
# ================================================================

find_matching_expression_matrix <- function(
    candidate_names,
    module_colors,
    species
) {

  for (object_name in candidate_names) {

    if (!exists(
      object_name,
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = TRUE
    )) {
      next
    }

    candidate <- get(
      object_name,
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = TRUE
    )

    candidate <- as.matrix(candidate)

    if (ncol(candidate) == length(module_colors)) {

      message(
        species,
        ": using ",
        object_name,
        " (",
        nrow(candidate),
        " samples × ",
        ncol(candidate),
        " genes)"
      )

      return(candidate)
    }
  }

  stop(
    species,
    ": no expression matrix matched the module-color vector.\n",
    "Checked: ",
    paste(candidate_names, collapse = ", "),
    "\nModule-color length: ",
    length(module_colors)
  )
}

Expr_use_ACE <- find_matching_expression_matrix(
  candidate_names = c("Expr_ACE", "Expr0_ACE"),
  module_colors = moduleColors_ACE,
  species = "ACE"
)

Expr_use_GEO <- find_matching_expression_matrix(
  candidate_names = c("Expr_GEO", "Expr0_GEO"),
  module_colors = moduleColors_GEO,
  species = "GEO"
)

# ================================================================
# 3. Align gene names and module-color vectors
# ================================================================

align_expression_and_colors <- function(
    datExpr,
    module_colors,
    species
) {

  datExpr <- as.matrix(datExpr)
  module_colors <- as.character(module_colors)

  color_names <- names(module_colors)
  expression_names <- colnames(datExpr)

  if (is.null(expression_names)) {
    stop(species, ": the expression matrix has no gene-column names.")
  }

  # Prefer names attached to moduleColors when they are complete
  # and correspond to the expression matrix.
  if (
    !is.null(color_names) &&
    length(color_names) == length(module_colors) &&
    all(!is.na(color_names)) &&
    all(nzchar(color_names)) &&
    all(color_names %in% expression_names)
  ) {

    datExpr <- datExpr[, color_names, drop = FALSE]
    gene_names <- color_names

  } else {

    if (ncol(datExpr) != length(module_colors)) {
      stop(
        species,
        ": expression columns and module-color vector do not match."
      )
    }

    gene_names <- colnames(datExpr)
    names(module_colors) <- gene_names
  }

  list(
    datExpr = datExpr,
    moduleColors = module_colors,
    genes = gene_names
  )
}

ace_aligned <- align_expression_and_colors(
  datExpr = Expr_use_ACE,
  module_colors = moduleColors_ACE,
  species = "ACE"
)

geo_aligned <- align_expression_and_colors(
  datExpr = Expr_use_GEO,
  module_colors = moduleColors_GEO,
  species = "GEO"
)

Expr_use_ACE <- ace_aligned$datExpr
moduleColors_ACE_use <- ace_aligned$moduleColors

Expr_use_GEO <- geo_aligned$datExpr
moduleColors_GEO_use <- geo_aligned$moduleColors

# ================================================================
# 4. Extract module genes and calculate kME
#
# Eigengenes are recalculated from the aligned expression matrix,
# which guarantees that samples, genes, and module colors correspond.
# ================================================================

extract_module_with_kME <- function(
    datExpr,
    module_colors,
    target_module,
    species
) {

  target_module <- tolower(target_module)
  module_colors <- tolower(as.character(module_colors))

  genes <- colnames(datExpr)

  if (length(genes) != length(module_colors)) {
    stop(
      species,
      ": gene-column count does not equal module-color count."
    )
  }

  if (!target_module %in% module_colors) {
    stop(
      species,
      ": module '",
      target_module,
      "' was not found.\nAvailable modules:\n",
      paste(sort(unique(module_colors)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  MEs <- WGCNA::moduleEigengenes(
    expr = datExpr,
    colors = module_colors,
    excludeGrey = FALSE
  )$eigengenes

  MEs <- WGCNA::orderMEs(MEs)

  expected_ME <- paste0("ME", target_module)

  me_match <- names(MEs)[
    tolower(names(MEs)) == tolower(expected_ME)
  ]

  if (length(me_match) != 1) {
    stop(
      species,
      ": could not identify eigengene column ",
      expected_ME,
      ".\nAvailable eigengenes:\n",
      paste(names(MEs), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  module_index <- module_colors == target_module
  module_genes <- genes[module_index]

  module_expression <- datExpr[
    ,
    module_genes,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  kME_values <- cor(
    module_expression,
    MEs[, me_match, drop = TRUE],
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )

  kME_values <- as.numeric(kME_values)

  tibble(
    Species = species,
    Module = target_module,
    Gene = module_genes,
    kME = kME_values,
    abs_kME = abs(kME_values)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_kME), Gene)
}

ACE_magenta_genes <- extract_module_with_kME(
  datExpr = Expr_use_ACE,
  module_colors = moduleColors_ACE_use,
  target_module = ACE_MODULE,
  species = "ACE"
)

GEO_brown_genes <- extract_module_with_kME(
  datExpr = Expr_use_GEO,
  module_colors = moduleColors_GEO_use,
  target_module = GEO_MODULE,
  species = "GEO"
)

cat("\nRaw WGCNA module sizes:\n")
cat(
  "  ACE magenta: ",
  nrow(ACE_magenta_genes),
  " genes\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "  GEO brown:   ",
  nrow(GEO_brown_genes),
  " genes\n",
  sep = ""
)

# ================================================================
# 5. Load repaired DrOrtholog maps
# ================================================================

norm_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

load_drortholog_map <- function(species) {

  map_file <- file.path(
    map_dir,
    paste0(
      species,
      "_key_to_DrOrtholog_minimal.tsv"
    )
  )

  if (!file.exists(map_file)) {
    stop(
      "Missing repaired DrOrtholog map:\n",
      map_file,
      "\nRun Map_to_zf.R first."
    )
  }

  readr::read_tsv(
    map_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species,
      key = as.character(key),
      key_norm = norm_key(key),
      DrOrtholog = as.character(DrOrtholog),
      DrOrtholog = sub(
        "\\.[0-9]+$",
        "",
        DrOrtholog
      ),
      picked_from = as.character(picked_from)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(key),
      nzchar(key),
      !is.na(DrOrtholog),
      nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      Species,
      key,
      key_norm,
      DrOrtholog,
      picked_from
    )
}

map_ACE <- load_drortholog_map("ACE")
map_GEO <- load_drortholog_map("GEO")

# ================================================================
# 6. Map module genes to DrOrtholog
# ================================================================

map_module_to_drortholog <- function(
    module_table,
    map_table,
    species,
    module
) {

  mapped <- module_table %>%
    mutate(
      key_norm = norm_key(Gene)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      map_table %>%
        select(
          key,
          key_norm,
          DrOrtholog,
          picked_from
        ),
      by = "key_norm",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    )

  stats <- mapped %>%
    summarise(
      Species = species,
      Module = module,
      Raw_module_genes = n_distinct(Gene),
      Genes_with_DrOrtholog = n_distinct(
        Gene[!is.na(DrOrtholog)]
      ),
      Unique_DrOrthologs = n_distinct(
        DrOrtholog[!is.na(DrOrtholog)]
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Percent_module_genes_mapped =
        100 * Genes_with_DrOrtholog /
        pmax(Raw_module_genes, 1)
    )

  list(
    full = mapped,
    mapped = mapped %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(DrOrtholog),
        nzchar(DrOrtholog)
      ) %>%
      distinct(
        Gene,
        DrOrtholog,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      ),
    stats = stats
  )
}

ACE_magenta_map <- map_module_to_drortholog(
  module_table = ACE_magenta_genes,
  map_table = map_ACE,
  species = "ACE",
  module = ACE_MODULE
)

GEO_brown_map <- map_module_to_drortholog(
  module_table = GEO_brown_genes,
  map_table = map_GEO,
  species = "GEO",
  module = GEO_MODULE
)

module_mapping_summary <- bind_rows(
  ACE_magenta_map$stats,
  GEO_brown_map$stats
)

cat("\nModule mapping summary:\n")
print(module_mapping_summary, n = Inf)

# ================================================================
# 7. Construct a fair shared WGCNA background
#
# The universe contains DrOrthologs represented among the genes
# entering both the ACE and GEO WGCNA analyses.
# ================================================================

map_wgcna_background <- function(
    gene_vector,
    map_table
) {

  tibble(
    Gene = unique(as.character(gene_vector)),
    key_norm = norm_key(
      unique(as.character(gene_vector))
    )
  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      map_table %>%
        select(
          key_norm,
          DrOrtholog
        ),
      by = "key_norm",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(DrOrtholog),
      nzchar(DrOrtholog)
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      Gene,
      DrOrtholog
    )
}

ACE_background_map <- map_wgcna_background(
  gene_vector = colnames(Expr_use_ACE),
  map_table = map_ACE
)

GEO_background_map <- map_wgcna_background(
  gene_vector = colnames(Expr_use_GEO),
  map_table = map_GEO
)

ACE_background_DrOrtholog <- unique(
  ACE_background_map$DrOrtholog
)

GEO_background_DrOrtholog <- unique(
  GEO_background_map$DrOrtholog
)

shared_background <- intersect(
  ACE_background_DrOrtholog,
  GEO_background_DrOrtholog
)

if (length(shared_background) == 0) {
  stop(
    "The ACE and GEO mapped WGCNA backgrounds have no shared DrOrthologs."
  )
}

# Module sets restricted to the shared testable universe
ACE_magenta_set <- intersect(
  unique(ACE_magenta_map$mapped$DrOrtholog),
  shared_background
)

GEO_brown_set <- intersect(
  unique(GEO_brown_map$mapped$DrOrtholog),
  shared_background
)

shared_module_orthologs <- intersect(
  ACE_magenta_set,
  GEO_brown_set
)

ACE_only_orthologs <- setdiff(
  ACE_magenta_set,
  GEO_brown_set
)

GEO_only_orthologs <- setdiff(
  GEO_brown_set,
  ACE_magenta_set
)

# ================================================================
# 8. Calculate overlap statistics
# ================================================================

universe_n <- length(shared_background)
ace_n <- length(ACE_magenta_set)
geo_n <- length(GEO_brown_set)
overlap_n <- length(shared_module_orthologs)

union_n <- length(
  union(
    ACE_magenta_set,
    GEO_brown_set
  )
)

neither_n <- universe_n - union_n

if (neither_n < 0) {
  stop(
    "Overlap contingency table produced a negative 'neither' count."
  )
}

overlap_contingency <- matrix(
  c(
    overlap_n,
    ace_n - overlap_n,
    geo_n - overlap_n,
    neither_n
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    ACE_magenta = c(
      "In_ACE_magenta",
      "Not_in_ACE_magenta"
    ),
    GEO_brown = c(
      "In_GEO_brown",
      "Not_in_GEO_brown"
    )
  )
)

fisher_result <- fisher.test(
  overlap_contingency,
  alternative = "greater"
)

expected_overlap <- (
  ace_n * geo_n
) / universe_n

fold_enrichment <- if (
  expected_overlap > 0
) {
  overlap_n / expected_overlap
} else {
  NA_real_
}

jaccard_similarity <- if (
  union_n > 0
) {
  overlap_n / union_n
} else {
  NA_real_
}

overlap_coefficient <- if (
  min(ace_n, geo_n) > 0
) {
  overlap_n / min(ace_n, geo_n)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

overlap_summary <- tibble(
  Comparison = "ACE magenta vs GEO brown",
  Shared_WGCNA_background_DrOrthologs = universe_n,
  ACE_magenta_DrOrthologs = ace_n,
  GEO_brown_DrOrthologs = geo_n,
  Shared_DrOrthologs = overlap_n,
  ACE_only_DrOrthologs = length(ACE_only_orthologs),
  GEO_only_DrOrthologs = length(GEO_only_orthologs),
  Percent_ACE_magenta_shared =
    100 * overlap_n / pmax(ace_n, 1),
  Percent_GEO_brown_shared =
    100 * overlap_n / pmax(geo_n, 1),
  Jaccard_similarity = jaccard_similarity,
  Overlap_coefficient = overlap_coefficient,
  Expected_overlap = expected_overlap,
  Fold_enrichment_over_expected = fold_enrichment,
  Fisher_odds_ratio = unname(
    fisher_result$estimate
  ),
  Fisher_one_sided_p = fisher_result$p.value
)

cat("\n================================================\n")
cat("ACE magenta versus GEO brown overlap summary\n")
cat("================================================\n")
print(overlap_summary, width = Inf)

cat("\nFisher contingency table:\n")
print(overlap_contingency)

# ================================================================
# 9. Collapse species-specific mappings to one row per DrOrtholog
#
# Where duplicate species genes map to an ortholog, the gene with
# the greatest absolute kME is retained as the representative.
# All corresponding species genes are also preserved.
# ================================================================

collapse_module_by_ortholog <- function(
    mapped_table,
    prefix
) {

  output <- mapped_table %>%
    arrange(
      DrOrtholog,
      desc(abs_kME)
    ) %>%
    group_by(DrOrtholog) %>%
    summarise(
      Representative_gene = first(Gene),
      All_species_genes = paste(
        sort(unique(Gene)),
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      Representative_kME = first(kME),
      Representative_abs_kME = first(abs_kME),
      Mapping_source = paste(
        sort(unique(
          picked_from[
            !is.na(picked_from) &
              nzchar(picked_from)
          ]
        )),
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  names(output)[
    names(output) == "Representative_gene"
  ] <- paste0(
    prefix,
    "_representative_gene"
  )

  names(output)[
    names(output) == "All_species_genes"
  ] <- paste0(
    prefix,
    "_all_genes"
  )

  names(output)[
    names(output) == "Representative_kME"
  ] <- paste0(
    prefix,
    "_kME"
  )

  names(output)[
    names(output) == "Representative_abs_kME"
  ] <- paste0(
    prefix,
    "_abs_kME"
  )

  names(output)[
    names(output) == "Mapping_source"
  ] <- paste0(
    prefix,
    "_mapping_source"
  )

  output
}

ACE_ortholog_summary <- collapse_module_by_ortholog(
  mapped_table = ACE_magenta_map$mapped,
  prefix = "ACE_magenta"
)

GEO_ortholog_summary <- collapse_module_by_ortholog(
  mapped_table = GEO_brown_map$mapped,
  prefix = "GEO_brown"
)

# ================================================================
# 10. Optional zebrafish annotation
# ================================================================

annotate_zebrafish_orthologs <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)
  x_clean <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)

  annotation <- tibble(
    DrOrtholog = x,
    Zebrafish_symbol = NA_character_,
    Zebrafish_gene_name = NA_character_,
    Zebrafish_EntrezID = NA_character_
  )

  if (
    !requireNamespace(
      "AnnotationDbi",
      quietly = TRUE
    ) ||
    !requireNamespace(
      "org.Dr.eg.db",
      quietly = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    message(
      "Packages AnnotationDbi and/or org.Dr.eg.db are unavailable; ",
      "zebrafish annotation columns will remain NA."
    )

    return(annotation)
  }

  db <- org.Dr.eg.db::org.Dr.eg.db

  symbols <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    db,
    keys = unique(x_clean),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    db,
    keys = unique(x_clean),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "ENTREZID",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  available_columns <- AnnotationDbi::columns(db)

  gene_names <- if (
    "GENENAME" %in% available_columns
  ) {

    AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
      db,
      keys = unique(x_clean),
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      column = "GENENAME",
      multiVals = "first"
    )

  } else {

    setNames(
      rep(
        NA_character_,
        length(unique(x_clean))
      ),
      unique(x_clean)
    )
  }

  annotation$Zebrafish_symbol <- unname(
    symbols[x_clean]
  )

  annotation$Zebrafish_gene_name <- unname(
    gene_names[x_clean]
  )

  annotation$Zebrafish_EntrezID <- unname(
    entrez[x_clean]
  )

  annotation
}

all_relevant_orthologs <- union(
  ACE_magenta_set,
  GEO_brown_set
)

zf_annotation <- annotate_zebrafish_orthologs(
  all_relevant_orthologs
)

# ================================================================
# 11. Construct detailed shared and unique tables

shared_overlap_table <- tibble(

GEO_only_table <- tibble(

# Full many-to-many gene-pair table for auditing
shared_gene_pair_table <- tibble(

  left_join(

    by = "DrOrtholog"
  ) %>%

    DrOrtholog,
    desc(ACE_abs_kME),
    desc(GEO_abs_kME)
  )
```

# Targeted gene analysis & plots
## Fig. 6
```{r}
# ================================================================
# CPM Heatmap: log2FC vs Normoxia
# Fully revised:
#   - ILOS -> ILOP everywhere
#   - PDF + PNG export
#   - crisp panels / crisp heatmap blocks
#   - all text forced to black
#   - FDR-corrected p-value version
#   - non-FDR/raw p-value version
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(grid)
  library(gtable)
  library(multcompView)
  library(plotrix)
  library(scico)
  library(scales)
  library(tibble)
})

# ================================================================
# 0. Settings
# ================================================================

base_dir <- "C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq"

FDR_ALPHA <- 0.05
RAW_ALPHA <- 0.05
CPM_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.01

pdf_width  <- 64
pdf_height <- 34

png_width  <- 64
png_height <- 34
png_res    <- 500

out_stats <- "Hypoxia_CPM_heatmap_targeted_CPM_tests_ILOP.csv"

out_pdf_FDR <- "Hypoxia_CPM_heatmap_log2FC_scaled_panels_FDR_ILOP_crisp.pdf"
out_png_FDR <- "Hypoxia_CPM_heatmap_log2FC_scaled_panels_FDR_ILOP_crisp.png"

out_pdf_raw <- "Hypoxia_CPM_heatmap_log2FC_scaled_panels_raw_p_ILOP_crisp.pdf"
out_png_raw <- "Hypoxia_CPM_heatmap_log2FC_scaled_panels_raw_p_ILOP_crisp.png"

pretty_cpm_labels <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x >= 1,
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0),
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 1. Function labels
# ================================================================

function_levels <- c(
  "Regulates Glucose Metabolism",
  "Lactate Shuttle",
  "Cardiovascular remodeling",
  "Transcription Factor Function",
  "Protein translation",
  "Immunity / Apoptosis",
  "Blood cell biogenesis",
  "Growth factor",
  "heme / RBC breakdown",
  "Mitochondria function",
  "Molecular Chaperone (HSP 70)",
  "Myoglobin (oxygen storage)"
)

function_labels_wrapped <- c(
  "Regulates Glucose Metabolism" = "Regulates\nGlucose Metabolism",
  "Lactate Shuttle" = "Lactate\nShuttle",
  "Cardiovascular remodeling" = "Cardiovascular\nRemodeling",
  "Transcription Factor Function" = "Transcription Factor\nFunction",
  "Protein translation" = "Protein\nTranslation",
  "Immunity / Apoptosis" = "Immunity /\nApoptosis",
  "Blood cell biogenesis" = "Blood Cell\nBiogenesis",
  "Growth factor" = "Growth\nFactor",
  "heme / RBC breakdown" = "Heme / RBC\nBreakdown",
  "Mitochondria function" = "Mitochondria\nFunction",
  "Molecular Chaperone (HSP 70)" = "Molecular\nChaperone\n(HSP 70)",
  "Myoglobin (oxygen storage)" = "Myoglobin\n(O2 storage)"
)

species_levels <- c(
  "E. maclovinus",
  "G. gibberifrons",
  "N. coriiceps",
  "P. georgianus",
  "C. aceratus"
)

treatment_levels <- c("Normoxia", "ILOP", "Hypoxia")

# ================================================================
# 2. Read CPM gene tables and assign treatments
# ================================================================

read_cpm_gene_file <- function(file, prefix, species,
                               n_normoxia,
                               n_ilop,
                               n_hypoxia = 0) {
  
  raw <- read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)
  
  sample_cols <- names(raw)[startsWith(names(raw), prefix)]
  
  expected_n <- n_normoxia + n_ilop + n_hypoxia
  
  if (length(sample_cols) != expected_n) {
    stop(
      species, ": expected ", expected_n,
      " sample columns starting with ", prefix,
      ", but found ", length(sample_cols), ".\n",
      "Found columns: ", paste(sample_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  treatment_lookup <- tibble(
    SampleID = sample_cols,
    Treatment = c(
      rep("Normoxia", n_normoxia),
      rep("ILOP", n_ilop),
      if (n_hypoxia > 0) rep("Hypoxia", n_hypoxia) else character(0)
    )
  )
  
  raw %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(sample_cols),
      names_to = "SampleID",
      values_to = "Reads_CPM"
    ) %>%
    left_join(treatment_lookup, by = "SampleID") %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species,
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels)
    )
}

ACE_CPM_Genes <- read_cpm_gene_file(
  file = file.path(base_dir, "ACE_CPM_Genes.csv"),
  prefix = "ACE",
  species = "C. aceratus",
  n_normoxia = 7,
  n_ilop = 8,
  n_hypoxia = 7
)

MAC_CPM_Genes <- read_cpm_gene_file(
  file = file.path(base_dir, "MAC_CPM_Genes.csv"),
  prefix = "MAC",
  species = "E. maclovinus",
  n_normoxia = 8,
  n_ilop = 8,
  n_hypoxia = 8
)

GIB_CPM_Genes <- read_cpm_gene_file(
  file = file.path(base_dir, "GIB_CPM_Genes.csv"),
  prefix = "GIB",
  species = "G. gibberifrons",
  n_normoxia = 7,
  n_ilop = 8,
  n_hypoxia = 7
)

COR_CPM_Genes <- read_cpm_gene_file(
  file = file.path(base_dir, "COR_CPM_Genes.csv"),
  prefix = "COR",
  species = "N. coriiceps",
  n_normoxia = 7,
  n_ilop = 8,
  n_hypoxia = 7
)

GEO_CPM_Genes <- read_cpm_gene_file(
  file = file.path(base_dir, "GEO_CPM_Genes.csv"),
  prefix = "GEO",
  species = "P. georgianus",
  n_normoxia = 7,
  n_ilop = 8,
  n_hypoxia = 0
)

Hypoxia_CPM_Genes <- bind_rows(
  ACE_CPM_Genes,
  MAC_CPM_Genes,
  GIB_CPM_Genes,
  COR_CPM_Genes,
  GEO_CPM_Genes
) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(as.character(Treatment), "ILOS" = "ILOP"),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_levels),
    Function = gsub("^Heme / RBC breakdown$", "heme / RBC breakdown", Function),
    Function = gsub("^Growth factor \\(.+\\)$", "Growth factor", Function),
    Function_pretty = factor(
      Function,
      levels = function_levels,
      labels = function_labels_wrapped[function_levels]
    )
  )

# ================================================================
# 3. Summary statistics and log2FC vs Normoxia
# ================================================================

normoxia_means <- Hypoxia_CPM_Genes %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Normoxia") %>%
  group_by(Species, GeneID, Function) %>%
  summarize(
    Normoxia_Mean = mean(Reads_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Hypoxia_CPM_Summary <- Hypoxia_CPM_Genes %>%
  group_by(Species, Treatment, GeneID, Function) %>%
  summarize(
    Mean_CPM = mean(Reads_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Reads_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = plotrix::std.error(Reads_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(normoxia_means, by = c("Species", "GeneID", "Function")) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = log2((Mean_CPM + CPM_PSEUDOCOUNT) / (Normoxia_Mean + CPM_PSEUDOCOUNT)),
    Function_pretty = factor(
      Function,
      levels = function_levels,
      labels = function_labels_wrapped[function_levels]
    ),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_levels),
    Treatment = factor(as.character(Treatment), levels = treatment_levels)
  )

# ================================================================
# 4. Targeted CPM tests
#    Directly test each plotted treatment against Normoxia.
#    Produces both raw p-value and FDR-corrected significance calls.
# ================================================================

targeted_cpm_tests <- Hypoxia_CPM_Genes %>%
  group_by(Species, GeneID, Function) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    dat <- .x %>%
      mutate(Treatment = as.character(Treatment))
    
    test_treatments <- setdiff(unique(dat$Treatment), "Normoxia")
    
    bind_rows(lapply(test_treatments, function(trt) {
      subdat <- dat %>%
        filter(Treatment %in% c("Normoxia", trt)) %>%
        mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Normoxia", trt)))
      
      group_sizes <- table(subdat$Treatment)
      
      if (length(group_sizes) < 2 || any(group_sizes < 2)) {
        return(tibble(
          Treatment = trt,
          p_raw = NA_real_,
          test = "Welch t-test vs Normoxia",
          note = "too_few_samples"
        ))
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        tt <- t.test(Reads_CPM ~ Treatment, data = subdat)
        
        tibble(
          Treatment = trt,
          p_raw = tt$p.value,
          test = "Welch t-test vs Normoxia",
          note = "ok"
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        tibble(
          Treatment = trt,
          p_raw = NA_real_,
          test = "Welch t-test vs Normoxia",
          note = paste0("failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
        )
      })
    }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_FDR_BH_global = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
    is_significant_raw = !is.na(p_raw) & p_raw < RAW_ALPHA,
    is_significant_FDR = !is.na(p_FDR_BH_global) & p_FDR_BH_global < FDR_ALPHA,
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels)
  )

write.csv(
  targeted_cpm_tests,
  out_stats,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== Targeted CPM treatment-vs-Normoxia tests ===\n")

cat("\nRaw p < ", RAW_ALPHA, ":\n", sep = "")
print(
  targeted_cpm_tests %>%
    count(Treatment, is_significant_raw, name = "n_tests"),
  n = Inf
)

cat("\nFDR-adjusted p < ", FDR_ALPHA, ":\n", sep = "")
print(
  targeted_cpm_tests %>%
    count(Treatment, is_significant_FDR, name = "n_tests"),
  n = Inf
)

cat("\nWrote targeted CPM test table to:\n")
cat("  ", out_stats, "\n", sep = "")

# ================================================================
# 5. Merge significance calls into summary table
# ================================================================

Hypoxia_CPM_Summary <- Hypoxia_CPM_Summary %>%
  left_join(
    targeted_cpm_tests %>%
      select(
        Species,
        GeneID,
        Function,
        Treatment,
        p_raw,
        p_FDR_BH_global,
        is_significant_raw,
        is_significant_FDR
      ),
    by = c("Species", "GeneID", "Function", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_significant_raw = ifelse(is.na(is_significant_raw), FALSE, is_significant_raw),
    is_significant_FDR = ifelse(is.na(is_significant_FDR), FALSE, is_significant_FDR)
  )

# ================================================================
# 6. Filter data for plotting
# ================================================================

heatmap_data <- Hypoxia_CPM_Summary %>%
  filter(!(Species == "P. georgianus" & Treatment == "Hypoxia")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC), Treatment != "Normoxia") %>%
  droplevels()

panel_gene_counts <- heatmap_data %>%
  group_by(Species, Function_pretty) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_panel = n_distinct(GeneID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

heatmap_tagged <- heatmap_data %>%
  left_join(panel_gene_counts, by = c("Species", "Function_pretty"))

# ================================================================
# 7. Heatmap builder
# ================================================================

make_heatmap_grob <- function(sig_col = c("is_significant_FDR", "is_significant_raw")) {
  
  sig_col <- match.arg(sig_col)
  
  sig_df <- heatmap_tagged %>%
    filter(.data[[sig_col]])
  
  p <- ggplot(
    heatmap_tagged,
    aes(x = GeneID, y = Treatment, fill = log2FC)
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      data = subset(heatmap_tagged, n_genes_panel > 1),
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      width = 0.98,
      height = 0.98
    ) +
    geom_tile(
      data = subset(heatmap_tagged, n_genes_panel == 1),
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      width = 0.62,
      height = 0.92
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = sig_df,
      aes(x = GeneID, y = Treatment),
      shape = 21,
      size = 4.4,
      fill = "black",
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_scico(
      palette = "vik",
      midpoint = 0,
      na.value = "white",
      name = expression(log[2] * "FC vs Normoxia")
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      Species ~ Function_pretty,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 38) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      title = element_text(color = "black"),
      
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.9
      ),
      strip.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 31,
        color = "black",
        lineheight = 0.88,
        margin = margin(t = 7, r = 5, b = 9, l = 5)
      ),
      strip.text.y.right = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 31,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(t = 4, r = 4, b = 4, l = 8)
      ),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "grey50",
        linewidth = 0.25
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.2,
        fill = NA
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 38,
        color = "black",
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 25,
        color = "black",
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 36,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(t = 18)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 46,
        color = "black",
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(r = 24)
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ),
      
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1.25, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.70, "lines"),
      
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 32, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 28, color = "black"),
      legend.key.width = unit(2.7, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.50, "cm"),
      
      # Larger internal margin helps, but true edge-padding is added below
      plot.margin = margin(t = 150, r = 85, b = 55, l = 95)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Gene ID",
      y = "Treatment"
    )
  
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  
  # Avoid clipping the top strips
  g$layout$clip[grep("strip-t", g$layout$name)] <- "off"
  
  strip_ids <- which(grepl("^strip-t", g$layout$name))
  
  strip_labels <- sapply(strip_ids, function(i) {
    grob <- g$grobs[[i]]
    
    if ("gTree" %in% class(grob)) {
      children <- grob$grobs[[1]]$children
      text_labels <- sapply(
        children,
        function(x) if (inherits(x, "text")) x$label else NA_character_
      )
      paste(na.omit(text_labels), collapse = "\n")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  })
  
  facet_levels <- levels(Hypoxia_CPM_Genes$Function_pretty)
  
  matched_levels <- match(strip_labels, facet_levels)
  strip_columns <- g$layout$l[strip_ids]
  strip_columns_ordered <- strip_columns[order(matched_levels)]
  
  gene_counts <- heatmap_data %>%
    group_by(Function_pretty, Species) %>%
    summarise(
      n_genes = n_distinct(GeneID),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Function_pretty) %>%
    summarise(
      n = max(n_genes, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(Function_pretty = factor(facet_levels, levels = facet_levels)),
      by = "Function_pretty"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0, n)
    )
  
  scaled_widths <- scales::rescale(gene_counts$n, to = c(8.5, 25))
  
  g$widths[strip_columns_ordered] <- unit(scaled_widths, "cm")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------
  # True outer padding to prevent edge cutoff
  # ------------------------------------------------
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(g, unit(1.1, "in"), pos = 0)
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(g, unit(1.1, "in"), pos = ncol(g))
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(0.45, "in"), pos = 0)
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(0.45, "in"), pos = nrow(g))
  
  g
}

# ================================================================
# 8. Export helper
# ================================================================

save_heatmap_outputs <- function(g, pdf_file, png_file,
                                 pdf_width = 68,
                                 pdf_height = 36,
                                 png_width = 68,
                                 png_height = 36,
                                 png_res = 500) {
  
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    filename = pdf_file,
    width = pdf_width,
    height = pdf_height,
    bg = "white"
  )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(g)
  dev.off()
  
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ragg::agg_png(
      filename = png_file,
      width = png_width,
      height = png_height,
      units = "in",
      res = png_res,
      background = "white"
    )
  } else {
    png(
      filename = png_file,
      width = png_width,
      height = png_height,
      units = "in",
      res = png_res,
      type = "cairo-png",
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(g)
  dev.off()
  
  invisible(list(pdf = pdf_file, png = png_file))
}

# ================================================================
# 9. Build and save both versions
# ================================================================

g_FDR <- make_heatmap_grob(
  sig_col = "is_significant_FDR"
)

g_raw_p <- make_heatmap_grob(
  sig_col = "is_significant_raw"
)

save_heatmap_outputs(
  g = g_FDR,
  pdf_file = out_pdf_FDR,
  png_file = out_png_FDR,
  pdf_width = 68,
  pdf_height = 36,
  png_width = 68,
  png_height = 36,
  png_res = 500
)

save_heatmap_outputs(
  g = g_raw_p,
  pdf_file = out_pdf_raw,
  png_file = out_png_raw,
  pdf_width = 68,
  pdf_height = 36,
  png_width = 68,
  png_height = 36,
  png_res = 500
)

cat("\nSaved FDR-corrected heatmap files:\n")
cat("  ", out_pdf_FDR, "\n", sep = "")
cat("  ", out_png_FDR, "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved non-FDR/raw-p heatmap files:\n")
cat("  ", out_pdf_raw, "\n", sep = "")
cat("  ", out_png_raw, "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved CPM test table:\n")
cat("  ", out_stats, "\n", sep = "")
```

## PNAS export
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Export Fig. 6 at final PNAS size
#
# The heatmap is first rendered at its original design size,
# then embedded proportionally into a final-size PDF.
#
# Final dimensions preserve the original 68:36 aspect ratio:
#   22 cm wide × 11.65 cm high
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(grid)
  library(magick)
})

# ------------------------------------------------
# Output settings
# ------------------------------------------------

FIG6_WIDTH_CM  <- 22
FIG6_HEIGHT_CM <- FIG6_WIDTH_CM * (36 / 68)   # approximately 11.65 cm

FIG6_RENDER_WIDTH_IN  <- 68
FIG6_RENDER_HEIGHT_IN <- 36
FIG6_RENDER_DPI       <- 300

fig6_out_dir <- "."

dir.create(
  fig6_out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ================================================================
# Helper: render grob at full size, then embed in final-size PDF
# ================================================================

save_fig6_pnas_pdf <- function(
    grob_object,
    temp_png,
    pdf_file,
    final_width_cm = FIG6_WIDTH_CM,
    final_height_cm = FIG6_HEIGHT_CM
) {

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Render the completed heatmap at its original
  #    layout size
  # ------------------------------------------------

  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {

    ragg::agg_png(
      filename = temp_png,
      width = FIG6_RENDER_WIDTH_IN,
      height = FIG6_RENDER_HEIGHT_IN,
      units = "in",
      res = FIG6_RENDER_DPI,
      background = "white"
    )

  } else {

    grDevices::png(
      filename = temp_png,
      width = FIG6_RENDER_WIDTH_IN,
      height = FIG6_RENDER_HEIGHT_IN,
      units = "in",
      res = FIG6_RENDER_DPI,
      type = "cairo-png",
      bg = "white"
    )
  }

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(grob_object)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  if (!file.exists(temp_png)) {
    stop(
      "The temporary full-size Fig. 6 rendering was not created: ",
      temp_png
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Read the completed composite image
  # ------------------------------------------------

  fig6_img <- magick::image_read(temp_png)

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Embed the completed image in a final-size PDF
  # ------------------------------------------------

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    filename = pdf_file,
    width = final_width_cm / 2.54,
    height = final_height_cm / 2.54,
    bg = "white",
    onefile = FALSE
  )

  grid::grid.newpage()

  grid::grid.raster(
    as.raster(fig6_img),
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    width = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    interpolate = TRUE
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()

  if (!file.exists(pdf_file)) {
    stop(
      "The final Fig. 6 PDF was not created: ",
      pdf_file
    )
  }

  unlink(temp_png)

  invisible(pdf_file)
}

# ================================================================
# Manuscript version: raw P-value significance markers
# ================================================================

temp_png_fig6_raw <- file.path(
  fig6_out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Fig6_fullsize_raw_p_",
    format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y"),
    "_TEMP.png"
  )
)

pdf_out_fig6_raw <- file.path(
  fig6_out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Fig6_Targeted_Hypoxia_HIF_Genes_raw_p_",
    format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y"),
    "_PNAS_22cm.pdf"
  )
)

save_fig6_pnas_pdf(
  grob_object = g_raw_p,
  temp_png = temp_png_fig6_raw,
  pdf_file = pdf_out_fig6_raw
)

# ================================================================
# Optional FDR-corrected version
# ================================================================

temp_png_fig6_FDR <- file.path(
  fig6_out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Fig6_fullsize_FDR_",
    format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y"),
    "_TEMP.png"
  )
)

pdf_out_fig6_FDR <- file.path(
  fig6_out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Fig6_Targeted_Hypoxia_HIF_Genes_FDR_",
    format(Sys.Date(), "%d%b%Y"),
    "_PNAS_22cm.pdf"
  )
)

save_fig6_pnas_pdf(
  grob_object = g_FDR,
  temp_png = temp_png_fig6_FDR,
  pdf_file = pdf_out_fig6_FDR
)

# ================================================================
# Confirm outputs
# ================================================================

cat("\nSaved final PNAS-sized Fig. 6 files:\n")
cat(
  "  Raw-P PDF: ",
  normalizePath(pdf_out_fig6_raw),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "  FDR PDF:   ",
  normalizePath(pdf_out_fig6_FDR),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  file.info(
    c(
      pdf_out_fig6_raw,
      pdf_out_fig6_FDR
    )
  )[, c("size", "mtime")]
)
```
