And, we run GO enrichment analysis on the sets of genes from edgeR.

# GO term enrichment analysis

This section now runs the species-level GO enrichment through a shared helper so the g:Profiler call, background handling, plot style, and output locations are consistent across species and treatments.

```{r}
# ================================================================
# Species-specific GO:BP enrichment using mapped zebrafish ENSDARG IDs
#
# Key logic:
#   - Species-specific enrichment does NOT restrict to repaired 1:1 DrOrtholog sets.
#   - Each species' DEGs are mapped to zebrafish ENSDARG using maps[[species]].
#   - Each species' tested background is mapped the same way.
#   - g:Profiler is run in drerio space with query ENSDARG IDs and custom_bg ENSDARG IDs.
#   - ILOS object names are retained for compatibility, but display/output labels use ILOP.
#   - Fixes recursive default-argument error in run_species_go_enrichment_ensdarg().
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gprofiler2)
  library(scico)
})

# ================================================================
# 0. Settings
# ================================================================

if (!exists("run_date")) {
  run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
}

go_out_dir   <- file.path("edgeR_output", "GO_enrichment_species_specific")
go_map_dir   <- file.path(go_out_dir, "mapped_gene_tables")
go_plot_dir  <- file.path(go_out_dir, "plots")
go_table_dir <- file.path(go_out_dir, "result_tables")

dir.create(go_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(go_map_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(go_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(go_table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

go_alpha <- 0.05
go_top_n_plot <- 20
go_min_query_ids <- 10

# g:Profiler correction options include "g_SCS", "fdr", and "bonferroni".
# "g_SCS" is commonly used with g:Profiler.
go_correction_method <- "g_SCS"

species_order <- c("MAC", "GIB", "COR", "GEO", "ACE")

species_labels <- c(
  ACE = "C. aceratus",
  MAC = "E. maclovinus",
  GIB = "G. gibberifrons",
  COR = "N. coriiceps",
  GEO = "P. georgianus"
)

condition_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~condition_internal, ~condition_display,
  "Hypoxia",           "Hypoxia",
  "ILOS",              "ILOP"
)

# ================================================================
# 1. Basic helpers
# ================================================================

clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x)))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}

norm_gene_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

get_obj_or_null <- function(obj_name) {
  if (exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
    get(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

get_gene_ids_from_df <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  
  if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
    ids <- as.character(df$Gene)
  } else if ("GeneID" %in% names(df)) {
    ids <- as.character(df$GeneID)
  } else {
    ids <- rownames(df)
  }
  
  clean_set(ids)
}

get_logfc_from_df <- function(df, gene_ids) {
  if (is.null(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(gene_ids)))
  }
  
  if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
    key <- as.character(df$Gene)
  } else if ("GeneID" %in% names(df)) {
    key <- as.character(df$GeneID)
  } else {
    key <- rownames(df)
  }
  
  as.numeric(df$logFC[match(gene_ids, key)])
}

wrap_label <- function(x, width = 55) {
  vapply(
    as.character(x),
    function(z) paste(strwrap(z, width = width), collapse = "\n"),
    character(1)
  )
}

print_if_not_null <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x)) print(x)
  invisible(x)
}

# ================================================================
# 2. Prepare species map
# ================================================================

prep_species_map_for_go <- function(map_df, species) {
  map_df <- as.data.frame(map_df)
  
  if (!"key" %in% names(map_df)) {
    stop("maps[[", species, "]] must contain a 'key' column.")
  }
  
  if (!"ENSDARG" %in% names(map_df)) {
    stop(
      "maps[[", species, "]] must contain an 'ENSDARG' column. ",
      "For species-specific GO enrichment, use the repaired species-to-zebrafish map, ",
      "not a DrOrtholog-only map."
    )
  }
  
  if (!"Symbol" %in% names(map_df)) {
    map_df$Symbol <- NA_character_
  }
  
  map_df %>%
    transmute(
      species = species,
      species_key = as.character(key),
      species_key_norm = norm_gene_key(key),
      ENSDARG = as.character(ENSDARG),
      ZF_symbol_from_map = as.character(Symbol)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(species_key), nzchar(species_key),
      !is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG),
      grepl("^ENSDARG", ENSDARG)
    ) %>%
    distinct(species_key, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Map species gene IDs to zebrafish ENSDARG
# ================================================================

map_species_gene_ids_to_ensdarg <- function(gene_ids,
                                            species,
                                            map_df,
                                            logFC = NULL,
                                            label = NULL) {
  
  gene_ids <- clean_set(gene_ids)
  
  if (is.null(label)) {
    label <- species
  }
  
  if (!length(gene_ids)) {
    return(tibble(
      species = character(),
      input_gene_id = character(),
      logFC = numeric(),
      species_key = character(),
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ZF_symbol_from_map = character(),
      match_method = character()
    ))
  }
  
  if (is.null(logFC)) {
    logFC <- rep(NA_real_, length(gene_ids))
  }
  
  gene_tbl <- tibble(
    input_order = seq_along(gene_ids),
    input_gene_id = gene_ids,
    input_key_norm = norm_gene_key(gene_ids),
    logFC = as.numeric(logFC)
  )
  
  map_clean <- prep_species_map_for_go(map_df, species)
  
  joined_exact <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_gene_id" = "species_key"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "exact")
  
  joined_norm <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, species_key_norm, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key_norm, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_key_norm" = "species_key_norm"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "normalized")
  
  mapped <- bind_rows(joined_exact, joined_norm) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG)) %>%
    arrange(
      input_order,
      factor(match_method, levels = c("exact", "normalized"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(input_gene_id, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(species = species) %>%
    select(
      species,
      input_gene_id,
      logFC,
      species_key,
      ENSDARG,
      ZF_symbol_from_map,
      match_method
    )
  
  cat(
    "\n[", label, "]\n",
    "  Input genes:        ", length(gene_ids), "\n",
    "  Mapped input genes: ", dplyr::n_distinct(mapped$input_gene_id), "\n",
    "  Mapped ENSDARG:     ", dplyr::n_distinct(mapped$ENSDARG), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  mapped
}

map_deg_df_to_ensdarg <- function(sig_df, species, map_df, label = NULL) {
  gene_ids <- get_gene_ids_from_df(sig_df)
  logFC <- get_logfc_from_df(sig_df, gene_ids)
  
  map_species_gene_ids_to_ensdarg(
    gene_ids = gene_ids,
    species = species,
    map_df = map_df,
    logFC = logFC,
    label = label
  )
}

map_background_to_ensdarg <- function(background_genes, species, map_df) {
  map_species_gene_ids_to_ensdarg(
    gene_ids = background_genes,
    species = species,
    map_df = map_df,
    logFC = NULL,
    label = paste0(species, " tested background")
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 4. GO enrichment helper
# ================================================================

run_species_go_enrichment_ensdarg <- function(species,
                                              condition_display,
                                              sig_mapped_df,
                                              background_mapped_df,
                                              run_date,
                                              out_dir = go_out_dir,
                                              table_dir = go_table_dir,
                                              plot_dir = go_plot_dir,
                                              min_query_ids = 10,
                                              alpha_cutoff = 0.05,
                                              top_n_terms = 20,
                                              correction = "g_SCS") {
  
  query_ids <- clean_set(sig_mapped_df$ENSDARG)
  background_ids <- clean_set(background_mapped_df$ENSDARG)
  
  # Essential: custom_bg and query must use the same ID syntax.
  query_ids <- intersect(query_ids, background_ids)
  
  empty_result <- list(
    species = species,
    condition = condition_display,
    query_genes = query_ids,
    background_genes = background_ids,
    gost = NULL,
    result_table = tibble(),
    plot = NULL,
    status = "not_run"
  )
  
  cat(
    "\n[GO input: ", species, " ", condition_display, "]\n",
    "  Query ENSDARG in background: ", length(query_ids), "\n",
    "  Background ENSDARG:          ", length(background_ids), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  if (length(query_ids) < min_query_ids) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] skipping GO enrichment: only ",
      length(query_ids), " query ENSDARG IDs after background intersection."
    )
    
    empty_result$status <- "too_few_query_ids"
    return(empty_result)
  }
  
  if (length(background_ids) < 100) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] skipping GO enrichment: background has only ",
      length(background_ids), " ENSDARG IDs."
    )
    
    empty_result$status <- "too_few_background_ids"
    return(empty_result)
  }
  
  gostres <- tryCatch(
    gprofiler2::gost(
      query = query_ids,
      organism = "drerio",
      sources = "GO:BP",
      correction_method = correction,
      significant = FALSE,
      user_threshold = alpha_cutoff,
      custom_bg = background_ids,
      domain_scope = "custom"
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(gostres, "error")) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] g:Profiler failed: ",
      conditionMessage(gostres)
    )
    
    empty_result$gost <- gostres
    empty_result$status <- paste0("gprofiler_error: ", conditionMessage(gostres))
    return(empty_result)
  }
  
  if (is.null(gostres$result) || !nrow(gostres$result)) {
    message("[", species, " ", condition_display, "] g:Profiler returned no rows.")
    
    empty_result$gost <- gostres
    empty_result$status <- "no_gprofiler_rows"
    return(empty_result)
  }
  
  res_tbl <- as_tibble(gostres$result) %>%
    filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species,
      Species_label = dplyr::recode(species, !!!species_labels),
      Treatment = condition_display,
      correction_method = correction,
      p_corrected = p_value,
      neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(p_corrected, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      significant_by_threshold = p_corrected <= alpha_cutoff,
      gene_ratio = intersection_size / query_size,
      term_name_wrapped = wrap_label(term_name, width = 55)
    )
  
  if (!nrow(res_tbl)) {
    message("[", species, " ", condition_display, "] no GO:BP rows after filtering.")
    
    empty_result$gost <- gostres
    empty_result$status <- "no_GO_BP_rows"
    return(empty_result)
  }
  
  out_stub <- paste(
    species,
    condition_display,
    "GO_BP",
    correction,
    run_date,
    sep = "_"
  )
  
  out_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", out_stub)
  
  readr::write_csv(
    res_tbl,
    file.path(table_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_full_results.csv"))
  )
  
  readr::write_csv(
    res_tbl %>% filter(significant_by_threshold),
    file.path(table_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_significant_results.csv"))
  )
  
  plot_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
    filter(significant_by_threshold) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = p_corrected, n = top_n_terms, with_ties = FALSE)
  
  if (!nrow(plot_tbl)) {
    plot_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
      slice_min(order_by = p_corrected, n = top_n_terms, with_ties = FALSE)
  }
  
  plot_tbl <- plot_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      term_name_wrapped = factor(
        term_name_wrapped,
        levels = rev(unique(term_name_wrapped))
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_tbl,
    aes(
      x = gene_ratio,
      y = term_name_wrapped,
      size = intersection_size,
      color = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_scico(
      palette = "vik",
      direction = -1,
      name = expression(-log[10] * "(corrected p)")
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Genes in term") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species, " ", condition_display, " GO:BP enrichment"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "g:Profiler / drerio / custom tested background / correction = ",
        correction
      ),
      x = "Gene ratio in query",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9.5,
    height = 7.5,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9.5,
    height = 7.5,
    dpi = 450,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  list(
    species = species,
    condition = condition_display,
    query_genes = query_ids,
    background_genes = background_ids,
    gost = gostres,
    result_table = res_tbl,
    plot = p,
    status = "ok"
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 5. Check required mapping object
# ================================================================

stopifnot(exists("maps"))

available_species <- species_order[species_order %in% names(maps)]

if (!length(available_species)) {
  stop("No species in species_order were found in maps.")
}

cat("\nSpecies available in maps:\n")
print(available_species)

# ================================================================
# 6. Map species-specific DEGs and backgrounds
# ================================================================

mapped_deg_results <- list()
mapped_backgrounds <- list()
mapping_diagnostics <- list()

for (sp in available_species) {
  
  keep_obj_name <- paste0("keep_counts_", sp)
  keep_counts_sp <- get_obj_or_null(keep_obj_name)
  
  if (is.null(keep_counts_sp)) {
    message("[", sp, "] skipping: missing ", keep_obj_name)
    next
  }
  
  background_genes <- rownames(keep_counts_sp)
  
  mapped_backgrounds[[sp]] <- map_background_to_ensdarg(
    background_genes = background_genes,
    species = sp,
    map_df = maps[[sp]]
  )
  
  readr::write_csv(
    mapped_backgrounds[[sp]],
    file.path(go_map_dir, paste0("background_", sp, "_mapped_ENSDARG_", run_date, ".csv"))
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(condition_specs))) {
    
    condition_internal <- condition_specs$condition_internal[i]
    condition_display <- condition_specs$condition_display[i]
    
    sig_obj_name <- paste0("sig.", condition_internal, "_", sp, ".fdr")
    sig_df <- get_obj_or_null(sig_obj_name)
    
    if (is.null(sig_df)) {
      message("[", sp, " ", condition_display, "] skipping: missing ", sig_obj_name)
      next
    }
    
    mapped_deg <- map_deg_df_to_ensdarg(
      sig_df = sig_df,
      species = sp,
      map_df = maps[[sp]],
      label = paste0(sp, " ", condition_display, " DEGs")
    )
    
    mapped_deg_results[[sp]][[condition_display]] <- mapped_deg
    
    readr::write_csv(
      mapped_deg,
      file.path(
        go_map_dir,
        paste0("sig_", sp, "_", condition_display, "_mapped_ENSDARG_", run_date, ".csv")
      )
    )
    
    raw_query_genes <- get_gene_ids_from_df(sig_df)
    query_ensdarg <- clean_set(mapped_deg$ENSDARG)
    bg_ensdarg <- clean_set(mapped_backgrounds[[sp]]$ENSDARG)
    query_in_bg <- intersect(query_ensdarg, bg_ensdarg)
    
    mapping_diagnostics[[paste(sp, condition_display, sep = "_")]] <- tibble(
      Species = sp,
      Treatment = condition_display,
      SigObject = sig_obj_name,
      RawQueryGenes = length(raw_query_genes),
      MappedInputGenes = n_distinct(mapped_deg$input_gene_id),
      MappedQueryENSDARG = length(query_ensdarg),
      BackgroundInputGenes = length(background_genes),
      BackgroundENSDARG = length(bg_ensdarg),
      QueryENSDARG_in_Background = length(query_in_bg),
      QueryMappingRate_pct = round(
        100 * n_distinct(mapped_deg$input_gene_id) / max(length(raw_query_genes), 1),
        2
      ),
      QueryInBackgroundRate_pct = round(
        100 * length(query_in_bg) / max(length(query_ensdarg), 1),
        2
      )
    )
  }
}

go_mapping_diagnostics <- bind_rows(mapping_diagnostics)

cat("\n=== GO mapping diagnostics ===\n")
print(go_mapping_diagnostics, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  go_mapping_diagnostics,
  file.path(go_out_dir, paste0("GO_mapping_diagnostics_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

# ================================================================
# 7. Run species-specific GO enrichment
# ================================================================

edgeR_go_results <- list()

for (sp in names(mapped_deg_results)) {
  
  if (is.null(mapped_backgrounds[[sp]])) {
    next
  }
  
  for (condition_display in names(mapped_deg_results[[sp]])) {
    
    edgeR_go_results[[sp]][[condition_display]] <- run_species_go_enrichment_ensdarg(
      species = sp,
      condition_display = condition_display,
      sig_mapped_df = mapped_deg_results[[sp]][[condition_display]],
      background_mapped_df = mapped_backgrounds[[sp]],
      run_date = run_date,
      min_query_ids = go_min_query_ids,
      alpha_cutoff = go_alpha,
      top_n_terms = go_top_n_plot,
      correction = go_correction_method
    )
  }
}

# ================================================================
# 8. GO enrichment summary
# ================================================================

edgeR_go_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_go_results), function(sp) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_go_results[[sp]]), function(cond) {
    
    res <- edgeR_go_results[[sp]][[cond]]
    
    tibble(
      Species = sp,
      Treatment = cond,
      Status = res$status,
      QueryGenes_ENSDARG = length(res$query_genes),
      BackgroundGenes_ENSDARG = length(res$background_genes),
      GOTerms_Total = nrow(res$result_table),
      GOTerms_Significant = if (nrow(res$result_table)) {
        sum(res$result_table$significant_by_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        0L
      },
      MinCorrectedP = if (nrow(res$result_table)) {
        min(res$result_table$p_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  }))
}))

cat("\n=== edgeR GO enrichment summary ===\n")
print(edgeR_go_summary, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  edgeR_go_summary,
  file.path(go_out_dir, paste0("edgeR_GO_enrichment_summary_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

# ================================================================
# 9. Display plots
# ================================================================

for (sp in names(edgeR_go_results)) {
  for (cond in names(edgeR_go_results[[sp]])) {
    cat("\n\n--- ", sp, " ", cond, " ---\n", sep = "")
    print_if_not_null(edgeR_go_results[[sp]][[cond]]$plot)
  }
}
```


# Pathway Analysis (KEGG)

```{r}
# ================================================================
# Species-specific KEGG pathway enrichment + optional pathview output
#
# Key logic:
#   - Species-specific KEGG does NOT restrict to 1:1 DrOrtholog sets.
#   - Each species' DEGs are mapped to zebrafish ENSDARG using maps[[species]].
#   - Each species' tested background is mapped the same way.
#   - KEGG enrichment uses zebrafish Entrez IDs via clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG().
#   - Dotplots are ranked and shaded by raw p-value.
#   - FDR/q-values are retained in the output tables.
#   - ILOS object names are retained for compatibility, but display labels use ILOP.
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pathview)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)
  library(scico)
})

# ================================================================
# 0. Settings
# ================================================================

if (!exists("run_date")) {
  run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
}

kegg_out_dir      <- file.path("edgeR_output", "KEGG_species_specific")
kegg_map_dir      <- file.path(kegg_out_dir, "mapped_gene_tables")
kegg_table_dir    <- file.path(kegg_out_dir, "result_tables")
kegg_plot_dir     <- file.path(kegg_out_dir, "dotplots")
kegg_pathview_dir <- file.path(kegg_out_dir, "pathview")

dir.create(kegg_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(kegg_map_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(kegg_table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(kegg_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(kegg_pathview_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

kegg_alpha <- 0.05
kegg_top_n_plot <- 20
kegg_min_query_ids <- 10

# Dotplots are ranked and shaded by raw p-value.
# FDR/q-values are retained in the tables.
kegg_plot_p_col <- "pvalue"

# Optional pathview rendering.
# Set FALSE if you only want enrichment tables/dotplots.
render_pathview_outputs <- TRUE
pathview_top_n <- 5
pathview_use <- "top_raw_p"      # options: "top_raw_p", "significant_FDR"
pathview_limit_gene <- 3

species_order <- c("MAC", "GIB", "COR", "GEO", "ACE")

species_labels <- c(
  ACE = "C. aceratus",
  MAC = "E. maclovinus",
  GIB = "G. gibberifrons",
  COR = "N. coriiceps",
  GEO = "P. georgianus"
)

condition_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~condition_internal, ~condition_display,
  "Hypoxia",           "Hypoxia",
  "ILOS",              "ILOP"
)

# Pathview color palette
.pv_cols  <- scico::scico(3, palette = "vik")
.col_low  <- .pv_cols[1]
.col_mid  <- .pv_cols[2]
.col_high <- .pv_cols[3]

# ================================================================
# 1. General helpers
# ================================================================

clean_set <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x)))
  x[nzchar(x)]
}

norm_gene_key <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

get_obj_or_null <- function(obj_name) {
  if (exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
    get(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

get_gene_ids_from_df <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
    ids <- as.character(df$Gene)
  } else if ("GeneID" %in% names(df)) {
    ids <- as.character(df$GeneID)
  } else {
    ids <- rownames(df)
  }

  clean_set(ids)
}

get_logfc_from_df <- function(df, gene_ids) {
  if (is.null(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(gene_ids)))
  }

  if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
    key <- as.character(df$Gene)
  } else if ("GeneID" %in% names(df)) {
    key <- as.character(df$GeneID)
  } else {
    key <- rownames(df)
  }

  as.numeric(df$logFC[match(gene_ids, key)])
}

wrap_label <- function(x, width = 55) {
  vapply(
    as.character(x),
    function(z) paste(strwrap(z, width = width), collapse = "\n"),
    character(1)
  )
}

parse_ratio <- function(x) {
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), "/"), function(z) {
    if (length(z) != 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(z[1]) / as.numeric(z[2])
  }, numeric(1))
}

print_if_not_null <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x)) print(x)
  invisible(x)
}

# ================================================================
# 2. Prepare species map
# ================================================================

prep_species_map_for_kegg <- function(map_df, species) {
  map_df <- as.data.frame(map_df)

  if (!"key" %in% names(map_df)) {
    stop("maps[[", species, "]] must contain a 'key' column.")
  }

  if (!"ENSDARG" %in% names(map_df)) {
    stop(
      "maps[[", species, "]] must contain an 'ENSDARG' column. ",
      "Use the repaired species-to-zebrafish map, not a DrOrtholog-only map."
    )
  }

  if (!"Symbol" %in% names(map_df)) {
    map_df$Symbol <- NA_character_
  }

  map_df %>%
    transmute(
      species = species,
      species_key = as.character(key),
      species_key_norm = norm_gene_key(key),
      species_key_lower = tolower(as.character(key)),
      species_key_upper = toupper(as.character(key)),
      ENSDARG = as.character(ENSDARG),
      ZF_symbol_from_map = as.character(Symbol)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(species_key), nzchar(species_key),
      !is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG),
      grepl("^ENSDARG", ENSDARG)
    ) %>%
    distinct(species_key, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Zebrafish ENSDARG / SYMBOL / ALIAS -> Entrez helpers
# ================================================================

map_ensdarg_to_entrez <- function(ensdarg_ids) {

  ensdarg_ids <- clean_set(ensdarg_ids)
  ensdarg_ids <- grep("^ENSDARG", ensdarg_ids, value = TRUE)

  if (!length(ensdarg_ids)) {
    return(tibble(
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ENTREZID_direct = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_direct = character(),
      direct_map_status = character()
    ))
  }

  valid_ens <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dr.eg.db, keytype = "ENSEMBL")
  valid_query <- intersect(ensdarg_ids, valid_ens)
  invalid_query <- setdiff(ensdarg_ids, valid_ens)

  if (length(invalid_query)) {
    message(
      "[ENSDARG -> Entrez] ",
      length(invalid_query),
      " ENSDARG IDs are not valid ENSEMBL keys in org.Dr.eg.db; attempting fallback mapping."
    )
  }

  direct_mapped <- if (length(valid_query)) {
    suppressMessages(
      AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Dr.eg.db,
        keys = valid_query,
        keytype = "ENSEMBL",
        columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL")
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        ENSDARG = as.character(ENSEMBL),
        ENTREZID_direct = as.character(ENTREZID),
        ZF_SYMBOL_direct = as.character(SYMBOL),
        direct_map_status = ifelse(
          !is.na(ENTREZID_direct) & nzchar(ENTREZID_direct),
          "direct_ENSDARG",
          "direct_no_ENTREZID"
        )
      ) %>%
      distinct(ENSDARG, ENTREZID_direct, .keep_all = TRUE)
  } else {
    tibble(
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ENTREZID_direct = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_direct = character(),
      direct_map_status = character()
    )
  }

  invalid_tbl <- if (length(invalid_query)) {
    tibble(
      ENSDARG = invalid_query,
      ENTREZID_direct = NA_character_,
      ZF_SYMBOL_direct = NA_character_,
      direct_map_status = "not_valid_orgDb_ENSEMBL_key"
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ENTREZID_direct = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_direct = character(),
      direct_map_status = character()
    )
  }

  bind_rows(direct_mapped, invalid_tbl) %>%
    distinct(ENSDARG, ENTREZID_direct, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

map_symbol_alias_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {

  symbols <- clean_set(symbols)

  if (!length(symbols)) {
    return(tibble(
      candidate_symbol = character(),
      ENTREZID_fallback = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_fallback = character(),
      fallback_map_method = character()
    ))
  }

  candidate_symbols <- clean_set(c(
    symbols,
    tolower(symbols),
    toupper(symbols)
  ))

  valid_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dr.eg.db, keytype = "SYMBOL")
  valid_aliases <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dr.eg.db, keytype = "ALIAS")

  symbol_query <- intersect(candidate_symbols, valid_symbols)
  alias_query <- intersect(candidate_symbols, valid_aliases)

  sym_tbl <- if (length(symbol_query)) {
    suppressMessages(
      AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Dr.eg.db,
        keys = symbol_query,
        keytype = "SYMBOL",
        columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL")
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        candidate_symbol = as.character(SYMBOL),
        ENTREZID_fallback = as.character(ENTREZID),
        ZF_SYMBOL_fallback = as.character(SYMBOL),
        fallback_map_method = "SYMBOL"
      )
  } else {
    tibble(
      candidate_symbol = character(),
      ENTREZID_fallback = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_fallback = character(),
      fallback_map_method = character()
    )
  }

  alias_tbl <- if (length(alias_query)) {
    suppressMessages(
      AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Dr.eg.db,
        keys = alias_query,
        keytype = "ALIAS",
        columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL", "ALIAS")
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        candidate_symbol = as.character(ALIAS),
        ENTREZID_fallback = as.character(ENTREZID),
        ZF_SYMBOL_fallback = as.character(SYMBOL),
        fallback_map_method = "ALIAS"
      )
  } else {
    tibble(
      candidate_symbol = character(),
      ENTREZID_fallback = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL_fallback = character(),
      fallback_map_method = character()
    )
  }

  bind_rows(sym_tbl, alias_tbl) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID_fallback), nzchar(ENTREZID_fallback)) %>%
    distinct(candidate_symbol, ENTREZID_fallback, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# ================================================================
# 4. Map species gene IDs -> zebrafish ENSDARG -> Entrez
# ================================================================

map_species_gene_ids_to_kegg <- function(gene_ids,
                                         species,
                                         map_df,
                                         logFC = NULL,
                                         label = NULL,
                                         allow_key_symbol_fallback = TRUE) {

  gene_ids <- clean_set(gene_ids)

  if (is.null(label)) {
    label <- species
  }

  if (!length(gene_ids)) {
    return(tibble(
      species = character(),
      input_gene_id = character(),
      logFC = numeric(),
      species_key = character(),
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ZF_symbol_from_map = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL = character(),
      ENTREZID = character(),
      match_method = character(),
      entrez_map_method = character()
    ))
  }

  if (is.null(logFC)) {
    logFC <- rep(NA_real_, length(gene_ids))
  }

  gene_tbl <- tibble(
    input_order = seq_along(gene_ids),
    input_gene_id = gene_ids,
    input_key_norm = norm_gene_key(gene_ids),
    input_key_lower = tolower(gene_ids),
    input_key_upper = toupper(gene_ids),
    logFC = as.numeric(logFC)
  )

  map_clean <- prep_species_map_for_kegg(map_df, species)

  joined_norm <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, species_key_norm, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key_norm, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_key_norm" = "species_key_norm"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "species_norm")

  joined_exact <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_gene_id" = "species_key"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "exact")

  joined_lower <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, species_key_lower, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key_lower, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_key_lower" = "species_key_lower"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "lower")

  joined_upper <- gene_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      map_clean %>%
        select(species_key, species_key_upper, ENSDARG, ZF_symbol_from_map) %>%
        distinct(species_key_upper, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("input_key_upper" = "species_key_upper"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(match_method = "upper")

  mapped_ens <- bind_rows(
    joined_norm,
    joined_exact,
    joined_lower,
    joined_upper
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG)) %>%
    arrange(
      input_order,
      factor(match_method, levels = c("species_norm", "exact", "lower", "upper"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(input_gene_id, ENSDARG, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(species = species) %>%
    select(
      species,
      input_gene_id,
      logFC,
      species_key,
      ENSDARG,
      ZF_symbol_from_map,
      match_method
    )

  if (!nrow(mapped_ens)) {
    cat(
      "\n[", label, "]\n",
      "  Input genes:        ", length(gene_ids), "\n",
      "  Mapped input genes: 0\n",
      "  Mapped ENSDARG:     0\n",
      "  Mapped ENTREZID:    0\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    return(tibble(
      species = character(),
      input_gene_id = character(),
      logFC = numeric(),
      species_key = character(),
      ENSDARG = character(),
      ZF_symbol_from_map = character(),
      ZF_SYMBOL = character(),
      ENTREZID = character(),
      match_method = character(),
      entrez_map_method = character()
    ))
  }

  # Direct ENSDARG -> Entrez
  entrez_direct <- map_ensdarg_to_entrez(mapped_ens$ENSDARG)

  mapped_direct <- mapped_ens %>%
    left_join(
      entrez_direct,
      by = "ENSDARG",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    )

  # Fallback Symbol / Alias -> Entrez
  fallback_long <- mapped_ens %>%
    mutate(
      fallback_symbol_1 = ZF_symbol_from_map,
      fallback_symbol_2 = if (allow_key_symbol_fallback) species_key else NA_character_,
      fallback_symbol_3 = if (allow_key_symbol_fallback) input_gene_id else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(
      species,
      input_gene_id,
      ENSDARG,
      fallback_symbol_1,
      fallback_symbol_2,
      fallback_symbol_3
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("fallback_symbol_"),
      names_to = "fallback_priority",
      values_to = "fallback_symbol"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fallback_symbol), nzchar(fallback_symbol)) %>%
    mutate(
      fallback_priority = factor(
        fallback_priority,
        levels = c("fallback_symbol_1", "fallback_symbol_2", "fallback_symbol_3")
      ),
      candidate_symbol = fallback_symbol
    )

  fallback_map <- map_symbol_alias_to_entrez(fallback_long$candidate_symbol)

  fallback_best <- fallback_long %>%
    left_join(
      fallback_map,
      by = "candidate_symbol",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID_fallback), nzchar(ENTREZID_fallback)) %>%
    arrange(
      input_gene_id,
      ENSDARG,
      fallback_priority,
      factor(fallback_map_method, levels = c("SYMBOL", "ALIAS"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(input_gene_id, ENSDARG, ENTREZID_fallback, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(input_gene_id, ENSDARG) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      input_gene_id,
      ENSDARG,
      fallback_symbol,
      ENTREZID_fallback,
      ZF_SYMBOL_fallback,
      fallback_map_method
    )

  mapped_combined <- mapped_direct %>%
    left_join(
      fallback_best,
      by = c("input_gene_id", "ENSDARG"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ENTREZID = dplyr::coalesce(ENTREZID_direct, ENTREZID_fallback),
      ZF_SYMBOL = dplyr::coalesce(ZF_SYMBOL_direct, ZF_SYMBOL_fallback, ZF_symbol_from_map),
      entrez_map_method = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(ENTREZID_direct) & nzchar(ENTREZID_direct) ~ "direct_ENSDARG",
        !is.na(ENTREZID_fallback) & nzchar(ENTREZID_fallback) ~ paste0("fallback_", fallback_map_method),
        TRUE ~ "unmapped"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
    distinct(input_gene_id, ENSDARG, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(
      species,
      input_gene_id,
      logFC,
      species_key,
      ENSDARG,
      ZF_symbol_from_map,
      ZF_SYMBOL,
      ENTREZID,
      match_method,
      entrez_map_method
    )

  cat(
    "\n[", label, "]\n",
    "  Input genes:        ", length(gene_ids), "\n",
    "  Mapped input genes: ", dplyr::n_distinct(mapped_combined$input_gene_id), "\n",
    "  Mapped ENSDARG:     ", dplyr::n_distinct(mapped_combined$ENSDARG), "\n",
    "  Mapped ENTREZID:    ", dplyr::n_distinct(mapped_combined$ENTREZID), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat("  Entrez map methods:\n")
  print(
    mapped_combined %>%
      count(entrez_map_method, sort = TRUE),
    n = Inf
  )

  mapped_combined
}

map_deg_df_to_kegg <- function(sig_df, species, map_df, label = NULL) {
  gene_ids <- get_gene_ids_from_df(sig_df)
  logFC <- get_logfc_from_df(sig_df, gene_ids)

  map_species_gene_ids_to_kegg(
    gene_ids = gene_ids,
    species = species,
    map_df = map_df,
    logFC = logFC,
    label = label
  )
}

map_background_to_kegg <- function(background_genes, species, map_df) {
  map_species_gene_ids_to_kegg(
    gene_ids = background_genes,
    species = species,
    map_df = map_df,
    logFC = NULL,
    label = paste0(species, " tested background")
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 5. enrichKEGG helper
# ================================================================

run_enrichKEGG_safe <- function(query_entrez,
                                background_entrez,
                                organism = "dre",
                                pvalue_cutoff = 1,
                                qvalue_cutoff = 1,
                                p_adjust_method = "BH") {

  query_entrez <- clean_set(query_entrez)
  background_entrez <- clean_set(background_entrez)

  res <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
      gene = query_entrez,
      universe = background_entrez,
      organism = organism,
      keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
      pvalueCutoff = pvalue_cutoff,
      qvalueCutoff = qvalue_cutoff,
      pAdjustMethod = p_adjust_method
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(res, "error")) {
    message(
      "[enrichKEGG] keyType='ncbi-geneid' failed; retrying with default keyType. Error was: ",
      conditionMessage(res)
    )

    res <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
        gene = query_entrez,
        universe = background_entrez,
        organism = organism,
        pvalueCutoff = pvalue_cutoff,
        qvalueCutoff = qvalue_cutoff,
        pAdjustMethod = p_adjust_method
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
  }

  res
}

# ================================================================
# 6. KEGG enrichment helper
# ================================================================

run_species_kegg_enrichment <- function(species,
                                        condition_display,
                                        sig_mapped_df,
                                        background_mapped_df,
                                        run_date,
                                        table_dir = kegg_table_dir,
                                        plot_dir = kegg_plot_dir,
                                        min_query_ids = 10,
                                        alpha_cutoff = 0.05,
                                        top_n_terms = 20,
                                        plot_p_col = "pvalue") {

  query_entrez <- clean_set(sig_mapped_df$ENTREZID)
  background_entrez <- clean_set(background_mapped_df$ENTREZID)

  query_entrez <- intersect(query_entrez, background_entrez)

  empty_result <- list(
    species = species,
    condition = condition_display,
    query_genes = query_entrez,
    background_genes = background_entrez,
    kegg = NULL,
    result_table = tibble(),
    plot = NULL,
    status = "not_run"
  )

  cat(
    "\n[KEGG input: ", species, " ", condition_display, "]\n",
    "  Query ENTREZID in background: ", length(query_entrez), "\n",
    "  Background ENTREZID:          ", length(background_entrez), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (length(query_entrez) < min_query_ids) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] skipping KEGG enrichment: only ",
      length(query_entrez), " query Entrez IDs after background intersection."
    )

    empty_result$status <- "too_few_query_ids"
    return(empty_result)
  }

  if (length(background_entrez) < 100) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] skipping KEGG enrichment: background has only ",
      length(background_entrez), " Entrez IDs."
    )

    empty_result$status <- "too_few_background_ids"
    return(empty_result)
  }

  kegg_res <- run_enrichKEGG_safe(
    query_entrez = query_entrez,
    background_entrez = background_entrez,
    organism = "dre",
    pvalue_cutoff = 1,
    qvalue_cutoff = 1,
    p_adjust_method = "BH"
  )

  if (inherits(kegg_res, "error")) {
    message(
      "[", species, " ", condition_display, "] enrichKEGG failed: ",
      conditionMessage(kegg_res)
    )

    empty_result$kegg <- kegg_res
    empty_result$status <- paste0("enrichKEGG_error: ", conditionMessage(kegg_res))
    return(empty_result)
  }

  res_tbl <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(kegg_res))

  if (!nrow(res_tbl)) {
    message("[", species, " ", condition_display, "] enrichKEGG returned no rows.")

    empty_result$kegg <- kegg_res
    empty_result$status <- "no_kegg_rows"
    return(empty_result)
  }

  res_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
    arrange(pvalue) %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species,
      Species_label = dplyr::recode(species, !!!species_labels),
      Treatment = condition_display,
      significant_FDR = p.adjust <= alpha_cutoff,
      significant_qvalue = qvalue <= alpha_cutoff,
      gene_ratio_num = parse_ratio(GeneRatio),
      bg_ratio_num = parse_ratio(BgRatio),
      neg_log10_raw_p = -log10(pmax(pvalue, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      neg_log10_FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      Description_wrapped = wrap_label(Description, width = 55)
    )

  out_stub <- paste(
    species,
    condition_display,
    "KEGG",
    run_date,
    sep = "_"
  )

  out_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", out_stub)

  readr::write_csv(
    res_tbl,
    file.path(table_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_full_results.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    res_tbl %>% filter(significant_FDR),
    file.path(table_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_FDR_significant_results.csv"))
  )

  plot_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
    slice_min(order_by = .data[[plot_p_col]], n = top_n_terms, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Description_wrapped = factor(
        Description_wrapped,
        levels = rev(unique(Description_wrapped))
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_tbl,
    aes(
      x = gene_ratio_num,
      y = Description_wrapped,
      size = Count,
      color = neg_log10_raw_p
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_scico(
      palette = "vik",
      direction = -1,
      name = expression(-log[10] * "(raw p)")
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Genes in pathway") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species, " ", condition_display, " KEGG enrichment"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG / dre / species-specific tested background",
        "\nTop pathways ranked by raw p-value; FDR retained in output tables"
      ),
      x = "Gene ratio in query",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot_raw_p.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9.5,
    height = 7.5,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot_raw_p.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9.5,
    height = 7.5,
    dpi = 450,
    bg = "white"
  )

  list(
    species = species,
    condition = condition_display,
    query_genes = query_entrez,
    background_genes = background_entrez,
    kegg = kegg_res,
    result_table = res_tbl,
    plot = p,
    status = "ok"
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 7. Pathview helpers
# ================================================================

make_pathview_gene_vector <- function(mapped_df) {
  if (is.null(mapped_df) || !nrow(mapped_df)) {
    return(numeric(0))
  }

  if (!all(c("ENTREZID", "logFC") %in% names(mapped_df))) {
    stop("mapped_df must contain ENTREZID and logFC columns.")
  }

  d <- mapped_df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(as.character(ENTREZID)),
      !is.na(logFC)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID),
      abs_logFC = abs(logFC)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_logFC)) %>%
    distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  v <- d$logFC
  names(v) <- d$ENTREZID

  v
}

run_pathview_for_kegg_result <- function(species,
                                         condition_display,
                                         mapped_deg_df,
                                         kegg_result_tbl,
                                         run_date,
                                         pathview_dir = kegg_pathview_dir,
                                         pathview_use = "top_raw_p",
                                         top_n = 5,
                                         limit_gene = 3) {

  gene_vec <- make_pathview_gene_vector(mapped_deg_df)

  if (!length(gene_vec)) {
    message("[pathview] ", species, " ", condition_display, ": no Entrez/logFC vector.")
    return(invisible(character(0)))
  }

  if (is.null(kegg_result_tbl) || !nrow(kegg_result_tbl)) {
    message("[pathview] ", species, " ", condition_display, ": no KEGG result table.")
    return(invisible(character(0)))
  }

  if (pathview_use == "significant_FDR") {
    path_tbl <- kegg_result_tbl %>%
      filter(significant_FDR) %>%
      arrange(p.adjust)
  } else {
    path_tbl <- kegg_result_tbl %>%
      arrange(pvalue)
  }

  path_tbl <- path_tbl %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)

  if (!nrow(path_tbl)) {
    message("[pathview] ", species, " ", condition_display, ": no pathways selected.")
    return(invisible(character(0)))
  }

  out_dir <- file.path(pathview_dir, species, condition_display)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  old_wd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(old_wd), add = TRUE)
  setwd(out_dir)

  out_files <- character(0)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(path_tbl))) {

    pid_full <- as.character(path_tbl$ID[i])
    pid_num <- sub("^dre", "", pid_full)
    pathway_name <- as.character(path_tbl$Description[i])

    suffix <- paste(species, condition_display, run_date, sep = "_")
    suffix <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", suffix)

    message(
      "[pathview] ",
      species, " ", condition_display,
      " | ", pid_full, " | ", pathway_name
    )

    pv <- tryCatch(
      pathview::pathview(
        gene.data = gene_vec,
        pathway.id = pid_num,
        species = "dre",
        kegg.native = TRUE,
        gene.idtype = "entrez",
        limit = list(gene = limit_gene, cpd = 1),
        low = list(gene = .col_low, cpd = "transparent"),
        mid = list(gene = .col_mid, cpd = "transparent"),
        high = list(gene = .col_high, cpd = "transparent"),
        na.col = "transparent",
        out.suffix = suffix
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(pv, "error")) {
      message(
        "[pathview] failed for ",
        species, " ", condition_display, " ", pid_full,
        ": ", conditionMessage(pv)
      )
      next
    }

    expected_png <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("dre", pid_num, ".", suffix, ".png")
    )

    if (!file.exists(expected_png)) {
      all_pngs <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
      guess <- all_pngs[
        grepl(paste0("dre", pid_num), basename(all_pngs), fixed = TRUE) &
          grepl(suffix, basename(all_pngs), fixed = TRUE)
      ]

      if (length(guess)) {
        expected_png <- guess[order(file.info(guess)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]
      }
    }

    if (file.exists(expected_png)) {
      out_files <- c(out_files, expected_png)
    }
  }

  invisible(out_files)
}

# ================================================================
# 8. Check required mapping object
# ================================================================

stopifnot(exists("maps"))

available_species <- species_order[species_order %in% names(maps)]

if (!length(available_species)) {
  stop("No species in species_order were found in maps.")
}

cat("\nSpecies available in maps:\n")
print(available_species)

# ================================================================
# 9. Map species-specific DEGs and backgrounds
# ================================================================

mapped_deg_results_kegg <- list()
mapped_backgrounds_kegg <- list()
kegg_mapping_diagnostics <- list()

for (sp in available_species) {

  keep_obj_name <- paste0("keep_counts_", sp)
  keep_counts_sp <- get_obj_or_null(keep_obj_name)

  if (is.null(keep_counts_sp)) {
    message("[", sp, "] skipping: missing ", keep_obj_name)
    next
  }

  background_genes <- rownames(keep_counts_sp)

  mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]] <- map_background_to_kegg(
    background_genes = background_genes,
    species = sp,
    map_df = maps[[sp]]
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]],
    file.path(kegg_map_dir, paste0("background_", sp, "_mapped_KEGG_", run_date, ".csv"))
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(condition_specs))) {

    condition_internal <- condition_specs$condition_internal[i]
    condition_display <- condition_specs$condition_display[i]

    sig_obj_name <- paste0("sig.", condition_internal, "_", sp, ".fdr")
    sig_df <- get_obj_or_null(sig_obj_name)

    if (is.null(sig_df)) {
      message("[", sp, " ", condition_display, "] skipping: missing ", sig_obj_name)
      next
    }

    mapped_deg <- map_deg_df_to_kegg(
      sig_df = sig_df,
      species = sp,
      map_df = maps[[sp]],
      label = paste0(sp, " ", condition_display, " DEGs")
    )

    mapped_deg_results_kegg[[sp]][[condition_display]] <- mapped_deg

    readr::write_csv(
      mapped_deg,
      file.path(
        kegg_map_dir,
        paste0("sig_", sp, "_", condition_display, "_mapped_KEGG_", run_date, ".csv")
      )
    )

    raw_query_genes <- get_gene_ids_from_df(sig_df)

    query_ensdarg <- clean_set(mapped_deg$ENSDARG)
    query_entrez <- clean_set(mapped_deg$ENTREZID)

    bg_ensdarg <- clean_set(mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]]$ENSDARG)
    bg_entrez <- clean_set(mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]]$ENTREZID)

    query_entrez_in_bg <- intersect(query_entrez, bg_entrez)

    kegg_mapping_diagnostics[[paste(sp, condition_display, sep = "_")]] <- tibble(
      Species = sp,
      Treatment = condition_display,
      SigObject = sig_obj_name,
      RawQueryGenes = length(raw_query_genes),
      MappedInputGenes = n_distinct(mapped_deg$input_gene_id),
      MappedQueryENSDARG = length(query_ensdarg),
      MappedQueryENTREZ = length(query_entrez),
      BackgroundInputGenes = length(background_genes),
      BackgroundENSDARG = length(bg_ensdarg),
      BackgroundENTREZ = length(bg_entrez),
      QueryENTREZ_in_Background = length(query_entrez_in_bg),
      QueryMappingRate_pct = round(
        100 * n_distinct(mapped_deg$input_gene_id) / max(length(raw_query_genes), 1),
        2
      ),
      QueryInBackgroundRate_pct = round(
        100 * length(query_entrez_in_bg) / max(length(query_entrez), 1),
        2
      ),
      EntrezRetentionFromENSDARG_pct = round(
        100 * length(query_entrez) / max(length(query_ensdarg), 1),
        2
      ),
      BackgroundEntrezRetentionFromENSDARG_pct = round(
        100 * length(bg_entrez) / max(length(bg_ensdarg), 1),
        2
      )
    )
  }
}

kegg_mapping_diagnostics <- bind_rows(kegg_mapping_diagnostics)

cat("\n=== KEGG mapping diagnostics ===\n")
print(kegg_mapping_diagnostics, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  kegg_mapping_diagnostics,
  file.path(kegg_out_dir, paste0("KEGG_mapping_diagnostics_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

# ================================================================
# 10. Run species-specific KEGG enrichment
# ================================================================

edgeR_kegg_results <- list()

for (sp in names(mapped_deg_results_kegg)) {

  if (is.null(mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]])) {
    next
  }

  for (condition_display in names(mapped_deg_results_kegg[[sp]])) {

    edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[condition_display]] <- run_species_kegg_enrichment(
      species = sp,
      condition_display = condition_display,
      sig_mapped_df = mapped_deg_results_kegg[[sp]][[condition_display]],
      background_mapped_df = mapped_backgrounds_kegg[[sp]],
      run_date = run_date,
      min_query_ids = kegg_min_query_ids,
      alpha_cutoff = kegg_alpha,
      top_n_terms = kegg_top_n_plot,
      plot_p_col = kegg_plot_p_col
    )
  }
}

# ================================================================
# 11. KEGG enrichment summary
# ================================================================

edgeR_kegg_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_kegg_results), function(sp) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]]), function(cond) {

    res <- edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]

    tibble(
      Species = sp,
      Treatment = cond,
      Status = res$status,
      QueryGenes_ENTREZ = length(res$query_genes),
      BackgroundGenes_ENTREZ = length(res$background_genes),
      KEGGTerms_Total = nrow(res$result_table),
      KEGGTerms_FDR_0.05 = if (nrow(res$result_table)) {
        sum(res$result_table$significant_FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        0L
      },
      MinRawP = if (nrow(res$result_table)) {
        min(res$result_table$pvalue, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      MinFDR = if (nrow(res$result_table)) {
        min(res$result_table$p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  }))
}))

cat("\n=== edgeR KEGG enrichment summary ===\n")
print(edgeR_kegg_summary, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  edgeR_kegg_summary,
  file.path(kegg_out_dir, paste0("edgeR_KEGG_enrichment_summary_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

# ================================================================
# 11b. Rebuild KEGG dotplots with standardized x-axis
#
# Edits:
#   - pathways selected by raw p-value
#   - pathways ordered vertically by % query genes in pathway
#   - x-axis = % query genes in pathway
#   - x-axis capped at 12%
#   - color = -log10(FDR)
#   - color scale is single-gradient, not diverging
#   - no subtitle
# ================================================================

kegg_x_axis_cap <- 12

collect_kegg_plot_terms <- function(edgeR_kegg_results,
                                    top_n_terms = kegg_top_n_plot,
                                    plot_p_col = kegg_plot_p_col) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_kegg_results), function(sp) {
    bind_rows(lapply(names(edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]]), function(cond) {
      
      res <- edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]
      
      if (!identical(res$status, "ok")) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      if (is.null(res$result_table) || !nrow(res$result_table)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      res$result_table %>%
        mutate(
          Species = sp,
          Treatment = cond,
          gene_percent = 100 * gene_ratio_num,
          neg_log10_FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin))
        ) %>%
        slice_min(
          order_by = .data[[plot_p_col]],
          n = top_n_terms,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )
    }))
  }))
}

kegg_dotplot_terms_all <- collect_kegg_plot_terms(
  edgeR_kegg_results = edgeR_kegg_results,
  top_n_terms = kegg_top_n_plot,
  plot_p_col = kegg_plot_p_col
)

if (!nrow(kegg_dotplot_terms_all)) {
  stop("No KEGG dotplot terms available from successful enrichment results.")
}

global_color_max <- max(kegg_dotplot_terms_all$neg_log10_FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
global_color_max <- ceiling(global_color_max)

if (!is.finite(global_color_max) || global_color_max <= 0) {
  global_color_max <- 1
}

cat("\n=== Standardized KEGG dotplot scales ===\n")
cat("  x-axis cap (% query genes in pathway): ", kegg_x_axis_cap, "\n", sep = "")
cat("  color max (-log10 FDR):                ", global_color_max, "\n", sep = "")

readr::write_csv(
  kegg_dotplot_terms_all,
  file.path(kegg_out_dir, paste0("KEGG_dotplot_selected_terms_FDR_colored_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

make_kegg_dotplot_percent_scaled <- function(res,
                                             species,
                                             condition_display,
                                             top_n_terms = kegg_top_n_plot,
                                             plot_p_col = kegg_plot_p_col,
                                             x_cap = kegg_x_axis_cap,
                                             color_max = global_color_max) {
  
  if (!identical(res$status, "ok")) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(res$result_table) || !nrow(res$result_table)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_tbl <- res$result_table %>%
    mutate(
      gene_percent = 100 * gene_ratio_num,
      neg_log10_FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin))
    ) %>%
    slice_min(
      order_by = .data[[plot_p_col]],
      n = top_n_terms,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    arrange(gene_percent, p.adjust) %>%
    mutate(
      Description_wrapped = factor(
        Description_wrapped,
        levels = unique(Description_wrapped)
      )
    )
  
  if (!nrow(plot_tbl)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ggplot(
    plot_tbl,
    aes(
      x = gene_percent,
      y = Description_wrapped,
      size = Count,
      color = neg_log10_FDR
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, x_cap),
      breaks = seq(0, x_cap, by = 3),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03)),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
  low = "#DEEBF7",
  high = "#08519C",
  limits = c(0, color_max),
  oob = scales::squish,
  name = expression(-log[10] * "(FDR)")
) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Genes in pathway",
      range = c(3, 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species, " ", condition_display, " KEGG enrichment"),
      x = "% of query genes in pathway",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 17,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(b = 12)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 18, b = 12, l = 12)
    )
}

# ================================================================
# 11c. Save rebuilt KEGG dotplots
# ================================================================

for (sp in names(edgeR_kegg_results)) {
  for (cond in names(edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]])) {
    
    res <- edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]
    
    if (!identical(res$status, "ok")) {
      message("[KEGG dotplot] skipping ", sp, " ", cond, ": status = ", res$status)
      next
    }
    
    p_new <- make_kegg_dotplot_percent_scaled(
      res = res,
      species = sp,
      condition_display = cond,
      top_n_terms = kegg_top_n_plot,
      plot_p_col = kegg_plot_p_col,
      x_cap = kegg_x_axis_cap,
      color_max = global_color_max
    )
    
    if (is.null(p_new)) {
      message("[KEGG dotplot] no plot made for ", sp, " ", cond)
      next
    }
    
    edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]$plot <- p_new
    
    out_stub <- paste(
      sp,
      cond,
      "KEGG",
      run_date,
      sep = "_"
    )
    
    out_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", out_stub)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        kegg_plot_dir,
        paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot_FDR_colored_percent_scaled_xcap12.pdf")
      ),
      plot = p_new,
      width = 9.5,
      height = 7.5,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        kegg_plot_dir,
        paste0(out_stub, "_dotplot_FDR_colored_percent_scaled_xcap12.png")
      ),
      plot = p_new,
      width = 9.5,
      height = 7.5,
      dpi = 450,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
}

cat("\nSaved rebuilt KEGG dotplots with x-axis capped at 12% and color = -log10(FDR).\n")

# ================================================================
# 12. Optional pathview rendering
# ================================================================

if (isTRUE(render_pathview_outputs)) {

  cat("\n=== Rendering pathview outputs ===\n")

  pathview_file_log <- list()

  for (sp in names(edgeR_kegg_results)) {
    for (cond in names(edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]])) {

      res <- edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]

      if (!identical(res$status, "ok")) {
        message("[pathview] skipping ", sp, " ", cond, ": KEGG status = ", res$status)
        next
      }

      out_files <- run_pathview_for_kegg_result(
        species = sp,
        condition_display = cond,
        mapped_deg_df = mapped_deg_results_kegg[[sp]][[cond]],
        kegg_result_tbl = res$result_table,
        run_date = run_date,
        pathview_dir = kegg_pathview_dir,
        pathview_use = pathview_use,
        top_n = pathview_top_n,
        limit_gene = pathview_limit_gene
      )

      pathview_file_log[[paste(sp, cond, sep = "_")]] <- tibble(
        Species = sp,
        Treatment = cond,
        pathview_file = as.character(out_files)
      )
    }
  }

  pathview_file_log_tbl <- bind_rows(pathview_file_log)

  if (nrow(pathview_file_log_tbl)) {
    readr::write_csv(
      pathview_file_log_tbl,
      file.path(kegg_out_dir, paste0("pathview_file_log_", run_date, ".csv"))
    )

    cat("\n=== Pathview file log ===\n")
    print(pathview_file_log_tbl, n = Inf)
  }
}

# ================================================================
# 13. Display rebuilt KEGG dotplots
# ================================================================

for (sp in names(edgeR_kegg_results)) {
  for (cond in names(edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]])) {
    
    res <- edgeR_kegg_results[[sp]][[cond]]
    
    if (!identical(res$status, "ok") || is.null(res$plot)) {
      message("[display] skipping ", sp, " ", cond, ": status = ", res$status)
      next
    }
    
    cat("\n\n--- ", sp, " ", cond, " KEGG dotplot ---\n", sep = "")
    print(res$plot)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ================================================================
# Side-by-side KEGG "pathview" panels for ACE / MAC / GIB
# - Expects 3 data frames already in memory:
#     sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr, sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr, sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr
#   each with columns: Gene (SYMBOL), Entrez, logFC  (Entrez must be character)
# - Prints the 3-wide image to console and saves a combined PNG per pathway
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(pathview)
  library(scico)
  library(magick)   # for stitching PNGs
})

# ---------- scico palette for pathview (vik diverging) ----------
.pv_cols  <- scico(3, palette = "vik")
.col_low  <- .pv_cols[1]
.col_mid  <- .pv_cols[2]
.col_high <- .pv_cols[3]

# ---------- minimal wrapper around pathview ----------
do_pv_one <- function(pid, df_logfc_entrez, species_tag, out_base = "pathview_out",
                      limit_gene = 3) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Entrez","logFC") %in% names(df_logfc_entrez)))
  # Prepare named vector for pathview
  v <- df_logfc_entrez %>%
    filter(!is.na(Entrez), !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    mutate(.abs = abs(logFC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(.abs)) %>%
    distinct(Entrez, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    { setNames(.$logFC, .$Entrez) }

  # Output dir per pathway
  out_dir <- file.path(out_base, pid)
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  old_wd <- getwd(); on.exit(setwd(old_wd), add = TRUE)
  setwd(out_dir)

  pathview(gene.data  = v,
           pathway.id = pid,
           species    = "dre",
           kegg.native = TRUE,
           limit      = list(gene = limit_gene, cpd = 1),
           low        = list(gene = .col_low),
           mid        = list(gene = .col_mid),
           high       = list(gene = .col_high),
           na.col     = "transparent",
           out.suffix = species_tag)

  invisible(out_dir)
}

# ---------- find the PNG pathview created (handles different name variants) ----------
# --- replace the old finder with this ---
# --- Drop-in replacement finder (handles filenames without 'pathview') ---
find_pv_png <- function(pid, species_tag, dir_path) {
  all_pngs <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(all_pngs)) stop("No PNGs in ", dir_path)

  base <- basename(all_pngs)

  # 1) Exact best: pid.SPECIES.png (e.g., dre00970.ACE.png)
  pat_exact <- paste0("^", pid, "\\.", species_tag, "\\.png$")
  m_exact <- grepl(pat_exact, base)
  if (any(m_exact)) return(all_pngs[which(m_exact)[1]])

  # 2) Next best: any png with pid and species tag somewhere
  m_relaxed <- grepl(pid, base, fixed = TRUE) & grepl(species_tag, base, fixed = TRUE)
  if (any(m_relaxed)) {
    # choose most recent if multiple
    cand <- all_pngs[m_relaxed]
    return(cand[order(file.info(cand)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1])
  }

  # 3) Fallback: the plain pid.png if present
  pat_plain <- paste0("^", pid, "\\.png$")
  m_plain <- grepl(pat_plain, base)
  if (any(m_plain)) return(all_pngs[which(m_plain)[1]])

  stop(
    "Could not find pathview PNG for ", pid, " / ", species_tag, " in ", dir_path,
    "\nFiles here:\n", paste(base, collapse = "\n")
  )
}


# ---------- make a 3-wide panel for one pathway and show it ----------
make_panel_for_pathway <- function(pid, title,
                                   ace_df, mac_df, gib_df,
                                   out_base = "pathview_out",
                                   panel_dir = "pathview_panels",
                                   limit_gene = 3) {
  # Run pathview per species
  dir_ace <- do_pv_one(pid, ace_df, "ACE", out_base, limit_gene)
  dir_mac <- do_pv_one(pid, mac_df, "MAC", out_base, limit_gene)
  dir_gib <- do_pv_one(pid, gib_df, "GIB", out_base, limit_gene)

  # Locate the produced PNGs
  f_ace <- find_pv_png(pid, "ACE", dir_ace)
  f_mac <- find_pv_png(pid, "MAC", dir_mac)
  f_gib <- find_pv_png(pid, "GIB", dir_gib)

  # Read + append horizontally
  imgs <- magick::image_read(c(f_ace, f_mac, f_gib))
  panel <- magick::image_append(imgs, stack = FALSE)
  # Add a simple title strip
  panel <- magick::image_annotate(panel, paste0(title, "  (ACE • MAC • GIB)"),
                                  gravity = "north", size = 28, weight = 700)

  dir.create(panel_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  out_file <- file.path(panel_dir, paste0(pid, "_ACE-MAC-GIB.png"))
  magick::image_write(panel, out_file)

  # Print to console
  print(panel)
  message("Saved: ", out_file)
  invisible(out_file)
}

# ================================================================
# USAGE
#   Pathways you called out as shared/important
# ================================================================
shared_paths <- list(
  "dre00970" = "Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis",
  "dre04010" = "MAPK signaling pathway",
  "dre04150" = "mTOR signaling pathway",
  "dre04310" = "Wnt signaling pathway",
  "dre05168" = "Herpes simplex virus 1 infection"
)

# If your tables do not already have unique Entrez per row,
# the helpers above handle deduping by |logFC|.
# Run panels (prints each to console and saves PNG in pathview_panels/)
for (pid in names(shared_paths)) {
  make_panel_for_pathway(
    pid   = pid,
    title = shared_paths[[pid]],
    ace_df = sig.Hypoxia_ACE.fdr,
    mac_df = sig.Hypoxia_MAC.fdr,
    gib_df = sig.Hypoxia_GIB.fdr,
    out_base  = "pathview_out",
    panel_dir = "pathview_panels",
    limit_gene = 3  # tweak if you want stronger/softer coloring thresholds
  )
}

# ACE & MAC ILOS

# ================================================================
# Pathview panels for **ACE vs MAC** under **ILOS**
# - Renders KEGG pathways for each species (ACE, MAC) side-by-side
# - Expects: sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr and sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr with columns
#            Gene (SYMBOL), Entrez (character), logFC
# - Saves per-pathway raw PNGs and a 2-wide panel; also prints panel
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(pathview)
  library(scico)
  library(magick)   # to stitch PNGs
})

# ---------- color anchors (scico "vik" diverging) ----------
.pv_cols  <- scico(3, palette = "vik")
.col_low  <- .pv_cols[1]
.col_mid  <- .pv_cols[2]
.col_high <- .pv_cols[3]

# ---------- prepare named vector (unique Entrez; keep largest |logFC|) ----------
.make_vector <- function(df) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Entrez","logFC") %in% names(df)))
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Entrez), !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    mutate(.abs = abs(logFC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(.abs)) %>%
    distinct(Entrez, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    { setNames(.$logFC, .$Entrez) }
}

# ---------- run pathview once ----------
do_pv_one <- function(pid, df_logfc_entrez, species_tag,
                      out_base = "pathview_out_ILOS", limit_gene = 3) {
  v <- .make_vector(df_logfc_entrez)
  out_dir <- file.path(out_base, pid)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  old <- getwd(); on.exit(setwd(old), add = TRUE)
  setwd(out_dir)

  pathview(
    gene.data   = v,
    pathway.id  = pid,
    species     = "dre",
    kegg.native = TRUE,
    limit       = list(gene = limit_gene, cpd = 1),
    low         = list(gene = .col_low),
    mid         = list(gene = .col_mid),
    high        = list(gene = .col_high),
    na.col      = "transparent",
    out.suffix  = species_tag
  )

  invisible(out_dir)
}

# ---------- find the PNG that pathview wrote (handles multiple name styles) ----------
find_pv_png <- function(pid, species_tag, dir_path) {
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(files)) stop("No PNGs in ", dir_path)

  base <- basename(files)
  # best: pid.SPECIES.png
  pat_exact <- paste0("^", pid, "\\.", species_tag, "\\.png$")
  hit <- files[grepl(pat_exact, base)]
  if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])

  # next: any file with pid and species tag
  cand <- files[grepl(pid, base, fixed = TRUE) & grepl(species_tag, base, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(cand)) return(cand[order(file.info(cand)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1])

  # fallback: bare pid.png
  bare <- files[grepl(paste0("^", pid, "\\.png$"), base)]
  if (length(bare)) return(bare[1])

  stop("Could not find pathview PNG for ", pid, " / ", species_tag, " in ", dir_path,
       "\nFiles here:\n", paste(base, collapse = "\n"))
}

# ---------- build a 2-wide panel and print it ----------
make_panel_two <- function(pid, title, ace_df, mac_df,
                           out_base = "pathview_out_ILOS",
                           panel_dir = "pathview_panels_ILOS",
                           limit_gene = 3) {

  d1 <- do_pv_one(pid, ace_df, "ACE", out_base, limit_gene)
  d2 <- do_pv_one(pid, mac_df, "MAC", out_base, limit_gene)

  f1 <- find_pv_png(pid, "ACE", d1)
  f2 <- find_pv_png(pid, "MAC", d2)

  img <- image_read(c(f1, f2)) |> image_append(stack = FALSE)
  img <- image_annotate(img, paste0(title, "  (ACE • MAC, ILOS)"),
                        gravity = "north", size = 28, weight = 700)

  dir.create(panel_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  outfile <- file.path(panel_dir, paste0(pid, "_ACE-MAC_ILOS.png"))
  image_write(img, outfile)

  print(img)
  message("Saved panel: ", outfile)
  invisible(outfile)
}

# ---------- pathways to render (same as earlier) ----------
shared_paths <- list(
  "dre00970" = "Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis",
  "dre04010" = "MAPK signaling pathway",
  "dre04150" = "mTOR signaling pathway",
  "dre04310" = "Wnt signaling pathway",
  "dre05168" = "Herpes simplex virus 1 infection"
)

# ---------- RUN for ILOS (ACE vs MAC) ----------
# Assumes you already created sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr and sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr with Entrez + logFC
for (pid in names(shared_paths)) {
  make_panel_two(pid, shared_paths[[pid]],
                 ace_df = sig.ILOS_ACE.fdr,
                 mac_df = sig.ILOS_MAC.fdr,
                 out_base = "pathview_out_ILOS",
                 panel_dir = "pathview_panels_ILOS",
                 limit_gene = 3)   # adjust color limits if desired
}

#             "pathview_panels_ILOS/ALL_ILOS_panels.png")
```

# Combined Fig. 4 -- Venns & KEGG Bubbles (Up & Down)

```{r}
# ================================================================
# KEGG BUBBLES + COMBINED DEG VENN / KEGG PANEL
# Fully revised, case-insensitive, mixed-ID aware, mapping-audited version
#
# Key fixes:
#   1. Case-insensitive matching for ALL species.
#   2. Species-map route first: species gene ID -> ENSDARG -> Entrez.
#   3. Direct zebrafish SYMBOL/ALIAS fallback for IDs not successfully mapped
#      through species maps. This is important for mixed namespaces, especially ACE.
#   4. KEGG enrichment is run once and stored in KT.
#   5. Venns use full within-species DEG sets, not restricted 1:1 ortholog sets.
#   6. Bubble panels use fixed-width dot regions so KEGG panels align cleanly.
#   7. Displayed pathways are selected by FDR strength and ordered vertically by %
#      KEGG-mapped DE genes in pathway.
# ================================================================

  library(dplyr)

  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Dr.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)

})

KEGG_ORGANISM <- "dre"

KEGG_Q_CUTOFF <- 1

STOP_ON_LOW_MAPPING <- TRUE

PCT_BREAKS <- seq(0, PCT_CAP, by = 3)

# ---------- text / sizing ----------
txt_base             <- 21

# Wider pathway label band inside bubble panels
```
