```{r}
# ================================================================
# 1. General utilities
# ================================================================

clean_chr <- function(x, lowercase = FALSE) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (lowercase) x <- tolower(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  unique(x)
}

clean_match_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  unique(x)
}

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  nms <- names(df)
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nms]
  if (length(hit)) hit[[1]] else NA_character_
}

default_rownames_are_ids <- function(df) {
  rn <- rownames(df)

  !is.null(rn) &&
    length(rn) == nrow(df) &&
    !all(rn == as.character(seq_len(nrow(df))))
}

null_to_na <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !length(x) || is.na(x[[1]])) NA_character_ else as.character(x[[1]])
}

write_csv_safe <- function(x, file) {
  if (requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    readr::write_csv(x, file)
  } else {
    write.csv(x, file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

# ================================================================
# 2. DE table utilities
# ================================================================

prep_de <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(tibble())
  if (!nrow(df)) return(as_tibble(df)[0, , drop = FALSE])

  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  ids <- if ("Gene" %in% names(df)) {
    as.character(df$Gene)
  } else {
    rownames(df)
  }

  ids <- trimws(ids)

  keep <- !is.na(ids) & nzchar(ids)

  df  <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ids <- ids[keep]

  dup <- duplicated(tolower(ids))

  df  <- df[!dup, , drop = FALSE]
  ids <- ids[!dup]

  rownames(df) <- ids

  as_tibble(df, rownames = ".species_id")
}

get_de_or_empty <- function(sym) {
  obj <- if (exists(sym, inherits = TRUE)) get(sym, inherits = TRUE) else NULL
  prep_de(obj)
}

get_species_de <- function(spec, treatment) {
  obj_name <- paste0("sig.", treatment, "_", spec, ".fdr")
  get_de_or_empty(obj_name)
}

get_species_reference_ids <- function(spec) {
  bg_name <- paste0("keep_counts_", spec)

  bg_ids <- if (exists(bg_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
    rownames(get(bg_name, inherits = TRUE))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }

  hyp_df  <- get_species_de(spec, "Hypoxia")
  ilos_df <- get_species_de(spec, "ILOS")

  clean_chr(c(bg_ids, hyp_df$.species_id, ilos_df$.species_id))
}

# ================================================================
# 3. Robust zebrafish / Entrez mapping utilities
# ================================================================

.safe_select <- function(keys, keytype, columns = "ENTREZID") {
  keys <- clean_chr(keys)

  expected_cols <- unique(c(keytype, columns))

  empty_out <- tibble::as_tibble(
    stats::setNames(
      replicate(length(expected_cols), character(0), simplify = FALSE),
      expected_cols
    )
  )

  if (!length(keys)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressMessages(
      suppressWarnings(
        AnnotationDbi::select(
          org.Dr.eg.db,
          keys    = keys,
          keytype = keytype,
          columns = columns
        )
      )
    ) %>%
      tibble::as_tibble(),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "[safe_select] select() failed for keytype = ",
        keytype,
        "; returning empty mapping table. Error was: ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      empty_out
    }
  )

  for (cc in expected_cols) {
    if (!cc %in% names(out)) {
      out[[cc]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(expected_cols), dplyr::everything())
}

map_ensdarg_to_entrez <- function(ensdarg) {
  ensdarg <- clean_chr(ensdarg)
  ensdarg <- ensdarg[stringr::str_detect(ensdarg, "^ENSDARG")]

  empty_out <- tibble::tibble(
    ENSDARG  = character(),
    ENTREZID = character()
  )

  if (!length(ensdarg)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  sel <- .safe_select(
    keys    = ensdarg,
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    columns = "ENTREZID"
  )

  if (!all(c("ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID") %in% names(sel))) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  sel %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      ENSDARG  = as.character(.data$ENSEMBL),
      ENTREZID = as.character(.data$ENTREZID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$ENSDARG),
      nzchar(.data$ENSDARG),
      !is.na(.data$ENTREZID),
      nzchar(.data$ENTREZID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

map_symbol_alias_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {
  symbols <- clean_chr(symbols)

  empty_out <- tibble::tibble(
    SYMBOL_IN = character(),
    ENTREZID  = character()
  )

  if (!length(symbols)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  symbol_variants <- clean_chr(c(symbols, tolower(symbols), toupper(symbols)))

  sym_map <- .safe_select(
    keys    = symbol_variants,
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    columns = "ENTREZID"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      SYMBOL_IN = as.character(.data$SYMBOL),
      ENTREZID  = as.character(.data$ENTREZID)
    )

  alias_map <- .safe_select(
    keys    = symbol_variants,
    keytype = "ALIAS",
    columns = "ENTREZID"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      SYMBOL_IN = as.character(.data$ALIAS),
      ENTREZID  = as.character(.data$ENTREZID)
    )

  dplyr::bind_rows(sym_map, alias_map) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$SYMBOL_IN),
      nzchar(.data$SYMBOL_IN),
      !is.na(.data$ENTREZID),
      nzchar(.data$ENTREZID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

standardize_species_map <- function(map_df,
                                    spec = NA_character_,
                                    ref_ids = NULL) {
  empty_map <- tibble(
    species_id = character(),
    ENSDARG    = character(),
    SYMBOL     = character(),
    ENTREZID   = character(),
    match_id   = character()
  )

  if (is.null(map_df) || !nrow(map_df)) {
    return(empty_map)
  }

  map_df <- as.data.frame(map_df)

  if (default_rownames_are_ids(map_df)) {
    map_df$.__rownames_id <- rownames(map_df)
  }

  candidate_cols <- names(map_df)[
    vapply(
      map_df,
      function(z) is.atomic(z) && length(z) == nrow(map_df),
      logical(1)
    )
  ]

  ref_ids_norm <- clean_match_id(ref_ids)

  candidate_audit <- map_dfr(candidate_cols, function(cc) {
    vals <- clean_match_id(map_df[[cc]])
    ov   <- length(intersect(vals, ref_ids_norm))

    tibble(
      species = spec,
      column = cc,
      unique_values = length(vals),
      overlap_n = ov,
      overlap_pct_ref = if (length(ref_ids_norm)) ov / length(ref_ids_norm) else NA_real_
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(desc(overlap_n), desc(overlap_pct_ref), desc(unique_values))

  if (nrow(candidate_audit) && max(candidate_audit$overlap_n, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    key_col <- candidate_audit$column[[1]]
  } else {
    key_col <- pick_col(
      map_df,
      c(
        "key", "Key", "Gene", "gene", "GeneID", "gene_id",
        "species_id", "SpeciesID", "query", "Query", "input", "Input",
        ".__rownames_id"
      )
    )
  }

  if (is.na(key_col)) {
    warning("[", spec, "] No usable species gene ID column found in mapping table.")
    return(empty_map)
  }

  ens_scores <- map_int(candidate_cols, function(cc) {
    vals <- as.character(map_df[[cc]])
    sum(stringr::str_detect(vals, "^ENSDARG"), na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  ens_col <- if (length(ens_scores) && max(ens_scores, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    candidate_cols[[which.max(ens_scores)]]
  } else {
    pick_col(
      map_df,
      c(
        "ENSDARG", "ensdarg", "zf_ENSDARG", "zf_ensdarg",
        "Danio_ENSDARG", "danio_ensdarg", "ENSEMBL", "Ensembl"
      )
    )
  }

  sym_col <- pick_col(
    map_df,
    c(
      "Symbol", "SYMBOL", "symbol", "zf_symbol", "ZF_SYMBOL",
      "gene_symbol", "GeneSymbol", "preferred_name", "Preferred_name"
    )
  )

  entrez_col <- pick_col(
    map_df,
    c(
      "Entrez", "ENTREZID", "entrez", "EntrezID", "entrez_id"
    )
  )

  out <- tibble(
    species_id = as.character(map_df[[key_col]]),
    ENSDARG    = if (!is.na(ens_col))    as.character(map_df[[ens_col]])    else NA_character_,
    SYMBOL     = if (!is.na(sym_col))    as.character(map_df[[sym_col]])    else NA_character_,
    ENTREZID   = if (!is.na(entrez_col)) as.character(map_df[[entrez_col]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(everything(), ~ trimws(.x)),
      match_id = tolower(species_id),
      ENSDARG  = ifelse(str_detect(ENSDARG, "^ENSDARG"), ENSDARG, NA_character_),
      ENTREZID = ifelse(!is.na(ENTREZID) & nzchar(ENTREZID), ENTREZID, NA_character_),
      SYMBOL   = ifelse(!is.na(SYMBOL)   & nzchar(SYMBOL),   SYMBOL,   NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(species_id), nzchar(species_id)) %>%
    distinct()

  if (!is.na(ens_col) && key_col == ens_col) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(ENSDARG = ifelse(str_detect(species_id, "^ENSDARG"), species_id, ENSDARG))
  }

  if (!is.na(sym_col) && key_col == sym_col) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(SYMBOL = ifelse(!is.na(species_id) & nzchar(species_id), species_id, SYMBOL))
  }

  if (!is.na(entrez_col) && key_col == entrez_col) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(ENTREZID = ifelse(!is.na(species_id) & nzchar(species_id), species_id, ENTREZID))
  }

  attr(out, "key_col")    <- key_col
  attr(out, "ens_col")    <- ens_col
  attr(out, "sym_col")    <- sym_col
  attr(out, "entrez_col") <- entrez_col
  attr(out, "key_audit")  <- candidate_audit

  message("\n[", spec, "] Selected mapping key column: ", key_col)
  message("[", spec, "] Top candidate key-column overlaps, case-insensitive:")
  print(head(candidate_audit, n = min(8, nrow(candidate_audit))))

  out
}

get_species_map <- function(spec, ref_ids = NULL) {
  if (exists("maps", inherits = TRUE)) {
    maps_obj <- get("maps", inherits = TRUE)

    if (is.list(maps_obj) && !is.null(maps_obj[[spec]])) {
      message("[", spec, "] Using mapping table from maps[['", spec, "']].")
      return(
        standardize_species_map(
          maps_obj[[spec]],
          spec = spec,
          ref_ids = ref_ids
        )
      )
    }
  }

  candidate_names <- c(
    paste0(spec, "_map"),
    paste0(tolower(spec), "_map"),
    paste0("map_", spec),
    paste0("map_", tolower(spec)),
    paste0(spec, "_key_to_ENSDARG_minimal"),
    paste0(tolower(spec), "_key_to_ENSDARG_minimal")
  )

  for (nm in candidate_names) {
    if (exists(nm, inherits = TRUE)) {
      message("[", spec, "] Using mapping table from object: ", nm)
      return(
        standardize_species_map(
          get(nm, inherits = TRUE),
          spec = spec,
          ref_ids = ref_ids
        )
      )
    }
  }

  warning(
    "[", spec, "] No repaired species -> zebrafish map found. ",
    "Falling back to direct mapping of rownames as zebrafish ENSDARG/SYMBOL/ALIAS."
  )

  tibble(
    species_id = character(),
    ENSDARG    = character(),
    SYMBOL     = character(),
    ENTREZID   = character(),
    match_id   = character()
  )
}

key_match_count <- function(ids, species_map) {
  if (is.null(species_map) || !nrow(species_map)) {
    return(NA_integer_)
  }

  ids0 <- clean_match_id(ids)
  keys <- clean_match_id(species_map$species_id)

  length(intersect(ids0, keys))
}

map_species_ids_to_entrez <- function(ids,
                                      spec,
                                      species_map = NULL,
                                      context = "query",
                                      allow_direct_fallback_if_map_exists = TRUE) {
  ids_raw <- clean_chr(ids)

  if (!length(ids_raw)) {
    return(tibble(
      species_id = character(),
      ENTREZID   = character(),
      mapped_by  = character()
    ))
  }

  if (is.null(species_map)) {
    species_map <- get_species_map(spec, ref_ids = ids_raw)
  }

  if (nrow(species_map)) {
    map2 <- species_map %>%
      mutate(match_id = tolower(species_id)) %>%
      distinct(match_id, ENSDARG, SYMBOL, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

    query_tbl <- tibble(
      species_id = ids_raw,
      match_id   = tolower(ids_raw)
    )

    joined <- query_tbl %>%
      left_join(map2, by = "match_id", suffix = c("", ".map"))

    direct_entrez <- joined %>%
      filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
      transmute(
        species_id,
        ENTREZID  = as.character(ENTREZID),
        mapped_by = "map_ENTREZID"
      )

    ens_map <- map_ensdarg_to_entrez(joined$ENSDARG)

    ens_entrez <- joined %>%
      filter(!is.na(ENSDARG), nzchar(ENSDARG)) %>%
      select(species_id, ENSDARG) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      left_join(ens_map, by = "ENSDARG") %>%
      filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
      transmute(
        species_id,
        ENTREZID  = as.character(ENTREZID),
        mapped_by = "map_ENSDARG_to_ENTREZID"
      )

    sym_map <- map_symbol_alias_to_entrez(joined$SYMBOL)

    sym_entrez <- joined %>%
      filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), nzchar(SYMBOL)) %>%
      select(species_id, SYMBOL) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      left_join(sym_map, by = c("SYMBOL" = "SYMBOL_IN")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
      transmute(
        species_id,
        ENTREZID  = as.character(ENTREZID),
        mapped_by = "map_SYMBOL_ALIAS_to_ENTREZID"
      )

    out <- bind_rows(direct_entrez, ens_entrez, sym_entrez) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
      distinct()

    if (allow_direct_fallback_if_map_exists) {
      mapped_ids <- clean_match_id(out$species_id)
      unmapped_ids <- ids_raw[!tolower(ids_raw) %in% mapped_ids]

      fallback_ens <- map_ensdarg_to_entrez(unmapped_ids) %>%
        transmute(
          species_id = ENSDARG,
          ENTREZID   = as.character(ENTREZID),
          mapped_by  = "fallback_direct_ENSDARG_to_ENTREZID"
        )

      fallback_sym <- map_symbol_alias_to_entrez(unmapped_ids) %>%
        transmute(
          species_id = SYMBOL_IN,
          ENTREZID   = as.character(ENTREZID),
          mapped_by  = "fallback_direct_SYMBOL_ALIAS_to_ENTREZID"
        )

      out <- bind_rows(out, fallback_ens, fallback_sym) %>%
        filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
        distinct()
    }

    route_counts <- out %>%
      count(mapped_by, name = "n_entrez_records") %>%
      arrange(desc(n_entrez_records))

    message(
      "[", spec, " ", context, "] IDs: ", length(ids_raw),
      " | key matches, case-insensitive: ", key_match_count(ids_raw, species_map),
      " | mapped Entrez: ", n_distinct(out$ENTREZID)
    )
    print(route_counts)

    return(out)
  }

  ens_direct <- map_ensdarg_to_entrez(ids_raw) %>%
    transmute(
      species_id = ENSDARG,
      ENTREZID   = as.character(ENTREZID),
      mapped_by  = "direct_ENSDARG_to_ENTREZID"
    )

  sym_direct <- map_symbol_alias_to_entrez(ids_raw) %>%
    transmute(
      species_id = SYMBOL_IN,
      ENTREZID   = as.character(ENTREZID),
      mapped_by  = "direct_SYMBOL_ALIAS_to_ENTREZID"
    )

  out <- bind_rows(ens_direct, sym_direct) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), nzchar(ENTREZID)) %>%
    distinct()

  message(
    "[", spec, " ", context, "] IDs: ", length(ids_raw),
    " | mapped Entrez by direct fallback: ", n_distinct(out$ENTREZID)
  )

  out
}

# ================================================================
# 4. KEGG enrichment utilities
# ================================================================

parse_ratio <- function(x) {
  sp <- strsplit(as.character(x), "/", fixed = TRUE)

  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vapply(sp, `[`, character(1), 1)))
  den <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vapply(sp, `[`, character(1), 2)))

  out <- num / den
  out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}

tidy_kegg_for_bubbles <- function(tbl) {
  if (is.null(tbl) || !nrow(tbl)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      pathway   = Description,
      nPath     = as.numeric(Count),
      pct       = 100 * parse_ratio(GeneRatio),
      neglogFDR = -log10(p.adjust)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(pathway),
      !is.na(pct),
      !is.na(nPath),
      !is.na(neglogFDR)
    ) %>%
    select(
      any_of(c(
        "species",
        "treatment",
        "direction",
        "ID",
        "pathway",
        "pct",
        "nPath",
        "neglogFDR",
        "pvalue",
        "p.adjust",
        "qvalue",
        "GeneRatio",
        "BgRatio",
        "Count",
        "geneID"
      ))
    )
}

enrich_kegg_one <- function(df,
                            spec,
                            treatment,
                            direction = c("Up", "Down"),
                            universe_entrez,
                            species_map,
                            min_fg = MIN_FG) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  diag_stub <- tibble(
    species              = spec,
    treatment            = treatment,
    direction            = direction,
    raw_deg              = 0L,
    query_key_matches    = 0L,
    query_key_match_frac = NA_real_,
    query_entrez         = 0L,
    query_entrez_frac    = NA_real_,
    query_in_bg          = 0L,
    bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
    n_terms              = 0L,
    min_fdr              = NA_real_,
    status               = "no_df_or_no_logFC"
  )

  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag_stub))
  }

  sub <- df %>%
    filter(if (direction == "Up") logFC > 0 else logFC < 0)

  raw_deg <- nrow(sub)

  if (!raw_deg) {
    diag <- diag_stub %>%
      mutate(raw_deg = 0L, status = "no_deg_in_direction")

    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag))
  }

  query_key_matches <- key_match_count(
    ids = sub$.species_id,
    species_map = species_map
  )

  fg_map <- map_species_ids_to_entrez(
    ids         = sub$.species_id,
    spec        = spec,
    species_map = species_map,
    context     = paste(treatment, direction)
  )

  fg_entrez_all <- unique(as.character(fg_map$ENTREZID))
  fg_entrez_all <- fg_entrez_all[!is.na(fg_entrez_all) & nzchar(fg_entrez_all)]

  universe_entrez <- unique(as.character(universe_entrez))
  universe_entrez <- universe_entrez[!is.na(universe_entrez) & nzchar(universe_entrez)]

  fg_entrez <- intersect(fg_entrez_all, universe_entrez)

  if (length(fg_entrez) < min_fg) {
    diag <- tibble(
      species              = spec,
      treatment            = treatment,
      direction            = direction,
      raw_deg              = raw_deg,
      query_key_matches    = query_key_matches,
      query_key_match_frac = query_key_matches / raw_deg,
      query_entrez         = length(fg_entrez_all),
      query_entrez_frac    = length(fg_entrez_all) / raw_deg,
      query_in_bg          = length(fg_entrez),
      bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
      n_terms              = 0L,
      min_fdr              = NA_real_,
      status               = "too_few_query_entrez_in_background"
    )

    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag))
  }

  ek <- suppressWarnings(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene          = fg_entrez,
      organism      = KEGG_ORGANISM,
      universe      = universe_entrez,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = KEGG_P_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = KEGG_Q_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GS_SIZE,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GS_SIZE
    )
  )

  res_tbl <- if (!is.null(ek) && !is.null(ek@result)) {
    as_tibble(ek@result)
  } else {
    tibble()
  }

  res_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    mutate(
      species   = spec,
      treatment = treatment,
      direction = direction,
      .before = 1
    )

  diag <- tibble(
    species              = spec,
    treatment            = treatment,
    direction            = direction,
    raw_deg              = raw_deg,
    query_key_matches    = query_key_matches,
    query_key_match_frac = query_key_matches / raw_deg,
    query_entrez         = length(fg_entrez_all),
    query_entrez_frac    = length(fg_entrez_all) / raw_deg,
    query_in_bg          = length(fg_entrez),
    bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
    n_terms              = nrow(res_tbl),
    min_fdr              = if (nrow(res_tbl)) min(res_tbl$p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    status               = if (nrow(res_tbl)) "terms_returned" else "no_terms_returned"
  )

  list(tbl = res_tbl, diag = diag)
}

build_species_kegg <- function(spec, min_fg = MIN_FG) {
  bg_name <- paste0("keep_counts_", spec)

  if (!exists(bg_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
    stop("[", spec, "] Missing background object: ", bg_name)
  }

  bg_obj <- get(bg_name, inherits = TRUE)
  bg_ids <- rownames(bg_obj)

  ref_ids <- get_species_reference_ids(spec)

  species_map <- get_species_map(
    spec,
    ref_ids = ref_ids
  )

  bg_key_matches <- key_match_count(
    ids = bg_ids,
    species_map = species_map
  )

  bg_map <- map_species_ids_to_entrez(
    ids         = bg_ids,
    spec        = spec,
    species_map = species_map,
    context     = "background"
  )

  bg_entrez <- unique(as.character(bg_map$ENTREZID))
  bg_entrez <- bg_entrez[!is.na(bg_entrez) & nzchar(bg_entrez)]

  bg_input_n <- length(unique(tolower(bg_ids)))

  message("[", spec, "] Final KEGG background Entrez IDs: ", length(bg_entrez))

  hyp_df  <- get_species_de(spec, "Hypoxia")
  ilos_df <- get_species_de(spec, "ILOS")

  runs <- list(
    ILOS_Up = enrich_kegg_one(
      df = ilos_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "ILOS",
      direction = "Up",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    ),
    Hypoxia_Up = enrich_kegg_one(
      df = hyp_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "Hypoxia",
      direction = "Up",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    ),
    ILOS_Down = enrich_kegg_one(
      df = ilos_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "ILOS",
      direction = "Down",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    ),
    Hypoxia_Down = enrich_kegg_one(
      df = hyp_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "Hypoxia",
      direction = "Down",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    )
  )

  tbls  <- lapply(runs, function(x) tidy_kegg_for_bubbles(x$tbl))
  diags <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "diag"))

  background_diag <- tibble(
    species           = spec,
    map_key_col       = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "key_col")),
    map_ens_col       = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "ens_col")),
    map_symbol_col    = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "sym_col")),
    map_entrez_col    = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "entrez_col")),
    bg_input_ids      = bg_input_n,
    bg_key_matches    = bg_key_matches,
    bg_key_match_frac = as.numeric(bg_key_matches) / as.numeric(bg_input_n),
    bg_entrez         = length(bg_entrez),
    bg_entrez_frac    = as.numeric(length(bg_entrez)) / as.numeric(bg_input_n)
  )

  list(
    tables = tbls,
    diagnostics = diags,
    background = background_diag,
    key_audit = attr(species_map, "key_audit")
  )
}

# ================================================================
# 5. Build KEGG once and audit mapping before plotting

# ================================================================
# 6. Bubble plot helpers with fixed-width interiors
# ================================================================

get_kt_panel <- function(sp, nm) {
  if (!is.null(KT[[sp]][[nm]])) {
    return(KT[[sp]][[nm]])
  }

  alias <- c(
    Hypoxia_Up   = "Hypox_Up",
    Hypoxia_Down = "Hypox_Down"
  )

  if (nm %in% names(alias) && !is.null(KT[[sp]][[alias[[nm]]]])) {
    return(KT[[sp]][[alias[[nm]]]])
  }

  tibble()
}

keep_top <- function(dat,
                     top_n = TOP_N_PANEL,
                     by = c("neglogFDR", "pct", "nPath")) {
  if (is.null(dat) || !nrow(dat)) return(tibble())

  by <- match.arg(by)

  dat %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[by]]), desc(pct), desc(nPath), pathway) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
}

get_bubble_limits <- function(KT, top_n = TOP_N_PANEL, select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY) {
  all_top <- map(species_order, function(sp) {
    bind_rows(
      keep_top(get_kt_panel(sp, "ILOS_Up"),      top_n = top_n, by = select_by),
      keep_top(get_kt_panel(sp, "Hypoxia_Up"),   top_n = top_n, by = select_by),
      keep_top(get_kt_panel(sp, "ILOS_Down"),    top_n = top_n, by = select_by),
      keep_top(get_kt_panel(sp, "Hypoxia_Down"), top_n = top_n, by = select_by)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  list(
    size_lim = if (nrow(all_top)) range(all_top$nPath, na.rm = TRUE) else c(1, 10),
    fill_lim = if (nrow(all_top)) range(all_top$neglogFDR, na.rm = TRUE) else c(1, 5),
    all_top = all_top
  )
}

bubble_lims <- get_bubble_limits(
  KT,
  top_n = TOP_N_PANEL,
  select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY
)

size_lim_global <- bubble_lims$size_lim
fill_lim_global <- bubble_lims$fill_lim
pct_lim_global  <- c(0, PCT_CAP)

prepare_bubble_data <- function(dat,
                                top_n = TOP_N_PANEL,
                                select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY,
                                y_order_by = ORDER_Y_BY,
                                wrap_width = 34) {
  if (is.null(dat) || !nrow(dat)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  dat <- keep_top(dat, top_n = top_n, by = select_by)

  if (!nrow(dat)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(pathway, width = wrap_width),
      y_order_value = .data[[y_order_by]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(y_order_value, pathway_wrapped) %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_factor = factor(pathway_wrapped, levels = unique(pathway_wrapped))
    )
}

bubble_dot_plot <- function(dat_prepped,
                            size_lim = size_lim_global,
                            fill_lim = fill_lim_global,
                            pct_lim = pct_lim_global,
                            pct_breaks = PCT_BREAKS,
                            show_legend = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    dat_prepped,
    aes(x = pct, y = pathway_factor)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = nPath, fill = neglogFDR),
      shape = 21,
      alpha = 0.9,
      stroke = 0.45,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = pct_lim,
      breaks = pct_breaks,
      oob = scales::squish,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "DE genes",
      limits = size_lim,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      low = blue_low,
      high = blue_high,
      limits = fill_lim,
      oob = scales::squish,
      guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = txt_base) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = txt_axis_x, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = legend_text_size, color = "black"),
      plot.margin        = margin(1, 3, 8, 3)
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}

bubble_label_plot <- function(dat_prepped,
                              side = c("left", "right")) {
  side <- match.arg(side)

  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  x_pos <- if (side == "left") 0.98 else 0.02
  hjust_val <- if (side == "left") 1 else 0

  ggplot(
    dat_prepped,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = pathway_factor,
      label = pathway_wrapped
    )
  ) +
    geom_text(
      hjust = hjust_val,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = pathway_text_size,
      lineheight = 0.92,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(1, 3, 6, 3)
    )
}

bubble_cell <- function(dat,
                        side = c("left", "right")) {
  side <- match.arg(side)

  dat_prepped <- prepare_bubble_data(
    dat,
    top_n = TOP_N_PANEL,
    select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY,
    y_order_by = ORDER_Y_BY,
    wrap_width = 38
  )

  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  p_lab <- bubble_label_plot(dat_prepped, side = side)
  p_dot <- bubble_dot_plot(dat_prepped, show_legend = FALSE)

  if (side == "left") {
    ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(
        p_lab,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        p_dot,
        x = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC,
        height = 1
      )
  } else {
    ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(
        p_dot,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        p_lab,
        x = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC,
        height = 1
      )
  }
}

# ================================================================
# 7. Standalone KEGG figures sourced from KT
# ================================================================

bubble_plot_standalone <- function(dat,
                                   title = NULL,
                                   top_n = TOP_N_STANDALONE,
                                   select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY,
                                   y_order_by = ORDER_Y_BY,
                                   wrap_width = 38,
                                   show_legend = TRUE) {
  dat_prepped <- prepare_bubble_data(
    dat,
    top_n = top_n,
    select_by = select_by,
    y_order_by = y_order_by,
    wrap_width = wrap_width
  )

  if (!nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = title) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            face = "bold",
            size = txt_title,
            color = "black"
          )
        )
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot(dat_prepped, aes(x = pct, y = pathway_factor)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = nPath, fill = neglogFDR),
      shape = 21,
      alpha = 0.9,
      stroke = 0.45,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = pct_lim_global,
      breaks = PCT_BREAKS,
      oob = scales::squish,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "DE genes",
      limits = size_lim_global,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      low = blue_low,
      high = blue_high,
      limits = fill_lim_global,
      oob = scales::squish,
      guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "% of KEGG-mapped DE genes in pathway",
      y = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = txt_base) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = txt_title, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = txt_axis_y, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = txt_axis_x, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = txt_axis_x + 1, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = legend_text_size, color = "black"),
      plot.margin        = margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}

make_species_kegg_figure <- function(spec,
                                     top_n = TOP_N_STANDALONE,
                                     save = TRUE) {
  p_iu <- bubble_plot_standalone(
    get_kt_panel(spec, "ILOS_Up"),
    title = paste(spec, "— ILOS • Up"),
    top_n = top_n,
    show_legend = FALSE
  )

  p_hu <- bubble_plot_standalone(
    get_kt_panel(spec, "Hypoxia_Up"),
    title = paste(spec, "— Hypoxia • Up"),
    top_n = top_n,
    show_legend = FALSE
  )

  p_id <- bubble_plot_standalone(
    get_kt_panel(spec, "ILOS_Down"),
    title = paste(spec, "— ILOS • Down"),
    top_n = top_n,
    show_legend = FALSE
  )

  p_hd <- bubble_plot_standalone(
    get_kt_panel(spec, "Hypoxia_Down"),
    title = paste(spec, "— Hypoxia • Down"),
    top_n = top_n,
    show_legend = FALSE
  )

  fig <- (p_iu | p_hu | p_id | p_hd) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(spec, " — KEGG Pathway Enrichment"),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          hjust = 0.5,
          face = "bold",
          size = 22,
          color = "black"
        )
      )
    ) &
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      text = element_text(color = "black")
    )

  if (save) {
    sp_dir <- file.path("edgeR_output", spec, "KEGG")
    dir.create(sp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    ggsave(
      file.path(sp_dir, paste0("KEGG_bubbles_", spec, "_", run_date, ".png")),
      fig,
      width = 31,
      height = 10.5,
      dpi = 500,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )

    ggsave(
      file.path(sp_dir, paste0("KEGG_bubbles_", spec, "_", run_date, ".pdf")),
      fig,
      width = 31,
      height = 10.5,
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }

  fig
}

p_species_kegg <- setNames(
  lapply(species_order, make_species_kegg_figure),
  species_order
)

# ================================================================
# 8. Venn counts from full DEG objects
# ================================================================

get_deg_set <- function(spec,
                        treatment = c("Hypoxia", "ILOS"),
                        direction = c("Up", "Down")) {
  treatment <- match.arg(treatment)
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  df <- get_species_de(spec, treatment)

  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  df %>%
    filter(if (direction == "Up") logFC > 0 else logFC < 0) %>%
    pull(.species_id) %>%
    clean_match_id()
}

venn_row_for <- function(spec, direction) {
  hyp <- get_deg_set(spec, "Hypoxia", direction)
  ilo <- get_deg_set(spec, "ILOS",    direction)

  tibble(
    Species        = spec,
    Direction      = direction,
    hypoxia_n      = length(hyp),
    ilos_n         = length(ilo),
    overlap        = length(intersect(hyp, ilo)),
    hypoxia_unique = length(setdiff(hyp, ilo)),
    ilos_unique    = length(setdiff(ilo, hyp))
  )
}

venn_counts <- map_dfr(species_order, function(sp) {
  bind_rows(
    venn_row_for(sp, "Up"),
    venn_row_for(sp, "Down")
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order),
    Direction = factor(Direction, levels = dir_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Species, Direction)

print(venn_counts)

write_csv_safe(
  venn_counts,
  file.path(out_panel_dir, paste0("Venn_counts_full_DEG_sets_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

# ================================================================
# 9. Venn geometry
# ================================================================

circle_overlap_area <- function(r1, r2, d) {
  if (d >= r1 + r2) return(0)
  if (d <= abs(r1 - r2)) return(pi * min(r1, r2)^2)

  r1_2 <- r1^2
  r2_2 <- r2^2

  a <- acos((d^2 + r1_2 - r2_2) / (2 * d * r1)) * 2
  b <- acos((d^2 + r2_2 - r1_2) / (2 * d * r2)) * 2

  0.5 * r1_2 * (a - sin(a)) +
    0.5 * r2_2 * (b - sin(b))
}

max_area_mac <- venn_counts %>%
  filter(Species == "MAC") %>%
  summarise(m = max(c(hypoxia_n, ilos_n), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(m)

if (!is.finite(max_area_mac) || max_area_mac <= 0) {
  max_area_mac <- 1
}

VENN_SCALE <- 0.8
R_BASE     <- 2.6 * 1.35
R_MAX      <- R_BASE * VENN_SCALE

rad_from_total <- function(A) {
  R_MAX * sqrt(A / max_area_mac)
}

X_PAD <- 1.45 * R_MAX
Y_MIN <- -1.45 * R_MAX
Y_MAX <-  1.25 * R_MAX

make_pair_panel <- function(total_hyp, total_ilo, overlap) {
  total_hyp <- ifelse(length(total_hyp), total_hyp, 0)
  total_ilo <- ifelse(length(total_ilo), total_ilo, 0)
  overlap   <- ifelse(length(overlap),   overlap,   0)

  if ((total_hyp <= 0) && (total_ilo <= 0)) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD, X_PAD), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN, Y_MAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
    )
  }

  r1 <- if (total_hyp > 0) rad_from_total(total_hyp) else 0
  r2 <- if (total_ilo > 0) rad_from_total(total_ilo) else 0

  A_ov <- pi * R_MAX^2 * (overlap / max_area_mac)

  u_h <- max(total_hyp - overlap, 0)
  u_i <- max(total_ilo - overlap, 0)

  d <- if (overlap <= 0) {
    (r1 + r2) * 2.6
  } else if (u_h == 0 || u_i == 0) {
    0.70 * abs(r1 - r2)
  } else {
    eps <- 1e-6
    uniroot(
      function(dd) circle_overlap_area(r1, r2, dd) - A_ov,
      lower = abs(r1 - r2) + eps,
      upper = (r1 + r2) - eps
    )$root
  }

  cx_i <- -d / 2
  cx_h <-  d / 2

  circ_df <- bind_rows(
    if (total_ilo > 0) tibble(set = "ILOS",    cx = cx_i, cy = 0, r = r2) else NULL,
    if (total_hyp > 0) tibble(set = "Hypoxia", cx = cx_h, cy = 0, r = r1) else NULL
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = circ_df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, fill = set),
      alpha = alpha_fill,
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = circ_df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, color = set),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = stroke_size
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_fill, ILOS = col_ilo_fill),
      name = "Treatment"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_line, ILOS = col_ilo_line),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD, X_PAD), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN, Y_MAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(2, 6, 2, 6)
    )

  if (u_i > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_i - r2 * 0.10,
      y = r2 + R_MAX * 0.12,
      label = comma(u_i),
      size = label_size,
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  if (overlap > 0 && total_hyp > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = comma(overlap),
      size = overlap_label_size,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  if (u_h > 0 && total_hyp > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_h + r1 * 0.10,
      y = -r1 - R_MAX * 0.12,
      label = comma(u_h),
      size = label_size,
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  p
}

venn_cell <- function(sp, direction = c("Up", "Down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  sub <- venn_counts %>%
    filter(Species == sp, Direction == direction)

  make_pair_panel(
    total_hyp = sub$hypoxia_n,
    total_ilo = sub$ilos_n,
    overlap   = sub$overlap
  )
}

row_for_species <- function(sp) {
  iu <- get_kt_panel(sp, "ILOS_Up")
  hu <- get_kt_panel(sp, "Hypoxia_Up")
  id <- get_kt_panel(sp, "ILOS_Down")
  hd <- get_kt_panel(sp, "Hypoxia_Down")

  left_up_empty    <- is.null(iu) || !nrow(iu)
  right_up_empty   <- is.null(hu) || !nrow(hu)
  left_down_empty  <- is.null(id) || !nrow(id)
  right_down_empty <- is.null(hd) || !nrow(hd)

  cor_note <- "Insufficient DEGs\nfor Pathway Analysis"

  row_canvas <- ggdraw() +
    draw_plot(
      label_cell(sp),
      x = x_species,
      y = 0,
      width = w_species,
      height = 1
    )

  if (sp == "COR" && left_up_empty && right_up_empty) {
    row_canvas <- row_canvas +
      draw_plot(
        note_cell(cor_note),
        x = x_ilos_up,
        y = 0,
        width = 2 * w_bub,
        height = 1
      )
  } else {
    row_canvas <- row_canvas +
      draw_plot(
        bubble_cell(iu, side = "left"),
        x = x_ilos_up,
        y = 0,
        width = w_bub,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        bubble_cell(hu, side = "right"),
        x = x_hyp_up,
        y = 0,
        width = w_bub,
        height = 1
      )
  }

  row_canvas <- row_canvas +
    draw_plot(
      venn_cell(sp, "Up"),
      x = x_ven_up,
      y = 0,
      width = w_ven,
      height = 1
    ) +
    draw_plot(
      venn_cell(sp, "Down"),
      x = x_ven_down,
      y = 0,
      width = w_ven,
      height = 1
    )

  if (sp == "COR" && left_down_empty && right_down_empty) {
    row_canvas <- row_canvas +
      draw_plot(
        note_cell(cor_note),
        x = x_ilos_down,
        y = 0,
        width = 2 * w_bub,
        height = 1
      )
  } else {
    row_canvas <- row_canvas +
      draw_plot(
        bubble_cell(id, side = "left"),
        x = x_ilos_down,
        y = 0,
        width = w_bub,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        bubble_cell(hd, side = "right"),
        x = x_hyp_down,
        y = 0,
        width = w_bub,
        height = 1
      )
  }

  row_canvas
}
```

## Combined Fig. 4a - All DEGs KEGG & VENNs

```{r}
# ================================================================
# 14. ALTERNATE PANEL:
#     KEGG + Venn using ALL significant DEGs
#     No up/down separation
#
# Layout:
#   Species | ILOP KEGG bubbles | ILOP ∩ Hypoxia DEG Venn | Hypoxia KEGG bubbles
#
# Notes:
#   - Object names still use "ILOS" because your upstream objects are named that way.
#   - Display text is changed to "ILOP".
#   - KEGG enrichment is rerun using all significant DEGs per treatment,
#     not by combining Up/Down KEGG results.
#   - Venns use all significant DEGs per treatment.
# ================================================================

DISPLAY_ILOS <- "ILOP"

TOP_N_PANEL_ALL <- 15
SELECT_TOP_BY_ALL <- SELECT_TOP_BY
ORDER_Y_BY_ALL    <- ORDER_Y_BY

PCT_CAP_ALL    <- 9
PCT_BREAKS_ALL <- seq(0, PCT_CAP_ALL, by=3)

pathway_text_size_all <- max(pathway_text_size, 6.8)
txt_hdr_all           <- max(txt_hdr, 10.5)
txt_section_all       <- max(txt_section, 13.0)
txt_section_sub_all   <- max(txt_section_sub, 10.0)
txt_note_all          <- max(txt_note, 8.0)

BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC_ALL <- 0.74
BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC_ALL   <- 1 - BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC_ALL

# ================================================================
# 14A. KEGG enrichment using all significant DEGs
# ================================================================

safe_lim_all <- function(x, fallback = c(0, 1), pad = 0.5, lower_floor = NULL) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (!length(x)) {
    return(fallback)
  }

  r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(r[1]) || !is.finite(r[2])) {
    return(fallback)
  }

  if (r[1] == r[2]) {
    pad_use <- max(pad, abs(r[1]) * 0.05)
    r <- r + c(-pad_use, pad_use)
  }

  if (!is.null(lower_floor)) {
    r[1] <- max(lower_floor, r[1])
  }

  r
}

enrich_kegg_all_one <- function(df,
                                spec,
                                treatment,
                                universe_entrez,
                                species_map,
                                min_fg = MIN_FG) {

  diag_stub <- tibble(
    species              = spec,
    treatment            = treatment,
    direction            = "All",
    raw_deg              = 0L,
    query_key_matches    = 0L,
    query_key_match_frac = NA_real_,
    query_entrez         = 0L,
    query_entrez_frac    = NA_real_,
    query_in_bg          = 0L,
    bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
    n_terms              = 0L,
    min_fdr              = NA_real_,
    status               = "no_df_or_no_logFC"
  )

  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag_stub))
  }

  # All rows in sig.*.fdr are treated as significant DEGs.
  # We only require a finite logFC so that malformed rows do not enter the set.
  sub <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(logFC), is.finite(logFC))

  raw_deg <- nrow(sub)

  if (!raw_deg) {
    diag <- diag_stub %>%
      mutate(status = "no_deg_after_logFC_filter")

    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag))
  }

  query_key_matches <- key_match_count(
    ids = sub$.species_id,
    species_map = species_map
  )

  fg_map <- map_species_ids_to_entrez(
    ids         = sub$.species_id,
    spec        = spec,
    species_map = species_map,
    context     = paste(treatment, "All")
  )

  fg_entrez_all <- unique(as.character(fg_map$ENTREZID))
  fg_entrez_all <- fg_entrez_all[!is.na(fg_entrez_all) & nzchar(fg_entrez_all)]

  universe_entrez <- unique(as.character(universe_entrez))
  universe_entrez <- universe_entrez[!is.na(universe_entrez) & nzchar(universe_entrez)]

  fg_entrez <- intersect(fg_entrez_all, universe_entrez)

  if (length(fg_entrez) < min_fg) {
    diag <- tibble(
      species              = spec,
      treatment            = treatment,
      direction            = "All",
      raw_deg              = raw_deg,
      query_key_matches    = query_key_matches,
      query_key_match_frac = query_key_matches / raw_deg,
      query_entrez         = length(fg_entrez_all),
      query_entrez_frac    = length(fg_entrez_all) / raw_deg,
      query_in_bg          = length(fg_entrez),
      bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
      n_terms              = 0L,
      min_fdr              = NA_real_,
      status               = "too_few_query_entrez_in_background"
    )

    return(list(tbl = tibble(), diag = diag))
  }

  ek <- suppressWarnings(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene          = fg_entrez,
      organism      = KEGG_ORGANISM,
      universe      = universe_entrez,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = KEGG_P_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = KEGG_Q_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GS_SIZE,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GS_SIZE
    )
  )

  res_tbl <- if (!is.null(ek) && !is.null(ek@result)) {
    as_tibble(ek@result)
  } else {
    tibble()
  }

  res_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    mutate(
      species   = spec,
      treatment = treatment,
      direction = "All",
      .before = 1
    )

  diag <- tibble(
    species              = spec,
    treatment            = treatment,
    direction            = "All",
    raw_deg              = raw_deg,
    query_key_matches    = query_key_matches,
    query_key_match_frac = query_key_matches / raw_deg,
    query_entrez         = length(fg_entrez_all),
    query_entrez_frac    = length(fg_entrez_all) / raw_deg,
    query_in_bg          = length(fg_entrez),
    bg_entrez            = length(universe_entrez),
    n_terms              = nrow(res_tbl),
    min_fdr              = if (nrow(res_tbl)) min(res_tbl$p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    status               = if (nrow(res_tbl)) "terms_returned" else "no_terms_returned"
  )

  list(tbl = res_tbl, diag = diag)
}

build_species_kegg_all <- function(spec, min_fg = MIN_FG) {
  bg_name <- paste0("keep_counts_", spec)

  if (!exists(bg_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
    stop("[", spec, "] Missing background object: ", bg_name)
  }

  bg_obj <- get(bg_name, inherits = TRUE)
  bg_ids <- rownames(bg_obj)

  ref_ids <- get_species_reference_ids(spec)

  species_map <- get_species_map(
    spec,
    ref_ids = ref_ids
  )

  bg_key_matches <- key_match_count(
    ids = bg_ids,
    species_map = species_map
  )

  bg_map <- map_species_ids_to_entrez(
    ids         = bg_ids,
    spec        = spec,
    species_map = species_map,
    context     = "background_allDEG"
  )

  bg_entrez <- unique(as.character(bg_map$ENTREZID))
  bg_entrez <- bg_entrez[!is.na(bg_entrez) & nzchar(bg_entrez)]

  bg_input_n <- length(unique(tolower(bg_ids)))

  message("[", spec, " ALL] Final KEGG background Entrez IDs: ", length(bg_entrez))

  hyp_df  <- get_species_de(spec, "Hypoxia")
  ilos_df <- get_species_de(spec, "ILOS")

  runs <- list(
    ILOS_All = enrich_kegg_all_one(
      df = ilos_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "ILOS",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    ),
    Hypoxia_All = enrich_kegg_all_one(
      df = hyp_df,
      spec = spec,
      treatment = "Hypoxia",
      universe_entrez = bg_entrez,
      species_map = species_map,
      min_fg = min_fg
    )
  )

  tbls  <- lapply(runs, function(x) tidy_kegg_for_bubbles(x$tbl))
  diags <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "diag"))

  background_diag <- tibble(
    species           = spec,
    map_key_col       = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "key_col")),
    map_ens_col       = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "ens_col")),
    map_symbol_col    = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "sym_col")),
    map_entrez_col    = null_to_na(attr(species_map, "entrez_col")),
    bg_input_ids      = bg_input_n,
    bg_key_matches    = bg_key_matches,
    bg_key_match_frac = as.numeric(bg_key_matches) / as.numeric(bg_input_n),
    bg_entrez         = length(bg_entrez),
    bg_entrez_frac    = as.numeric(length(bg_entrez)) / as.numeric(bg_input_n)
  )

  list(
    tables = tbls,
    diagnostics = diags,
    background = background_diag,
    key_audit = attr(species_map, "key_audit")
  )
}

# Build all-DEG KEGG results

get_deg_set_all <- function(spec,
                            treatment = c("Hypoxia", "ILOS")) {
  treatment <- match.arg(treatment)

  df <- get_species_de(spec, treatment)

  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !"logFC" %in% names(df)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(logFC), is.finite(logFC)) %>%
    pull(.species_id) %>%
    clean_match_id()
}

venn_row_all_for <- function(spec) {
  hyp <- get_deg_set_all(spec, "Hypoxia")
  ilo <- get_deg_set_all(spec, "ILOS")

  tibble(
    Species        = spec,
    hypoxia_n      = length(hyp),
    ilos_n         = length(ilo),
    overlap        = length(intersect(hyp, ilo)),
    hypoxia_unique = length(setdiff(hyp, ilo)),
    ilos_unique    = length(setdiff(ilo, hyp))
  )
}

venn_counts_all <- map_dfr(species_order, venn_row_all_for) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)) %>%
  arrange(Species)

print(venn_counts_all)

# ================================================================
# 14C. All-DEG Venn geometry
#      Uses separate scaling so all-DEG circles are not forced onto
#      the original Up/Down-specific Venn scale.
# ================================================================

max_area_mac_all <- venn_counts_all %>%
  filter(Species == "MAC") %>%
  summarise(m = max(c(hypoxia_n, ilos_n), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(m)

if (!is.finite(max_area_mac_all) || max_area_mac_all <= 0) {
  max_area_mac_all <- 1
}

VENN_SCALE_ALL <- VENN_SCALE
R_BASE_ALL     <- R_BASE
R_MAX_ALL      <- R_BASE_ALL * VENN_SCALE_ALL

rad_from_total_all <- function(A) {
  R_MAX_ALL * sqrt(A / max_area_mac_all)
}

X_PAD_ALL <- 1.45 * R_MAX_ALL
Y_MIN_ALL <- -1.45 * R_MAX_ALL
Y_MAX_ALL <-  1.25 * R_MAX_ALL

make_pair_panel_all <- function(total_hyp, total_ilo, overlap) {
  total_hyp <- ifelse(length(total_hyp), total_hyp, 0)
  total_ilo <- ifelse(length(total_ilo), total_ilo, 0)
  overlap   <- ifelse(length(overlap),   overlap,   0)

  if ((total_hyp <= 0) && (total_ilo <= 0)) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD_ALL, X_PAD_ALL), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN_ALL, Y_MAX_ALL), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
    )
  }

  r1 <- if (total_hyp > 0) rad_from_total_all(total_hyp) else 0
  r2 <- if (total_ilo > 0) rad_from_total_all(total_ilo) else 0

  A_ov <- pi * R_MAX_ALL^2 * (overlap / max_area_mac_all)

  u_h <- max(total_hyp - overlap, 0)
  u_i <- max(total_ilo - overlap, 0)

  d <- if (overlap <= 0) {
    (r1 + r2) * 2.6
  } else if (u_h == 0 || u_i == 0) {
    0.70 * abs(r1 - r2)
  } else {
    eps <- 1e-6
    uniroot(
      function(dd) circle_overlap_area(r1, r2, dd) - A_ov,
      lower = abs(r1 - r2) + eps,
      upper = (r1 + r2) - eps
    )$root
  }

  cx_i <- -d / 2
  cx_h <-  d / 2

  circ_df <- bind_rows(
    if (total_ilo > 0) tibble(set = "ILOS",    cx = cx_i, cy = 0, r = r2) else NULL,
    if (total_hyp > 0) tibble(set = "Hypoxia", cx = cx_h, cy = 0, r = r1) else NULL
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = circ_df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, fill = set),
      alpha = alpha_fill,
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggforce::geom_circle(
      data = circ_df,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, r = r, color = set),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = stroke_size
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_fill, ILOS = col_ilo_fill),
      name = "Treatment"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Hypoxia = col_hyp_line, ILOS = col_ilo_line),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-X_PAD_ALL, X_PAD_ALL), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(Y_MIN_ALL, Y_MAX_ALL), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(2, 6, 2, 6)
    )

  if (u_i > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_i - r2 * 0.10,
      y = r2 + R_MAX_ALL * 0.12,
      label = comma(u_i),
      size = label_size,
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  if (overlap > 0 && total_hyp > 0 && total_ilo > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = comma(overlap),
      size = overlap_label_size,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  if (u_h > 0 && total_hyp > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = cx_h + r1 * 0.10,
      y = -r1 - R_MAX_ALL * 0.12,
      label = comma(u_h),
      size = label_size,
      color = "black"
    )
  }

  p
}

venn_cell_all <- function(sp) {
  sub <- venn_counts_all %>%
    filter(Species == sp)

  make_pair_panel_all(
    total_hyp = sub$hypoxia_n,
    total_ilo = sub$ilos_n,
    overlap   = sub$overlap
  )
}

get_kt_all_panel <- function(sp, nm) {
  if (!is.null(KT_all[[sp]][[nm]])) {
    return(KT_all[[sp]][[nm]])
  }

  tibble()
}

get_bubble_limits_all <- function(KT_all,
                                  top_n = TOP_N_PANEL_ALL,
                                  select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY_ALL) {

  all_top <- map(species_order, function(sp) {
    bind_rows(
      keep_top(get_kt_all_panel(sp, "ILOS_All"),    top_n = top_n, by = select_by),
      keep_top(get_kt_all_panel(sp, "Hypoxia_All"), top_n = top_n, by = select_by)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  list(
    size_lim = safe_lim_all(all_top$nPath,     fallback = c(1, 10), lower_floor = 1),
    fill_lim = safe_lim_all(all_top$neglogFDR, fallback = c(1, 5),  lower_floor = 0),
    all_top = all_top
  )
}

bubble_lims_all <- get_bubble_limits_all(
  KT_all,
  top_n = TOP_N_PANEL_ALL,
  select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY_ALL
)

size_lim_global_all <- bubble_lims_all$size_lim
fill_lim_global_all <- bubble_lims_all$fill_lim
pct_lim_global_all  <- c(0, PCT_CAP_ALL)

prepare_bubble_data_all <- function(dat,
                                    top_n = TOP_N_PANEL_ALL,
                                    select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY_ALL,
                                    y_order_by = ORDER_Y_BY_ALL,
                                    wrap_width = 46) {
  if (is.null(dat) || !nrow(dat)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  dat <- keep_top(dat, top_n = top_n, by = select_by)

  if (!nrow(dat)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(pathway, width = wrap_width),
      y_order_value = .data[[y_order_by]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(y_order_value, pathway_wrapped) %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_factor = factor(pathway_wrapped, levels = unique(pathway_wrapped))
    )
}

bubble_dot_plot_all <- function(dat_prepped,
                                size_lim = size_lim_global_all,
                                fill_lim = fill_lim_global_all,
                                pct_lim = pct_lim_global_all,
                                pct_breaks = PCT_BREAKS_ALL,
                                show_legend = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    dat_prepped,
    aes(x = pct, y = pathway_factor)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = nPath, fill = neglogFDR),
      shape = 21,
      alpha = 0.9,
      stroke = 0.45,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = pct_lim,
      breaks = pct_breaks,
      oob = scales::squish,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "DE genes",
      limits = size_lim,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      low = blue_low,
      high = blue_high,
      limits = fill_lim,
      oob = scales::squish,
      guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2, title.position = "top")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = txt_base) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = txt_axis_x, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey88"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = legend_text_size, color = "black"),
      plot.margin        = margin(1, 4, 8, 4)
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}

bubble_label_plot_all <- function(dat_prepped,
                                  side = c("left", "right")) {
  side <- match.arg(side)

  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  x_pos <- if (side == "left") 0.98 else 0.02
  hjust_val <- if (side == "left") 1 else 0

  ggplot(
    dat_prepped,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = pathway_factor,
      label = pathway_wrapped
    )
  ) +
    geom_text(
      hjust = hjust_val,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = pathway_text_size_all,
      lineheight = 0.90,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 6, 4)
    )
}

bubble_cell_all <- function(dat,
                            side = c("left", "right")) {
  side <- match.arg(side)

  dat_prepped <- prepare_bubble_data_all(
    dat,
    top_n = TOP_N_PANEL_ALL,
    select_by = SELECT_TOP_BY_ALL,
    y_order_by = ORDER_Y_BY_ALL,
    wrap_width = 46
  )

  if (is.null(dat_prepped) || !nrow(dat_prepped)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  p_lab <- bubble_label_plot_all(dat_prepped, side = side)
  p_dot <- bubble_dot_plot_all(dat_prepped, show_legend = FALSE)

  if (side == "left") {
    ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(
        p_lab,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC_ALL,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        p_dot,
        x = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC_ALL,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC_ALL,
        height = 1
      )
  } else {
    ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(
        p_dot,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC_ALL,
        height = 1
      ) +
      draw_plot(
        p_lab,
        x = BUBBLE_DOT_FRAC_ALL,
        y = 0,
        width = BUBBLE_LABEL_FRAC_ALL,
        height = 1
      )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ================================================================
# 14G. Export Fig. 4 at final PNAS size
#
# Strategy:
#   1. Render the completed figure at its original designed size.
#   2. Embed that completed rendering in an 18 × 18 cm PDF.
#
# This prevents ggplot from rearranging and overlapping elements
# when the output device is reduced directly to publication size.
# ================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(magick)
  library(grid)
})

# ------------------------------------------------
# Output paths
# ------------------------------------------------

dir.create(out_panel_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

temp_png_all <- file.path(
  out_panel_dir,
  paste0(
    "Fig4_fullsize_render_",
    run_date,
    "_TEMP.png"
  )
)

pdf_out_all <- file.path(
  out_panel_dir,
  paste0(
    "DEG_Venn+KEGG_ALL_DEGS_ILOP_Hypoxia_",
    run_date,
    "_PNAS_18cm.pdf"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. Render at the original size for which the
#    figure layout and text were designed
# ------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = temp_png_all,
  plot = final_plot_all,
  width = 34,
  height = 34,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 550,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

if (!file.exists(temp_png_all)) {
  stop("The temporary full-size PNG was not created: ", temp_png_all)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read completed composite
# ------------------------------------------------

fig4_img <- magick::image_read(temp_png_all)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. Place completed composite into final-size PDF
# ------------------------------------------------

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  filename = pdf_out_all,
  width = 18 / 2.54,
  height = 18 / 2.54,
  bg = "white",
  onefile = FALSE
)

grid::grid.newpage()

grid::grid.raster(
  as.raster(fig4_img),
  x = 0.5,
  y = 0.5,
  width = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
  height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
  interpolate = TRUE
)

grDevices::dev.off()

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. Confirm output and remove temporary rendering
# ------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(pdf_out_all)) {
  stop("The final PDF was not created: ", pdf_out_all)
}

unlink(temp_png_all)

cat("\nSaved final PNAS-sized Fig. 4:\n")
cat("  ", normalizePath(pdf_out_all), "\n", sep = "")

print(
  file.info(pdf_out_all)[, c("size", "mtime")]
)
```

# Functional GO Network Visualizations

```{r}
# Required libraries
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Dr.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(visNetwork)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Prepare background gene sets per species
bg_MAC <- rownames(keep_counts_MAC)
bg_ACE <- rownames(keep_counts_ACE)
bg_GIB <- tolower(rownames(keep_counts_GIB))


bg_entrez_MAC <- bitr(bg_MAC, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Dr.eg.db) %>%
  pull(ENTREZID) %>% unique()

bg_entrez_ACE <- bitr(bg_ACE, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Dr.eg.db) %>%
  pull(ENTREZID) %>% unique()

bg_entrez_GIB <- bitr(bg_GIB, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Dr.eg.db) %>%
  pull(ENTREZID) %>% unique()


# Helper function to build enrichment data with GO + KEGG
build_network_data <- function(sig_df, group_label, bg_genes, top_n = 15) {
  gene_list <- sig_df %>% tidyr::drop_na(Entrez) %>% pull(Entrez)

  ego_go <- enrichGO(
    gene          = gene_list,
    OrgDb         = org.Dr.eg.db,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    ont           = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    universe      = bg_genes,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  ego_kegg <- enrichKEGG(
    gene          = gene_list,
    organism      = "dre",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    universe      = bg_genes
  ) %>% setReadable(OrgDb = org.Dr.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  go_long <- ego_go@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(geneID)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "GO") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/")

  kegg_long <- ego_kegg@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(geneID)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "KEGG") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/")

  combined_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(go_long, kegg_long)

  # edges: pathway → gene
  edges <- combined_long %>%
    dplyr::select(from = Description, to = geneID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Regulation = group_label)

  # per-term stats (useful for label size/ordering)
  term_info <- combined_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Description, source) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      padj       = min(p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE),
      gene_count = dplyr::n_distinct(geneID),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(negLog10FDR = -log10(padj))

  # vertices with type + group + styling fields
  vertices <- tibble::tibble(name = unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = ifelse(name %in% combined_long$Description, "Pathway", "Gene")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      term_info %>% dplyr::rename(name = Description),
      by = "name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Group = dplyr::case_when(
      Type == "Gene" ~ "Gene",
      source == "GO" ~ "GO Term",
      source == "KEGG" ~ "KEGG Pathway",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ))

  list(edges = edges, vertices = vertices)
}

build_network_data <- function(sig_df, group_label, bg_genes, top_n = 15) {
  gene_list <- sig_df %>% tidyr::drop_na(Entrez) %>% pull(Entrez)

  ego_go <- enrichGO(
    gene          = gene_list,
    OrgDb         = org.Dr.eg.db,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    ont           = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    universe      = bg_genes,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  ego_kegg <- enrichKEGG(
    gene          = gene_list,
    organism      = "dre",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    universe      = bg_genes
  ) %>% setReadable(OrgDb = org.Dr.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  go_long <- ego_go@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(geneID)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "GO") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/")

  kegg_long <- ego_kegg@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(geneID)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "KEGG") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/")

  combined_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(go_long, kegg_long)

  # edges: pathway → gene
  edges <- combined_long %>%
    dplyr::select(from = Description, to = geneID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Regulation = group_label)

  # per-term stats for styling
  term_info <- combined_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Description, source) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      padj       = min(p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE),
      gene_count = dplyr::n_distinct(geneID),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(negLog10FDR = -log10(padj))

  # gene degree (how many terms a gene connects to)
  gene_deg <- edges %>% dplyr::count(to, name = "gene_deg")

  vertices <- tibble::tibble(name = unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = ifelse(name %in% combined_long$Description, "Pathway", "Gene")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(term_info %>% dplyr::rename(name = Description), by = "name") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene_deg, by = c("name" = "to")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene_deg = dplyr::coalesce(gene_deg, 0L),
      Group = dplyr::case_when(
        Type == "Gene" ~ "Gene",
        source == "GO" ~ "GO Term",
        source == "KEGG" ~ "KEGG Pathway",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  list(edges = edges, vertices = vertices)
}

# Static plot function
plot_static_network <- function(
  up_df, down_df, pdf_name, bg_genes,
  base_size = 22, top_n = 15,
  width = 26, height = 14,
  gene_point_size = 2.6,
  gene_label_min_degree = Inf,   # set to Inf to turn off gene labels; set to 1 to label all genes (very busy)
  layout_pref = c("stress", "kk")  # stress needs graphlayouts; falls back to kk
) {
  layout_pref <- match.arg(layout_pref)

  up_net   <- build_network_data(up_df,   "Upregulated",   bg_genes, top_n = top_n)
  down_net <- build_network_data(down_df, "Downregulated", bg_genes, top_n = top_n)

  # pathway point size from support (−log10 FDR fallback to gene_count)
  size_from_vertices <- function(v) {
    m <- ifelse(is.na(v$negLog10FDR), v$gene_count, v$negLog10FDR)
    rng <- range(m, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(diff(rng)) || diff(rng) == 0) rep(7, nrow(v)) else 6 + 9 * (m - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
  }

  plot_network <- function(net_data, title_text, edge_color) {
    edges    <- net_data$edges
    vertices <- net_data$vertices
    vertices$pt_size <- size_from_vertices(vertices)

    g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = vertices)

    lay <- tryCatch(
      if (layout_pref == "stress") ggraph::create_layout(g, layout = "stress") else ggraph::create_layout(g, layout = "kk"),
      error = function(e) ggraph::create_layout(g, layout = "kk")
    )

    p <- ggraph::ggraph(lay) +
      # faint edges
      ggraph::geom_edge_link(linewidth = 0.35, color = scales::alpha(edge_color, 0.22)) +

      # GENES (now mapped to legend): small light-grey filled circles
      ggraph::geom_node_point(
        aes(filter = Type == "Gene", shape = Group, fill = Group),
        size = gene_point_size, color = "black", stroke = 0.2, alpha = 0.55
      ) +

      # PATHWAYS: circle = GO, square = KEGG; size encodes support
      ggraph::geom_node_point(
        aes(filter = Type == "Pathway", shape = Group, fill = Group, size = pt_size),
        color = "black", stroke = 0.7
      ) +

      # PATHWAY LABELS: white boxes with border (big)
      ggraph::geom_node_label(
        aes(label = name, filter = Type == "Pathway"),
        fill = "white", colour = "black",
        label.size = 0.45, label.r = grid::unit(0.22, "lines"),
        label.padding = grid::unit(0.35, "lines"),
        size = 6.0, repel = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf,
        box.padding = 0.7, point.padding = 0.45, force = 1
      ) +

      # LEGENDS
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c("GO Term" = 21, "KEGG Pathway" = 22, "Gene" = 21),
        name = "Pathway Type"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("GO Term" = "goldenrod", "KEGG Pathway" = "royalblue3", "Gene" = "grey70"),
        name   = "Pathway Type"
      ) +
      scale_size_identity() +

      ggplot2::labs(title = title_text) +
      ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = base_size) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = base_size * 0.95),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = base_size * 1.25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin     = margin(12, 14, 12, 14)
      )

    # OPTIONAL: label genes by degree (how many terms they touch)
    if (is.finite(gene_label_min_degree)) {
      p <- p + ggraph::geom_node_text(
        aes(label = name, filter = Type == "Gene" & gene_deg >= gene_label_min_degree),
        size = 4.2, colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.9, repel = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf,
        box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2, force = 0.8
      )
    }
    p
  }

  plot_up   <- plot_network(up_net,   "A. Upregulated GO + KEGG Terms", edge_color = "salmon3")
  plot_down <- plot_network(down_net, "B. Downregulated GO + KEGG Terms", edge_color = "steelblue3")

  combined <- plot_up + plot_down + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggplot2::ggsave(filename = pdf_name, plot = combined,
                  width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
}


# Interactive plot function
plot_interactive_network <- function(up_df, down_df, html_name, bg_genes) {
  up_net   <- build_network_data(up_df,   "Upregulated",   bg_genes)
  down_net <- build_network_data(down_df, "Downregulated", bg_genes)

  combined_edges    <- dplyr::bind_rows(up_net$edges, down_net$edges)
  combined_vertices <- dplyr::bind_rows(up_net$vertices, down_net$vertices) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  g_combined <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(combined_edges, vertices = combined_vertices)

  # color map for groups
  group_fill <- function(g) dplyr::case_when(
    g == "GO Term"       ~ "goldenrod",
    g == "KEGG Pathway"  ~ "royalblue3",
    g == "Gene"          ~ "rgba(128,128,128,0.25)",
    TRUE                 ~ "#999999"
  )

  # ---- nodes (build list-cols rowwise) ----
  nodes <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_combined, what = "vertices") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      id    = name,
      label = name,
      group = Group,
      shape = ifelse(Type == "Pathway", "box", "dot"),
      value = dplyr::case_when( # larger for pathways
        Type == "Pathway" ~ pmax(10, pmin(30, 8 + 2 * ifelse(is.na(gene_count), 5, gene_count))),
        TRUE              ~ 1
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      font  = list(list(size = ifelse(Type == "Pathway", 24, 16), face = "bold")),
      color = list(list(background = group_fill(Group), border = "black", highlight = "orange")),
      shadow = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(id, label, group, shape, value, font, color, shadow)

  # ---- edges (list-col for color) ----
  edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_combined, what = "edges") %>%
    dplyr::rename(from = from, to = to) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(width = 1) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(color = list(list(color = "grey60", highlight = "orange"))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  vis_plot <- visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, edges, width = "100%", height = "900px") %>%
    visNetwork::visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>%
    visNetwork::visLegend(useGroups = TRUE, width = 0.2) %>%
    visNetwork::visLayout(randomSeed = 1234, improvedLayout = TRUE) %>%
    visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE, hover = TRUE, keyboard = TRUE) %>%
    visNetwork::visPhysics(
      solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
      stabilization = list(enabled = TRUE, iterations = 700)
    )

  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(vis_plot, html_name, selfcontained = FALSE, background = "white")
}
```
