# Top 10 Hub Genes for Pos / Neg Modules associated with ILOS for each species

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/augus/Desktop/UAF/Antarctic Fish Project/RNAseq/edgeR_output/AllSpecies/FDR=0.05_L2FC=0")

# =========================================================
# Hub genes for ILOS_torr per species (Pearson; heatmap-aligned; COR732 excluded)
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(WGCNA)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(gt)
  library(scales)
})
allowWGCNAThreads()

# ---------- strict helper: use exactly ILOS_torr; trait rows must be named by sample IDs ----------
.pick_trait_vec <- function(trait_df, datExpr, trait_col = "ILOS_torr") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(trait_df))
  sx <- rownames(datExpr)
  if (is.null(sx)) stop("datExpr must have rownames that are sample IDs.")
  if (!all(sx %in% rownames(trait_df))) {
    miss <- setdiff(sx, rownames(trait_df))
    stop("Trait data not aligned: missing rows for samples: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  }
  cn <- names(trait_df)
  hit <- which(tolower(cn) == tolower(trait_col))
  if (!length(hit)) stop("Trait column '", trait_col, "' not found in trait data.")
  v <- trait_df[[hit[1]]]
  if (!is.numeric(v)) stop("Trait column '", trait_col, "' must be numeric (as in your heatmap objects).")
  names(v) <- rownames(trait_df)
  v[sx]  # reorder to datExpr row order
}

# ---------- main: pick top + and top − modules (Pearson on valid & not-excluded samples); hubs by |kME| ----------
get_hubs_for_species <- function(datExpr, moduleColors, trait_df,
                                 species = "SPECIES", top_n = 10,
                                 trait_col = "ILOS_torr",
                                 exclude_samples = character()) {
  stopifnot(nrow(datExpr) > 1, ncol(datExpr) > 1)
  moduleColors <- as.character(moduleColors)

  # Eigengenes (all samples), drop grey
  MEs0 <- WGCNA::moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = moduleColors)$eigengenes
  MEs  <- WGCNA::orderMEs(MEs0)
  mods <- sub("^ME", "", colnames(MEs))
  keep <- mods != "grey"
  MEs  <- MEs[, keep, drop = FALSE]; mods <- mods[keep]
  if (!length(mods)) { message("[", species, "] No non-grey modules."); return(tibble()) }

  # Trait vector aligned to samples (exactly like heatmap frames)
  y_all <- .pick_trait_vec(trait_df, datExpr, trait_col = trait_col)

  # Subset to valid samples and exclude specified outliers (e.g., COR732)
  valid <- !is.na(y_all) & !(names(y_all) %in% exclude_samples)
  nUsed <- sum(valid)
  if (nUsed < 2) {
    message("[", species, "] Not enough valid samples for '", trait_col, "'.")
    return(tibble())
  }
  MEs_sub <- MEs[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  y_sub   <- as.numeric(y_all[valid])

  # Pearson correlations (heatmap-aligned)
  r_vec <- as.numeric(cor(MEs_sub, y_sub, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"))
  p_vec <- WGCNA::corPvalueStudent(r_vec, nSamples = nUsed)
  assoc_tbl <- tibble(ModuleColor = mods, r = r_vec, p = p_vec, nUsed = nUsed)

  # Pick top positive & negative
  pos_row <- assoc_tbl %>% slice_max(r, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  neg_row <- assoc_tbl %>% slice_min(r, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("[%s] %s: top+ %s (r=%.3f, p=%.2g, n=%d) | top- %s (r=%.3f, p=%.2g, n=%d)%s",
                  species, trait_col,
                  pos_row$ModuleColor, pos_row$r, pos_row$p, pos_row$nUsed,
                  neg_row$ModuleColor, neg_row$r, neg_row$p, neg_row$nUsed,
                  if (length(exclude_samples)) paste0(" [excluded: ", paste(exclude_samples, collapse=", "), "]") else ""))

  # kME vs ordered MEs (all samples), standard WGCNA
  kME <- WGCNA::signedKME(datExpr, WGCNA::orderMEs(MEs0))
  kmec_names <- colnames(kME)
  kme_color  <- sub("^ME", "", sub("^kME", "", kmec_names))
  find_kme_col <- function(color) {
    hit <- which(tolower(kme_color) == tolower(color))
    if (!length(hit)) return(NA_integer_)
    hit[1]
  }
  kME_pos_col <- find_kme_col(pos_row$ModuleColor)
  kME_neg_col <- find_kme_col(neg_row$ModuleColor)
  genes <- colnames(datExpr)

  pick_top <- function(target_mod, kME_col_idx) {
    if (is.na(kME_col_idx)) return(tibble())
    in_mod <- which(moduleColors == target_mod)
    if (!length(in_mod)) return(tibble())
    kme_vec <- as.numeric(kME[in_mod, kME_col_idx])
    ord <- order(abs(kme_vec), decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
    sel <- head(ord, top_n)
    tibble(Gene = genes[in_mod][sel], kME = kme_vec[sel], Rank = seq_along(sel))
  }

  top_pos <- pick_top(pos_row$ModuleColor, kME_pos_col) %>%
    mutate(Species = species, Direction = "Pos",
           ModuleColor = pos_row$ModuleColor,
           ModuleTraitCor = pos_row$r, ModuleTraitP = pos_row$p, nSamples = pos_row$nUsed)

  top_neg <- pick_top(neg_row$ModuleColor, kME_neg_col) %>%
    mutate(Species = species, Direction = "Neg",
           ModuleColor = neg_row$ModuleColor,
           ModuleTraitCor = neg_row$r, ModuleTraitP = neg_row$p, nSamples = neg_row$nUsed)

  res <- bind_rows(top_pos, top_neg) %>%
    relocate(Species, Direction, ModuleColor, ModuleTraitCor, ModuleTraitP, nSamples,
             Rank, Gene, kME)

  attr(res, "assoc_table") <- assoc_tbl %>% arrange(desc(r))  # for quick QA
  res
}

# ---------- RUN (use the *heatmap* trait frames with rownames = sample IDs) ----------
# Example objects below should be the same ones you used for the heatmaps.
# If a species used a *_full frame in the heatmap, use that here too.

hub_MAC <- get_hubs_for_species(Expr_MAC, moduleColors_MAC, Traits_MAC,
                                species = "MAC", trait_col = "ILOS_torr", top_n = 10)

hub_GIB <- get_hubs_for_species(Expr_GIB, moduleColors_GIB, Traits_GIB,
                                species = "GIB", trait_col = "ILOS_torr", top_n = 10)

hub_COR <- get_hubs_for_species(Expr_COR, moduleColors_COR, Traits_COR_full,
                                species = "COR", trait_col = "ILOS_torr", top_n = 10,
                                exclude_samples = c("COR732"))   # <-- match heatmap

hub_GEO <- get_hubs_for_species(Expr_GEO, moduleColors_GEO, Traits_GEO_full,
                                species = "GEO", trait_col = "ILOS_torr", top_n = 10)

hub_ACE <- get_hubs_for_species(Expr_ACE, moduleColors_ACE, Traits_ACE,
                                species = "ACE", trait_col = "ILOS_torr", top_n = 10)

# ---------- combine & table ----------
species_order <- c("MAC","GIB","COR","GEO","ACE")
dir_order     <- c("Pos","Neg")

all_hubs <- bind_rows(hub_MAC, hub_GIB, hub_COR, hub_GEO, hub_ACE) %>%
  filter(n() > 0) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order),
         Direction = factor(Direction, levels = dir_order)) %>%
  arrange(Species, Direction, ModuleColor, Rank)

if (nrow(all_hubs) == 0) stop("No hub genes found. Check that your heatmap trait frames are passed in here.")

# Optional quick QA: top 5 rows of the ME–trait table per species
message("\n--- ME–ILOS_torr tables (top 5 rows each) ---")
lapply(
  list(MAC=hub_MAC, GIB=hub_GIB, COR=hub_COR, GEO=hub_GEO, ACE=hub_ACE),
  function(x) { print(head(attr(x, "assoc_table"), 5)); cat("\n") }
)

# Pretty GT table
tab <- all_hubs %>%
  transmute(
    Species, Direction,
    Module = ModuleColor,
    `r` = ModuleTraitCor,
    `p` = ModuleTraitP,
    `n` = nSamples,
    Rank, Gene, kME
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Species") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Top 10 hub genes for ILOS_torr-associated modules**"),
    subtitle = "Most positively and negatively ILOS_torr-correlated non-grey modules per species (Pearson; COR732 excluded)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Direction = "Direction", Module = "Module",
    `r` = "ME–ILOS_torr cor", `p` = "P-value", `n` = "n (used)",
    Rank = "Rank", Gene = "Gene", kME = "kME"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Module–Trait association", columns = c(`r`,`p`,`n`)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Hub genes (by |kME|)",     columns = c(Rank, Gene, kME)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`r`, kME), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_scientific(columns = `p`, decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), data_row.padding = px(6),
              row_group.as_column = FALSE, row_group.font.weight = "bold") %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Direction, Module, Rank)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right",  columns = c(`r`, `p`, `n`, kME))

gtsave(tab, "ILOS_hub_genes_table.html")
readr::write_csv(all_hubs, "ILOS_hub_genes_table_raw.csv")

library(flextable)
ft <- flextable(all_hubs)
# Save to DOCX
save_as_docx("ILOS hub genes" = ft, path = "ILOS_hub_genes_table.docx")

# Load your hub table
library(dplyr); library(readr); library(tibble)

# 1) Load hubs
hubs <- read_csv("ILOS_hub_genes_table_raw.csv")

# 2) Build full tables (log2FC for ALL genes) from edgeR objects
mac_all <- topTags(qlf.ILOS_MAC, n = Inf)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  transmute(Species = "MAC", Gene, log2FC = logFC, FDR)

gib_all <- topTags(qlf.ILOS_GIB, n = Inf)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  transmute(Species = "GIB", Gene, log2FC = logFC, FDR)

cor_all <- topTags(qlf.ILOS_COR, n = Inf)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  transmute(Species = "COR", Gene, log2FC = logFC, FDR)

geo_all <- topTags(qlf.ILOS_GEO, n = Inf)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  transmute(Species = "GEO", Gene, log2FC = logFC, FDR)

ace_all <- topTags(qlf.ILOS_ACE, n = Inf)$table %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  transmute(Species = "ACE", Gene, log2FC = logFC, FDR)

de_all <- bind_rows(mac_all, gib_all, cor_all, geo_all, ace_all)

# 3) Join onto hubs (now no missing log2FCs) and save
hubs_with_lfc <- hubs %>%
  left_join(de_all, by = c("Species", "Gene"))

write_csv(hubs_with_lfc, "ILOS_hub_genes_table_with_log2FC.csv")
```
